`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/theme_provider.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/rendering.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../monetization/widgets/banner_ad_widget.dart';
import '../../quran/services/quran_audio_service.dart';
import '../../quran/providers/quran_providers.dart';
import '../../quran/widgets/quran_audio_player_bar.dart';
import '../data/verified_duas_data.dart';
import '../models/dua_model.dart';
import '../providers/dua_providers.dart';
import 'morning_evening_adhkar_screen.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/luxury_page_route.dart';

enum _DuaTab { categories, list, favorites }

/// Beyân - Dua Kütüphanesi Ekranı
/// 12 Kategorili Doğrulanmış Hadis ve Kur'an Duaları Külliyatı
class DuaLibraryScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const DuaLibraryScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<DuaLibraryScreen> createState() => _DuaLibraryScreenState();
}

class _DuaLibraryScreenState extends ConsumerState<DuaLibraryScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  _DuaTab _activeTab = _DuaTab.categories;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    final initialQuery = ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider).trim();
    if (initialQuery.isNotEmpty) {
      _searchController.text = initialQuery;
      _activeTab = _DuaTab.list;
    }
  }

  static const _popularPills = [
    ('Âyetü\'l-Kürsî', '✨'),
    ('Kevser', '🌊'),
    ('İhlâs', '💎'),
    ('Felak & Nâs', '🛡️'),
    ('Sübhaneke', '🤲'),
    ('Nazar Duası', '🧿'),
    ('İnşirah', '🕊️'),
    ('Âmentü', '⭐'),
    ('Kâfirûn', '📜'),
    ('Asr Suresi', '⏳'),
    ('Kadir Suresi', '🌙'),
    ('Şifa Duası', '🌿'),
    ('Rabbi Yessir', '📖'),
    ('Ezan Duası', '🕌'),
    ('Tahiyyat', '📿'),
    ('Kunut', '✨'),
    ('Bereket', '💰'),
    ('Fâtiha', '🌟'),
    ('Lev Enzelnâ', '📜'),
  ];

  void _onQuickPillTap(String term) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    if (_searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase() == term.toLowerCase()) {
      _searchController.clear();
      ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider.notifier).state = '';
    } else {
      _searchController.text = term;
      ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null;
      ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider.notifier).state = term;
      _activeTab = _DuaTab.list;
    }
    setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final selectedCategory = ref.watch(selectedDuaCategoryProvider);
    final duas = ref.watch(filteredDuasListProvider);
    final isSearching = _searchController.text.trim().isNotEmpty;
    final hasActiveAudio = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.currentSurahId != null));
    final bottomAudioPadding = hasActiveAudio ? 100.0 : 24.0;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          strings.duaLibraryTitle,
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 0.3),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.wb_sunny_outlined, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
            tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Sabah & Akşam Duaları' : 'Morning & Evening Adhkar',
            onPressed: () {
              HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
              Navigator.push(
                context,
                LuxuryPageRoute(page: const MorningEveningAdhkarScreen()),
              );
            },
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              selectedCategory == null ? Icons.filter_alt_outlined : Icons.filter_alt,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
            ),
            tooltip: strings.duaFilterTooltip,
            onPressed: () {
              HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
              if (selectedCategory != null) {
                ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null;
              } else {
                setState(() {
                  _activeTab = _DuaTab.categories;
                });
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          Column(
            children: [
              // ── Arama Çubuğu ──────────────────────────────────────────────
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 8),
                child: Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07201C) : Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
                      width: 1,
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.04),
                        blurRadius: 10,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                      fontSize: 14.5,
                    ),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: strings.duaSearchHint,
                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white38 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      ),
                      prefixIcon: Icon(
                        Icons.search_rounded,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        size: 22,
                      ),
                      suffixIcon: _searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                          ? IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18),
                              onPressed: () {
                                _searchController.clear();
                                ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider.notifier).state = '';
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            )
                          : null,
                      border: InputBorder.none,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (val) {
                      ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider.notifier).state = val;
                      if (val.trim().isNotEmpty && _activeTab != _DuaTab.list) {
                        _activeTab = _DuaTab.list;
                      }
                      setState(() {});
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              // ── Hızlı Popüler Dualar Çubuğu ──────────────────────────────
              SizedBox(
                height: 34,
                child: ListView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  children: _popularPills.map((pill) {
                    final isPillActive = _searchController.text.trim().toLowerCase() == pill.$1.toLowerCase();
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                      child: InkWell(
                        onTap: () => _onQuickPillTap(pill.$1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: isPillActive
                                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                                : (isDark
                                    ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F3A32).withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                                    : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE3EFEA)),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: isPillActive
                                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                                  : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
                              width: 1,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              Text(pill.$2, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11)),
                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                              Text(
                                pill.$1,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: isPillActive ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: isPillActive
                                      ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B)
                                      : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07453B)),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),

              // ── Görünüm Modu Değiştirici (Kategoriler / Tüm Dualar) ────────
              if (!isSearching)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 4),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06221D) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE9F3EE),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.2),
                        width: 1,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildSegmentButton(
                            label: '${strings.duaCategoriesTab} (12)',
                            icon: Icons.grid_view_rounded,
                            isActive: _activeTab == _DuaTab.categories && selectedCategory == null,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null;
                              setState(() {
                                _activeTab = _DuaTab.categories;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildSegmentButton(
                            label: '${strings.allDuasTab} (${verifiedDuasList.length})',
                            icon: Icons.format_list_bulleted_rounded,
                            isActive: _activeTab == _DuaTab.list || selectedCategory != null,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              setState(() {
                                _activeTab = _DuaTab.list;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildSegmentButton(
                            label: '${strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Favorilerim' : 'Favorites'} (${ref.watch(favoriteDuasProvider).length})',
                            icon: Icons.favorite_rounded,
                            isActive: _activeTab == _DuaTab.favorites,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null;
                              setState(() {
                                _activeTab = _DuaTab.favorites;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              // ── Kategori Çipleri (Yatay Kaydırma - Yalnızca Liste Modunda) ───
              if (_activeTab == _DuaTab.list || isSearching) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 42,
                  child: ListView(
                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                    children: [
                      _buildCategoryChip(
                        label: strings.allDuasWithCount(verifiedDuasList.length),
                        isSelected: selectedCategory == null,
                        onTap: () => ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null,
                        isDark: isDark,
                      ),
                      ...DuaCategory.values.map((cat) {
                        final count = verifiedDuasList.where((d) => d.category == cat).length;
                        return _buildCategoryChip(
                          label: '${cat.localizedName(strings.language.code)} ($count)',
                          isSelected: selectedCategory == cat,
                          onTap: () => ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = cat,
                          isDark: isDark,
                        );
                      }),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 6),

              // ── Ana İçerik Alanı ──────────────────────────────────────────
              Expanded(
                child: _buildMainContent(
                  strings: strings,
                  isDark: isDark,
                  selectedCategory: selectedCategory,
                  duas: duas,
                  isSearching: isSearching,
                  bottomPadding: bottomAudioPadding,
                ),
              ),

              // Alt banner reklam (Tilavet çubuğu açık değilken görünür)
              if (!hasActiveAudio)
                const BannerAdWidget(),
            ],
          ),

          // Alt Mini Tilavet Oynatıcısı
          const Positioned(
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            child: SafeArea(
              top: false,
              child: QuranAudioPlayerBar(),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSegmentButton({
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required bool isActive,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isActive
              ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F3E34) : Colors.white)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          boxShadow: isActive
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.06),
                    blurRadius: 6,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                  ),
                ]
              : null,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              size: 16,
              color: isActive
                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                  : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12.5,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
                color: isActive
                    ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B))
                    : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMainContent({
    required AppStrings strings,
    required bool isDark,
    required DuaCategory? selectedCategory,
    required List<DuaItem> duas,
    required bool isSearching,
    required double bottomPadding,
  }) {
    // 1. Favoriler Görünümü
    if (_activeTab == _DuaTab.favorites && !isSearching) {
      final favoriteDuas = duas.where((d) => d.isFavorite).toList();
      if (favoriteDuas.isEmpty) {
        return _buildFavoritesEmptyState(isDark: isDark, strings: strings);
      }
      return ListView.builder(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.viewport(2.0),
        addRepaintBoundaries: true,
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, bottomPadding),
        itemCount: favoriteDuas.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          return _DuaCardItem(dua: favoriteDuas[index], isDark: isDark);
        },
      );
    }

    // 2. Kategoriler Grid Görünümü (Arama yokken ve Kategoriler sekmesi aktifken)
    if (_activeTab == _DuaTab.categories && !isSearching && selectedCategory == null) {
      return _buildCategoriesGrid(
        isDark: isDark,
        strings: strings,
        bottomPadding: bottomPadding,
        onSelectCategory: (cat) {
          HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
          ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = cat;
          setState(() {
            _activeTab = _DuaTab.list;
          });
        },
      );
    }

    // 2. Arama sonucu boşsa
    if (duas.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(
              Icons.menu_book_rounded,
              size: 54,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              strings.noDuaFound,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 15,
                color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    // 3. Tek bir kategori filtrelenmiş durumdaysa
    if (selectedCategory != null && !isSearching) {
      return ListView(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.viewport(2.0),
        addRepaintBoundaries: true,
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, bottomPadding),
        children: [
          _buildSelectedCategoryBanner(
            category: selectedCategory,
            count: duas.length,
            isDark: isDark,
            strings: strings,
            onBackToCategories: () {
              HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
              ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = null;
              setState(() {
                _activeTab = _DuaTab.categories;
              });
            },
          ),
          ...duas.map((dua) => _DuaCardItem(dua: dua, isDark: isDark)),
        ],
      );
    }

    // 4. Arama yapılıyorsa (Düz arama sonuçları listesi)
    if (isSearching) {
      return ListView.builder(
        physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
        scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.viewport(2.0),
        addRepaintBoundaries: true,
        padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, bottomPadding),
        itemCount: duas.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          return _DuaCardItem(dua: duas[index], isDark: isDark);
        },
      );
    }

    // 5. Tüm Dualar Liste Görünümü (Kategorilere Göre Başlıklı & Gruplanmış)
    return ListView(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.viewport(2.0),
      addRepaintBoundaries: true,
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, bottomPadding),
      children: [
        for (final cat in DuaCategory.values) ...[
          Builder(
            builder: (context) {
              final catDuas = duas.where((d) => d.category == cat).toList();
              if (catDuas.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
              return Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  _buildCategorySectionHeader(
                    category: cat,
                    count: catDuas.length,
                    isDark: isDark,
                    strings: strings,
                    onFocusCategory: () {
                      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                      ref.read(selectedDuaCategoryProvider.notifier).state = cat;
                    },
                  ),
                  ...catDuas.map((dua) => _DuaCardItem(dua: dua, isDark: isDark)),
                ],
              );
            },
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoriesGrid({
    required bool isDark,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required double bottomPadding,
    required Function(DuaCategory) onSelectCategory,
  }) {
    return GridView.builder(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, bottomPadding),
      gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
        crossAxisCount: 2,
        crossAxisSpacing: 10,
        mainAxisSpacing: 10,
        childAspectRatio: 1.02,
      ),
      itemCount: DuaCategory.values.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final cat = DuaCategory.values[index];
        final count = verifiedDuasList.where((d) => d.category == cat).length;
        return Material(
          color: Colors.transparent,
          child: InkWell(
            onTap: () => onSelectCategory(cat),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  colors: isDark
                      ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF092922), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF051C17)]
                      : [Colors.white, BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF7FAF8)],
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
                  width: 1,
                ),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.04),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Container(
                        width: 36,
                        height: 36,
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.16),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                            width: 1,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Icon(
                          cat.icon,
                          size: 20,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 3),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        ),
                        child: Text(
                          strings.categoryDuaCount(count),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  Text(
                    cat.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
                      height: 1.2,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(
                    cat.localizedSubtitle(strings.language.code),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 10.5,
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                      height: 1.25,
                    ),
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategorySectionHeader({
    required DuaCategory category,
    required int count,
    required bool isDark,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required VoidCallback onFocusCategory,
  }) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 14, 0, 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: isDark
              ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D332B), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06221D)]
              : [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE4F0EB), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF2F8F5)],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 32,
            height: 32,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
              border: Border.all(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                width: 1,
              ),
            ),
            child: Icon(
              category.icon,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              size: 17,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        category.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                        ),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        strings.categoryDuaCount(count),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  category.localizedSubtitle(strings.language.code),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          InkWell(
            onTap: onFocusCategory,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    strings.language.code == 'tr' ? 'Tümü' : 'View',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 2),
                  Icon(
                    Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                    size: 11,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSelectedCategoryBanner({
    required DuaCategory category,
    required int count,
    required bool isDark,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required VoidCallback onBackToCategories,
  }) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 4, 0, 14),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: isDark
              ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D372E), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07241F)]
              : [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE3EFE9), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF3F8F5)],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(

        label: Text(label),
        selected: isSelected,
        onSelected: (_) {
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();

        labelStyle: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 12,

class _DuaCardItem extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DuaItem dua;
  final bool isDark;

  const _DuaCardItem({required this.dua, required this.isDark});

  void _copyDua(BuildContext context, AppStrings strings) {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    final text = '${dua.localizedTitle(strings.language.code)}\n\n'
        '${dua.arabicText}\n\n'
        '${strings.transliterationLabel}: ${dua.transliteration}\n\n'
        '${strings.meaningLabel}: ${dua.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code)}\n\n'
        '${strings.referenceLabel}: ${dua.localizedReference(strings.language.code)}\n\n'
        '${strings.appSignature}';
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 20),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(strings.duaCopied),
          ],
        ),
        backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final linked = _getLinkedSurah(dua);

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06221D) : Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
          width: 1,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.05),
            blurRadius: 12,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Üst Rozet & Başlık & Aksiyonlar
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                      width: 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        dua.category.icon,
                        size: 13,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 5),
                      Text(
                        dua.category.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                // Favori butonu
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(
                    dua.isFavorite ? Icons.favorite_rounded : Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                    color: dua.isFavorite ? Colors.redAccent : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black45),
                    size: 22,
                  ),
                  tooltip: dua.isFavorite ? strings.removeFromFavorites : strings.addToFavorites,
                  onPressed: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ref.read(favoriteDuasProvider.notifier).toggleFavorite(dua.id);
                  },
                ),
                if (linked != null)
                  Consumer(
                    builder: (context, ref, _) {
                      final isCurrent = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider.select((s) {
                        if (s.currentSurahId != linked.id) return false;
                        if (linked.fromVerse == null) return true;
                        final active = s.activeVerseNumber;
                        if (active == null) return false;
                        return active >= linked.fromVerse! &&
                            (linked.toVerse == null || active <= linked.toVerse!);
                      }));
                      final isPlaying = isCurrent && ref.watch(quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.isPlaying));
                      return Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          IconButton(
                            icon: Icon(
                              isPlaying
                                  ? Icons.pause_circle_filled_rounded
                                  : (isCurrent
                                      ? Icons.play_circle_filled_rounded
                                      : Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded),
                              color: isCurrent ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                              size: 24,
                            ),
                            tooltip: isPlaying
                                ? strings.pauseRecitation
                                : (isCurrent
                                    ? strings.resumeRecitation
                                    : strings.listenSurahRecitation(linked.nameTurkish)),
                            onPressed: () async {
                              HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                              final audio = ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier);
                              if (isCurrent) {
                                audio.togglePlayPause();
                              } else if (linked.isFullSurah) {
                                audio.playSurah(linked.id, linked.nameTurkish);
                              } else {
                                final verses = await ref.read(versesBySurahProvider(linked.id).future);
                                await audio.playVerseRange(
                                  verses,
                                  from: linked.fromVerse!,
                                  to: linked.toVerse ?? linked.fromVerse!,
                                  surahName: linked.nameTurkish,
                                );
                              }
                            },
                          ),
                          if (isCurrent)
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(
                                Icons.stop_circle_outlined,
                                color: Color(0xFFFF6B6B),
                                size: 22,
                              ),
                              tooltip: strings.stopRecitation,
                              onPressed: () {
                                HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                                ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).stop();
                              },
                            ),
                        ],
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                // Kopyala butonu
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(
                    Icons.copy_rounded,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    size: 20,
                  ),
                  tooltip: strings.copyAndShare,
                  onPressed: () => _copyDua(context, strings),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            // Başlık
            Text(
              dua.localizedTitle(strings.language.code),
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
                letterSpacing: 0.2,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Arapça Metin (Amiri Fontu, RTL)
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021B17) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF7FAF9),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                  width: 0.8,
                ),
              ),
              child: Text(
                dua.arabicText,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                  fontSize: 20,
                  height: 1.8,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Türkçe Okunuşu (Belirgin Sayfa Kartı Formatı)
            if (dua.transliteration.isNotEmpty) ...[
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark
                      ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0B2D26).withValues(alpha: 0.55)
                      : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF4F8F6),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.28 : 0.22),
                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Icon(
                          Icons.record_voice_over_rounded,
                          size: 13.5,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          strings.language.code == 'tr' ? 'Türkçe Okunuşu' : strings.transliterationLabel,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            letterSpacing: 0.3,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    SelectableText(
                      dua.transliteration,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14.5,
                        height: 1.6,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.95) : const Color(0xFF1E293B),
                        letterSpacing: 0.1,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
            ],

            // Anlamı (Meali)
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark
                    ? Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.22)
                    : const Color(0xFFFAFCFA),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black).withValues(alpha: 0.08),
                  width: 0.8,
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        Icons.translate_rounded,
                        size: 13.5,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(
                        strings.language.code == 'tr' ? 'Anlamı (Meali)' : strings.meaningLabel,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          letterSpacing: 0.3,
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  SelectableText(
                    dua.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      height: 1.55,
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.88) : const Color(0xFF334155),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            // Fazilet / Açıklama
            if (dua.virtueExplanation != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),

class _LinkedSurahInfo {
  final int id;
  final String nameTurkish;
  final int? fromVerse;
  final int? toVerse;
  const _LinkedSurahInfo(this.id, this.nameTurkish, {this.fromVerse, this.toVerse});

  bool get isFullSurah => fromVerse == null;
}

_LinkedSurahInfo? _getLinkedSurah(DuaItem dua) {
  switch (dua.id) {
    case 'kuran_fatiha':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(1, 'Fâtiha');
    case 'uyku_3': // Âyetü'l-Kürsî (Bakara 255)
    case 'kuran_ayetel_kursi':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(2, 'Bakara', fromVerse: 255, toVerse: 255);
    case 'aksam_3': // Âmenerresûlü (Bakara 285-286)
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(2, 'Bakara', fromVerse: 285, toVerse: 286);
    case 'kuran_1': // Rabbena Âtina (Bakara 201)
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(2, 'Bakara', fromVerse: 201, toVerse: 201);
    case 'kuran_2': // Âl-i İmrân 8
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(3, 'Âl-i İmrân', fromVerse: 8, toVerse: 8);
    case 'peygamber_5': // Âl-i İmrân 38
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(3, 'Âl-i İmrân', fromVerse: 38, toVerse: 38);
    case 'peygamber_3': // A'râf 23
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(7, 'A\'râf', fromVerse: 23, toVerse: 23);
    case 'peygamber_4': // Yûsuf 101
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(12, 'Yûsuf', fromVerse: 101, toVerse: 101);
    case 'kuran_3': // İbrâhîm 41
    case 'namaz_rabbena_agfirli':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(14, 'İbrâhîm', fromVerse: 41, toVerse: 41);
    case 'kuran_5': // İbrâhîm 40
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(14, 'İbrâhîm', fromVerse: 40, toVerse: 40);
    case 'kuran_6': // Tâhâ 114
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(20, 'Tâhâ', fromVerse: 114, toVerse: 114);
    case 'peygamber_1': // Tâhâ 25-28
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(20, 'Tâhâ', fromVerse: 25, toVerse: 28);
    case 'sikinti_1': // Enbiyâ 87 (Hz. Yûnus)
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(21, 'Enbiyâ', fromVerse: 87, toVerse: 87);
    case 'peygamber_2': // Enbiyâ 83 (Hz. Eyyûb)
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(21, 'Enbiyâ', fromVerse: 83, toVerse: 83);
    case 'kuran_4': // Furkân 74
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(25, 'Furkân', fromVerse: 74, toVerse: 74);
    case 'kuran_lev_enzelna': // Haşr 21-24
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(59, 'Haşr', fromVerse: 21, toVerse: 24);
    case 'kuran_duha':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(93, 'Duhâ');
    case 'kuran_insirah': // İnşirâh Suresi
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(94, 'İnşirâh');
    case 'kuran_kadr':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(97, 'Kadir');
    case 'kuran_asr':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(103, 'Asr');
    case 'kuran_fil':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(105, 'Fîl');
    case 'kuran_kureys':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(106, 'Kureyş');
    case 'kuran_maun':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(107, 'Mâûn');
    case 'kuran_kevser':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(108, 'Kevser');
    case 'kuran_kafirun':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(109, 'Kâfirûn');
    case 'kuran_nasr':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(110, 'Nasr');
    case 'kuran_tebbet':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(111, 'Tebbet');
    case 'kuran_ihlas':
    case 'aksam_4': // İhlâs, Felak, Nas
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(112, 'İhlâs');
    case 'kuran_felak':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(113, 'Felak');
    case 'kuran_nas':
      return const _LinkedSurahInfo(114, 'Nâs');
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';

import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../models/morning_evening_adhkar_model.dart';

/// Sabah & Akşam Duaları Eşlikçisi (Hısnu'l-Müslim Akışı)
class MorningEveningAdhkarScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final bool? initialIsMorning;

  const MorningEveningAdhkarScreen({super.key, this.initialIsMorning});

  @override
  ConsumerState<MorningEveningAdhkarScreen> createState() => _MorningEveningAdhkarScreenState();
}

class _MorningEveningAdhkarScreenState extends ConsumerState<MorningEveningAdhkarScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late bool _isMorning;
  int _currentIndex = 0;
  int _currentCount = 0;
  bool _isCompleted = false;
  bool _isTransitioning = false;

  late final AnimationController _shimmerController;
  late final Animation<double> _shimmerAnimation;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.initialIsMorning != null) {
      _isMorning = widget.initialIsMorning!;
    } else {
      final hour = DateTime.now().hour;
      _isMorning = hour >= 4 && hour < 15;
    }

    _shimmerController = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 800),
    );
    _shimmerAnimation = Tween<double>(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(
      CurvedAnimation(parent: _shimmerController, curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _shimmerController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  List<AdhkarItem> get _currentList {
    return verifiedMorningEveningAdhkar.where((item) {
      if (_isMorning) {
        return item.timeType == AdhkarTimeType.morning || item.timeType == AdhkarTimeType.both;
      } else {
        return item.timeType == AdhkarTimeType.evening || item.timeType == AdhkarTimeType.both;
      }
    }).toList();
  }

  void _onTapCounter() {
    if (_isTransitioning || _isCompleted) return;
    final list = _currentList;
    if (_currentIndex >= list.length) return;
    final item = list[_currentIndex];

    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();

    setState(() {
      _currentCount++;
      if (_currentCount >= item.targetCount) {
        // Hedef tamamlandı
        _isTransitioning = true;
        HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
        _shimmerController.forward(from: 0.0);

        Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 380), () {
          if (!mounted) return;
          if (_currentIndex < list.length - 1) {
            setState(() {
              _currentIndex++;
              _currentCount = 0;
              _isTransitioning = false;
            });
          } else {
            setState(() {
              _isCompleted = true;
              _isTransitioning = false;
            });
            HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
          }
        });
      }
    });
  }

  void _switchMode(bool isMorning) {
    if (_isMorning == isMorning) return;
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    setState(() {
      _isMorning = isMorning;
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _currentCount = 0;
      _isCompleted = false;
      _isTransitioning = false;
    });
  }

  void _nextDua() {
    final list = _currentList;
    if (_currentIndex < list.length - 1) {
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex++;
        _currentCount = 0;
        _isTransitioning = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _prevDua() {
    if (_currentIndex > 0) {
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
      setState(() {
        _currentIndex--;
        _currentCount = 0;
        _isTransitioning = false;
      });
    }
  }

  void _restart() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    setState(() {
      _currentIndex = 0;
      _currentCount = 0;
      _isCompleted = false;
      _isTransitioning = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final lang = strings.language.code;
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final list = _currentList;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021B16) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF3F7F5),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
              ? 'Hısnu\'l-Müslim Virdi'
              : (strings.language == AppLanguage.arabic ? 'أذكار الصباح والمساء' : 'Daily Adhkar Flow'),
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 17),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded),
            tooltip: strings.reset,
            onPressed: _restart,
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── Üst Sabah / Akşam Segment Seçici ──────────────────────
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 8, 20, 10),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF042B23) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE2EEEA),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: InkWell(
                        onTap: () => _switchMode(true),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 9),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _isMorning ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37) : Colors.transparent,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.wb_sunny_rounded,
                                size: 16,
                                color: _isMorning ? Colors.black87 : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Text(
                                strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Sabah Duaları' : 'Morning Adhkar',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  color: _isMorning ? Colors.black87 : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: InkWell(
                        onTap: () => _switchMode(false),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        child: AnimatedContainer(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 9),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: !_isMorning ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37) : Colors.transparent,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                            children: [
                              Icon(
                                Icons.nightlight_round,
                                size: 16,
                                color: !_isMorning ? Colors.black87 : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Text(
                                strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Akşam Duaları' : 'Evening Adhkar',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  color: !_isMorning ? Colors.black87 : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // ── Story Tarzı İlerleme Çubukları ─────────────────────────
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 4),
              child: Row(
                children: List.generate(list.length, (idx) {
                  final isDone = idx < _currentIndex || _isCompleted;
                  final isCurrent = idx == _currentIndex && !_isCompleted;
                  return Expanded(
                    child: Container(
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
                      height: 4,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isDone
                            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                            : (isCurrent
                                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.8)
                                : (isDark ? Colors.white12 : Colors.black12)),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // ── Ana İçerik Kartı ─────────────────────────────────────
            Expanded(
              child: _isCompleted
                  ? _buildCompletionState(strings, isDark)
                  : _buildAdhkarContent(list[_currentIndex], strings, isDark, lang),
            ),

            // ── Alt Sayaç & Gezinme Barı ──────────────────────────────
            if (!_isCompleted) _buildBottomControls(list[_currentIndex], strings, isDark),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAdhkarContent(AdhkarItem item, AppStrings strings, bool isDark, String lang) {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 6),
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF04261F) : Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          border: Border.all(
            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.4 : 0.25),
            width: 1.2,
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.06),
              blurRadius: 18,
              offset: const Offset(0, 6),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            // Üst Başlık & Kaynak
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    item.localizedTitle(lang),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      letterSpacing: 0.2,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    '${_currentIndex + 1} / ${_currentList.length}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 18),

            // Arapça Metin
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021B16) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF7FAF9),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              ),
              child: Text(
                item.arabicText,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                  fontSize: 22,
                  height: 2.1,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                ),
                textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Okunuş (Transliterasyon)
            Text(
              item.transliteration,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13.5,
                height: 1.5,
                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF80CBC4) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0A685A),
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Divider(color: isDark ? Colors.white12 : Colors.black12, thickness: 0.8),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),

            // Meal
            Text(
              item.localizedMeaning(lang),
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14,
                height: 1.55,
                color: isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.9) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF1E2E2B),
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 14),

            // Fazilet ve Hadis Kutusu
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06332A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFEBF4F1),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                  width: 0.8,
                ),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.stars_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(
                        strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Manevi Mükafatı' : 'Virtue & Blessing',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 12,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      Text(
                        item.source,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    item.localizedVirtue(lang),
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      height: 1.45,
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF23443E),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBottomControls(AdhkarItem item, AppStrings strings, bool isDark) {
    final progress = item.targetCount > 0 ? (_currentCount / item.targetCount).clamp(0.0, 1.0) : 1.0;

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 6, 20, 16),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          // Önceki
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_new_rounded, size: 20),
            tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Önceki' : 'Previous',
            onPressed: _currentIndex > 0 ? _prevDua : null,
          ),

          const SizedBox(width: 8),

          // ── Merkez Lüks Dokunma Butonu ──────────────────────
          Expanded(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: _onTapCounter,
              child: AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: _shimmerAnimation,
                builder: (context, _) {
                  return Container(
                    height: 64,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: RadialGradient(
                        colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF04584C), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B)],
                        radius: 0.9,
                      ),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        width: 1.6,
                      ),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                          blurRadius: 16,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Stack(
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      children: [
                        // İlerleme Doldurması
                        Positioned(
                          left: 0,
                          top: 0,
                          bottom: 0,
                          width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.65 * progress,
                          child: Container(
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),

                        // Altın Işık Süzülmesi
                        if (_shimmerController.isAnimating)
                          Positioned.fill(
                            child: ClipRRect(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                              child: Transform.rotate(
                                angle: _shimmerAnimation.value * math.pi,
                                child: Container(
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                                      colors: [
                                        Colors.transparent,
                                        BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                                        Colors.transparent,
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),

                        // Sayaç Metni
                        Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Icon(Icons.touch_app_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 22),
                            const SizedBox(width: 10),
                            Text(
                              '$_currentCount / ${item.targetCount}',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 21,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: Colors.white,
                                letterSpacing: 1.2,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Text(
                              strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Dokun' : 'Tap',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),

          const SizedBox(width: 8),

          // Sonraki
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 20),
            tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Sonraki' : 'Next',
            onPressed: _currentIndex < _currentList.length - 1 ? _nextDua : null,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCompletionState(AppStrings strings, bool isDark) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 90,
              height: 90,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                gradient: RadialGradient(
                  colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)],
                ),
              ),
              child: Icon(Icons.check_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B), size: 52),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),
            Text(
              strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                  ? 'Elhamdülillâh!\nVirdiniz Tamamlandı'
                  : 'Alhamdulillah!\nAdhkar Completed',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                height: 1.35,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
              strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                  ? 'Gününüz ilahi muhafaza, huzur ve bereketle dolsun. Allah kabul eylesin.'
                  : 'May your day be blessed with divine protection and tranquility.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14,
                color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                height: 1.5,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 28),
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
              label: Text(strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Ana Sayfaya Dön' : 'Return Home'),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 12),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

@immutable
class QuizQuestion {
  final String questionText;
  final String? audioTarget;
  final String arabicPrompt;
  final List<String> options;
  final int correctOptionIndex;
  final String explanation;
  final bool autoPlayAudio;

  const QuizQuestion({
    required this.questionText,
    this.audioTarget,
    required this.arabicPrompt,
    required this.options,
    required this.correctOptionIndex,
    required this.explanation,
    this.autoPlayAudio = false,
  });
}

@immutable
class ElifBaLesson {
  final String id;
  final int levelNumber;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;
  final String iconName;
  final bool isPremiumOnly;
  final int xpReward;
  final List<QuizQuestion> questions;

  const ElifBaLesson({
    required this.id,
    required this.levelNumber,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
    required this.iconName,
    required this.isPremiumOnly,
    required this.xpReward,
    required this.questions,
  });
}
