## Dosya: lib/features/elif_ba/screens/elif_ba_hub_screen.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../models/elif_ba_lesson.dart';
import '../models/elif_ba_letter.dart';
import '../services/elif_ba_progress_service.dart';
import '../services/elif_ba_audio_service.dart';
import 'elif_ba_lesson_quiz_screen.dart';

class ElifBaHubScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ElifBaHubScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ElifBaHubScreen> createState() => _ElifBaHubScreenState();
}

class _ElifBaHubScreenState extends ConsumerState<ElifBaHubScreen> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late TabController _tabController;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: 2, vsync: this);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ElifBaAudioService().stop();
    _tabController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _showLetterDetail(BuildContext context, ElifBaLetter letter, bool isDark) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    ElifBaAudioService().playLetter(letter.id);

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF022B24) : Colors.white,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) {
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 20, 24, 28),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                // Drag handle
                Container(
                  width: 40,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white24,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Large Letter Display (Tap to speak)
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ElifBaAudioService().playLetter(letter.id);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(45),
                  child: Container(
                    width: 90,
                    height: 90,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: RadialGradient(
                        colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFB8860B)],
                      ),
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                          blurRadius: 14,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Stack(
                      alignment: Alignment.center,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          letter.arabic,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                            fontSize: 52,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Positioned(
                          right: 8,
                          bottom: 8,
                          child: Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, size: 16, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B)),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Letter Name & Phonetic with Speaker Button
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      '${letter.nameTr}  (${letter.nameEn})',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 24),
                      tooltip: 'Sesli Dinle',
                      onPressed: () {
                        HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                        ElifBaAudioService().playLetter(letter.id);
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text(
                  'Telaffuz: "${letter.phonetic}"',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // 4 Yazılış Formu (Yalın, Başta, Ortada, Sonda - Her biri tıklanınca seslendirir)
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF063B32) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF1F8F5),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
                    children: [
                      _buildFormItem('Yalın', letter.isolated, letter.id),
                      _buildFormItem('Başta', letter.initial, letter.id),
                      _buildFormItem('Ortada', letter.medial, letter.id),
                      _buildFormItem('Sonda', letter.finalForm, letter.id),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Mahreç Bilgisi
                Container(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF03221C) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE8F6F0),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.mic_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Text(
                            'Mahreç (Çıkış Yeri):',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        letter.mahraj,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                          height: 1.35,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Kur'an'dan Örnek Kelime (Tıklanınca kelimeyi seslendirir)
                InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ElifBaAudioService().speakArabic(letter.exampleWord);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        const Text('Örnek Kelime: ', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 13)),
                        Text(
                          letter.exampleWord,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                            fontSize: 22,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, size: 16, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text('(${letter.exampleMeaning})', style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 13)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFormItem(String label, String form, int letterId) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
        ElifBaAudioService().playLetter(letterId);
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 4),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Text(
              form,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                fontSize: 26,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(
              label,
              style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _onLessonTap(ElifBaLesson lesson, bool isUnlocked) {
    if (!isUnlocked) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Lütfen önceki dersi tamamlayın.'),
          duration: Duration(seconds: 1),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => ElifBaLessonQuizScreen(lesson: lesson)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final progress = ref.watch(elifBaProgressProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021B16) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF4F8F6),
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012720) : AppColors.teal,
        elevation: 0,
        title: const Text(
          'Sesli Elif-Bâ & Dua Eğitimi',
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.white),
        ),
        actions: [
          // XP Badge
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Text(
                  '${progress.totalXp} XP',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),

          // Streak Badge
          Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 8),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.orange.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(color: Colors.orangeAccent),
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.local_fire_department_rounded, color: Colors.orangeAccent, size: 16),
                const SizedBox(width: 2),
                Text(
                  '${progress.streakDays}',
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.orangeAccent,
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
        bottom: TabBar(
          controller: _tabController,
          indicatorColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
          indicatorWeight: 3,
          labelColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
          unselectedLabelColor: Colors.white60,
          tabs: const [
            Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.alt_route_rounded), text: 'Öğrenim Haritası'),
            Tab(icon: Icon(Icons.grid_view_rounded), text: '28 Harf & Mahreç'),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      body: TabBarView(
        controller: _tabController,
        children: [
          // ── 1. Tab: Duolingo Stili İlerleme Haritası ───────
          _buildRoadmap(isDark, progress),

          // ── 2. Tab: 28 Harf ve Mahreç Tablosu ─────────────
          _buildLetterGrid(isDark),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRoadmap(bool isDark, ElifBaProgressState progress) {
    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 24),
      itemCount: elifBaLessonsList.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final lesson = elifBaLessonsList[index];
        final isCompleted = progress.completedLessonIds.contains(lesson.id);
        final isPreviousCompleted = index == 0 || progress.completedLessonIds.contains(elifBaLessonsList[index - 1].id);
        final isUnlocked = isPreviousCompleted;

        return Column(
          children: [
            // Roadmap Node Card
            InkWell(
              onTap: () => _onLessonTap(lesson, isUnlocked),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    colors: isCompleted
                        ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F4D3F), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF09362C)]
                        : (isUnlocked
                            ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF135A4A), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0A3D32)]
                            : [isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07241E) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE5EDE9), isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF041814) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD6E2DD)]),
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: isCompleted
                        ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                        : (isUnlocked
                            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
                            : (isDark ? Colors.white12 : Colors.black12)),
                    width: isUnlocked || isCompleted ? 1.8 : 1,
                  ),
                  boxShadow: isUnlocked
                      ? [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                            blurRadius: 10,
                            spreadRadius: 1,
                          ),
                        ]
                      : null,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    // Node Avatar
                    Container(
                      width: 52,
                      height: 52,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isCompleted
                            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                            : (isUnlocked
                                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.25)
                                : Colors.black26),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: isCompleted ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                          width: 1.5,
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Center(
                        child: Icon(
                          isCompleted
                              ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                              : (isUnlocked
                                  ? Icons.play_arrow_rounded
                                  : Icons.lock_outline_rounded),
                          color: isCompleted
                              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B)
                              : (isUnlocked ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white38),
                          size: 28,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 16),

                    // Lesson Info
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            lesson.title,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 16,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: isUnlocked || isCompleted ? Colors.white : Colors.white38,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            lesson.subtitle,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: isUnlocked || isCompleted ? Colors.white70 : Colors.white30,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 6),
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 14, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                              const SizedBox(width: 2),
                              Text(
                                '+${lesson.xpReward} XP',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 12),
                              Text(
                                '${lesson.questions.length} Soru',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: isUnlocked || isCompleted ? Colors.white60 : Colors.white24,
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    Icon(
                      Icons.chevron_right_rounded,
                      color: isUnlocked || isCompleted ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white24,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),

            // Connecting line to next node
            if (index < elifBaLessonsList.length - 1)
              Container(
                width: 3,
                height: 28,
                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isCompleted
                      ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                      : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0B3F34) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD0DDD8)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLetterGrid(bool isDark) {
    return GridView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(
        crossAxisCount: 4,
        crossAxisSpacing: 10,
        mainAxisSpacing: 10,
        childAspectRatio: 0.85,
      ),
      itemCount: elifBaLettersList.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final letter = elifBaLettersList[index];
        return InkWell(
          onTap: () => _showLetterDetail(context, letter, isDark),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06332A) : Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                width: 1.2,
              ),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                  blurRadius: 6,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: Stack(
              children: [
                Positioned(
                  top: 6,
                  right: 6,
                  child: Icon(
                    Icons.volume_up_rounded,
                    size: 13,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                  ),
                ),
                Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        letter.arabic,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                          fontSize: 34,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        letter.nameTr,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        letter.phonetic,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: Colors.white54,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/elif_ba/screens/elif_ba_lesson_quiz_screen.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../models/elif_ba_lesson.dart';
import '../services/elif_ba_progress_service.dart';
import '../services/elif_ba_audio_service.dart';

class ElifBaLessonQuizScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final ElifBaLesson lesson;

  const ElifBaLessonQuizScreen({super.key, required this.lesson});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ElifBaLessonQuizScreen> createState() => _ElifBaLessonQuizScreenState();
}

class _ElifBaLessonQuizScreenState extends ConsumerState<ElifBaLessonQuizScreen> {
  int _currentQuestionIndex = 0;
  int? _selectedOptionIndex;
  bool _hasAnswered = false;
  int _correctAnswersCount = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      final question = widget.lesson.questions[_currentQuestionIndex];
      if (question.autoPlayAudio) {
        _speakCurrentPrompt();
      }
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    ElifBaAudioService().stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _speakCurrentPrompt() {
    final question = widget.lesson.questions[_currentQuestionIndex];
    final target = (question.audioTarget != null && question.audioTarget!.isNotEmpty)
        ? question.audioTarget!
        : question.arabicPrompt;
    if (target.isNotEmpty) {
      ElifBaAudioService().speakArabic(target);
    }
  }

  void _handleOptionSelect(int index) {
    if (_hasAnswered) return;

    final question = widget.lesson.questions[_currentQuestionIndex];
    final isCorrect = index == question.correctOptionIndex;
    final selectedOpt = question.options[index];

    // Doğru ya da seçilen soru harfini hoca sesiyle dinlet
    final target = (question.audioTarget != null && question.audioTarget!.isNotEmpty)
        ? question.audioTarget!
        : question.arabicPrompt;
    if (target.isNotEmpty) {
      ElifBaAudioService().speakArabic(target);
    } else if (RegExp(r'[\u0600-\u06FF]').hasMatch(selectedOpt)) {
      ElifBaAudioService().speakArabic(selectedOpt);
    }

    setState(() {
      _selectedOptionIndex = index;
      _hasAnswered = true;
      if (isCorrect) {
        _correctAnswersCount++;
      }
    });

    if (isCorrect) {
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    } else {
      HapticFeedback.heavyImpact();
    }
  }

  void _nextQuestion() {
    if (_currentQuestionIndex + 1 < widget.lesson.questions.length) {
      setState(() {
        _currentQuestionIndex++;
        _selectedOptionIndex = null;
        _hasAnswered = false;
      });
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        final nextQuestion = widget.lesson.questions[_currentQuestionIndex];
        if (nextQuestion.autoPlayAudio) {
          _speakCurrentPrompt();
        }
      });
    } else {
      _finishQuiz();
    }
  }

  void _finishQuiz() {
    ref.read(elifBaProgressProvider.notifier).completeLesson(
          widget.lesson.id,
          widget.lesson.xpReward,
        );

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF022B24),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
          side: BorderSide(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), width: 1.5),
        ),
        title: Column(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.workspace_premium_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 48),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Text(
              'Tebrikler! Ders Tamamlandı',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                fontSize: 20,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Text(
              '${widget.lesson.questions.length} sorudan $_correctAnswersCount tanesini doğru bildiniz.',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 14),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
              ),
              child: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 22),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Text(
                    '+${widget.lesson.xpReward} XP Kazanıldı!',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      fontSize: 16,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          Center(
            child: ElevatedButton(
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 12),
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(ctx); // Dialogu kapat
                Navigator.pop(context); // Hub ekranına dön
              },
              child: const Text('Devam Et', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16)),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final totalQuestions = widget.lesson.questions.length;
    final question = widget.lesson.questions[_currentQuestionIndex];
    final isCorrect = _selectedOptionIndex == question.correctOptionIndex;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF6FAF8),
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B) : AppColors.teal,
        elevation: 0,
        leading: IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white),
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
        ),
        title: Text(
          widget.lesson.title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.white),
        ),
        bottom: PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(6),
          child: LinearProgressIndicator(
            value: (_currentQuestionIndex + (_hasAnswered ? 1 : 0)) / totalQuestions,
            backgroundColor: Colors.white24,
            valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // Progress badge
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Soru ${_currentQuestionIndex + 1} / $totalQuestions',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text(
                          '${widget.lesson.xpReward} XP',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                            fontSize: 12,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              // Question Title
              Text(
                question.questionText,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                  height: 1.3,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),

              // Large Arabic Prompt Card (Cevaplandıktan sonra dinlemeye açılır, kopyayı önler)
              InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  if (!_hasAnswered) {
                    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).clearSnackBars();
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text('Cevabı işaretledikten sonra doğru telaffuzu dinleyebilirsiniz.'),
                        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 1400),
                        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }
                  HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                  _speakCurrentPrompt();
                },
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                child: Container(
                  height: 120,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      colors: isDark
                          ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF04332B), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07241E)]
                          : [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE8F5F1), Colors.white],
                      begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                      end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                      width: 1.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Stack(
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Center(
                        child: Text(
                          question.arabicPrompt,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                            fontSize: 54,
                            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Positioned(
                        right: 12,
                        top: 12,
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _hasAnswered
                                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.25)
                                : Colors.white12,
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                          ),
                          child: Icon(
                            _hasAnswered ? Icons.volume_up_rounded : Icons.volume_off_rounded,
                            size: 16,
                            color: _hasAnswered ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white38,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // Options
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.separated(
                  itemCount: question.options.length,
                  separatorBuilder: (_, __) => const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final opt = question.options[index];
                    final isSelected = _selectedOptionIndex == index;
                    final isOptionCorrect = index == question.correctOptionIndex;

                    Color cardBorderColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D3830) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE2EBE8);
                    Color cardBgColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF062B24) : Colors.white;

                    if (_hasAnswered) {
                      if (isOptionCorrect) {
                        cardBorderColor = Colors.greenAccent;
                        cardBgColor = Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.15);
                      } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
                        cardBorderColor = Colors.redAccent;
                        cardBgColor = Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.15);
                      }
                    } else if (isSelected) {
                      cardBorderColor = BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A);
                    }

                    return InkWell(
                      onTap: () => _handleOptionSelect(index),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: cardBgColor,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                          border: Border.all(
                            color: cardBorderColor,
                            width: isSelected || (_hasAnswered && isOptionCorrect) ? 2 : 1,
                          ),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              width: 32,
                              height: 32,
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F3E34) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE2EBE8),
                              ),
                              child: Center(
                                child: Text(
                                  String.fromCharCode(65 + index), // A, B, C, D
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.teal,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 14),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                opt,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (_hasAnswered && isOptionCorrect)
                              const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: Colors.greenAccent),
                            if (_hasAnswered && isSelected && !isCorrect)
                              const Icon(Icons.cancel_rounded, color: Colors.redAccent),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),

              // Feedback & Next Button
              if (_hasAnswered) ...[
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isCorrect
                        ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
                        : Colors.orange.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: isCorrect ? Colors.greenAccent : Colors.orangeAccent,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    children: [
                      Icon(
                        isCorrect ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                        color: isCorrect ? Colors.greenAccent : Colors.orangeAccent,
                        size: 22,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          question.explanation,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13,
                            color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      IconButton(
                        icon: Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 22),
                        tooltip: 'Tekrar Dinle',
                        onPressed: () {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          _speakCurrentPrompt();
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16)),
                  ),
                  onPressed: _nextQuestion,
                  child: Text(
                    _currentQuestionIndex + 1 < totalQuestions ? 'Sonraki Soru →' : 'Sonucu Gör ✨',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/elif_ba/services/elif_ba_audio_service.dart

`dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:audioplayers/audioplayers.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_tts/flutter_tts.dart';
import '../models/elif_ba_letter.dart';

/// Elif-Bâ Ses Servisi
/// 28 temel Arapça harf için yüksek kaliteli, gerçek hoca/kāri tilaveti (MP3) çalar.
/// Çevrimdışı çalışır, sıfır gecikmelidir ve cihazın sistem dil paketine bağımlı değildir.
/// Çok heceli dualar ve cümleler için FlutterTts desteğini yedek olarak kullanır.
class ElifBaAudioService {
  static final ElifBaAudioService _instance = ElifBaAudioService._internal();
  factory ElifBaAudioService() => _instance;

  ElifBaAudioService._internal() {
    _initAudio();
  }

  final AudioPlayer _audioPlayer = AudioPlayer();
  final FlutterTts _flutterTts = FlutterTts();
  bool _isTtsInitialized = false;
  bool _isPlaying = false;

  bool get isPlaying => _isPlaying;

  // Harf ID -> Arapça Temel Karakter
  static const Map<String, int> _arabicToLetterId = {
    'ا': 1, 'أ': 1, 'إ': 1, 'آ': 1, 'ٱ': 1,
    'ب': 2,
    'ت': 3, 'ة': 3,
    'ث': 4,
    'ج': 5,
    'ح': 6,
    'خ': 7,
    'د': 8,
    'ذ': 9,
    'ر': 10,
    'ز': 11,
    'س': 12,
    'ش': 13,
    'ص': 14,
    'ض': 15,
    'ط': 16,
    'ظ': 17,
    'ع': 18,
    'غ': 19,
    'ف': 20,
    'ق': 21,
    'ك': 22,
    'ل': 23,
    'م': 24,
    'ن': 25,
    'و': 26,
    'ه': 27,
    'ي': 28, 'ى': 28,
  };

  static const Map<String, int> _nameToLetterId = {
    'elif': 1, 'alif': 1,
    'be': 2, 'baa': 2,
    'te': 3, 'taa': 3,
    'se': 4, 'thaa': 4, 'se (peltek)': 4,
    'cim': 5, 'jeem': 5,
    'ha': 6, 'haa': 6, 'ha (boğaz)': 6,
    'hı': 7, 'khaa': 7, 'hı (hırıltılı)': 7,
    'dal': 8, 'daal': 8,
    'zel': 9, 'zaal': 9, 'zel (peltek)': 9,
    'ra': 10, 'raa': 10,
    'ze': 11, 'zaay': 11, 'ze (keskin)': 11,
    'sin': 12, 'seen': 12,
    'şın': 13, 'sheen': 13,
    'sad': 14, 'saad': 14, 'sad (kalın)': 14,
    'dad': 15, 'daad': 15,
    'tı': 16, 'taah': 16, 'tı (kalın)': 16,
    'zı': 17, 'zhaa': 17, 'zı (kalın peltek)': 17,
    'ayn': 18, 'ain': 18,
    'gayn': 19, 'ghayn': 19,
    'fe': 20, 'faa': 20,
    'kaf': 21, 'qaaf': 21, 'kaf (kalın)': 21,
    'kef': 22, 'kaaf': 22, 'kef (ince)': 22,
    'lam': 23, 'laam': 23,
    'mim': 24, 'meem': 24,
    'nun': 25, 'noon': 25,
    'vav': 26, 'waaw': 26, 'waw': 26,
    'he': 27, 'he (göğüs)': 27, 'haah': 27,
    'ye': 28, 'yaa': 28,
  };

  Future<void> _initAudio() async {
    try {
      await _audioPlayer.setAudioContext(
        AudioContext(
          iOS: AudioContextIOS(
            category: AVAudioSessionCategory.playback,
            options: const {AVAudioSessionOptions.mixWithOthers},
          ),
          android: const AudioContextAndroid(
            isSpeakerphoneOn: false,
            stayAwake: false,
            contentType: AndroidContentType.music,
            usageType: AndroidUsageType.media,
            audioFocus: AndroidAudioFocus.gainTransientMayDuck,
          ),
        ),
      );

      _audioPlayer.onPlayerStateChanged.listen((state) {
        _isPlaying = (state == PlayerState.playing);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[ElifBaAudioService] AudioContext init hatası: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _initTts() async {
    if (_isTtsInitialized) return;
    try {
      await _flutterTts.setLanguage('ar-SA');
      await _flutterTts.setSpeechRate(0.38);
      await _flutterTts.setPitch(1.05);
      await _flutterTts.setVolume(1.0);

      _flutterTts.setStartHandler(() {
        _isPlaying = true;
      });

      _flutterTts.setCompletionHandler(() {
        _isPlaying = false;
      });

      _flutterTts.setErrorHandler((_) {
        _isPlaying = false;
      });

      _isTtsInitialized = true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[ElifBaAudioService] TTS init hatası: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Harf ID'si (1 - 28) ile gerçek hoca sesini anında çalar.
  Future<void> playLetter(int letterId) async {
    if (letterId < 1 || letterId > 28) return;
    try {
      await stop();
      final assetPath = 'audio/letters/letter_$letterId.mp3';
      await _audioPlayer.play(AssetSource(assetPath));
      _isPlaying = true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[ElifBaAudioService] playLetter ($letterId) hatası: $e, TTS yedeği devreye alınıyor.');
      try {
        final letter = elifBaLettersList.firstWhere(
          (l) => l.id == letterId,
          orElse: () => elifBaLettersList.first,
        );
        await _speakWithTts(letter.arabic);
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  /// Harf, hareke veya kelimeyi seslendirir.
  /// Tek harf veya harf formu ise gerçek hoca MP3 tilaveti çalar.
  Future<void> speakArabic(String text) async {
    final clean = text.trim();
    if (clean.isEmpty) return;

    // Sayısal ID geldiyse doğrudan harfi çal
    final numeric = int.tryParse(clean.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), ''));
    if (numeric != null && numeric >= 1 && numeric <= 28) {
      await playLetter(numeric);
      return;
    }

    // Harf veya harf formu kontrolü
    final letterId = _resolveLetterId(clean);
    if (letterId != null) {
      await playLetter(letterId);
      return;
    }

    // Çok harfli veya hareke içeren özel kelimeler için TTS yedeği
    await _speakWithTts(clean);
  }

  /// Fonetik telaffuz çağrısı
  Future<void> speakPhonetic(String text) async {
    await speakArabic(text);
  }

  int? _resolveLetterId(String input) {
    // 1. İsim eşleşmesi (Türkçe/İngilizce)
    final lower = input.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (_nameToLetterId.containsKey(lower)) {
      return _nameToLetterId[lower];
    }

    // 2. Uzatma/keşide (ـ) ve harekeleri temizle
    final stripped = input
        .replaceAll('ـ', '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]'), '')
        .trim();

    if (_arabicToLetterId.containsKey(stripped)) {
      return _arabicToLetterId[stripped];
    }

    // 3. Tek harf içeriyorsa harfi tespit et
    if (stripped.length == 1 && _arabicToLetterId.containsKey(stripped)) {
      return _arabicToLetterId[stripped];
    }

    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _speakWithTts(String arabicText) async {
    try {
      await stop();
      await _initTts();
      await _flutterTts.speak(arabicText);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('[ElifBaAudioService] TTS speak hatası: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> stop() async {
    try {
      await _audioPlayer.stop();
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await _flutterTts.stop();
    } catch (_) {}
    _isPlaying = false;
  }
}

`dart
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class ElifBaProgressState {
  final int totalXp;
  final int streakDays;
  final Set<String> completedLessonIds;

  const ElifBaProgressState({
    this.totalXp = 0,
    this.streakDays = 1,
    this.completedLessonIds = const {},
  });

  ElifBaProgressState copyWith({
    int? totalXp,
    int? streakDays,
    Set<String>? completedLessonIds,
  }) {
    return ElifBaProgressState(
      totalXp: totalXp ?? this.totalXp,
      streakDays: streakDays ?? this.streakDays,
      completedLessonIds: completedLessonIds ?? this.completedLessonIds,
    );
  }
}

class ElifBaProgressNotifier extends StateNotifier<ElifBaProgressState> {
  static const String _keyXp = 'elif_ba_total_xp';
  static const String _keyStreak = 'elif_ba_streak_days';
  static const String _keyCompleted = 'elif_ba_completed_lessons';

  ElifBaProgressNotifier() : super(const ElifBaProgressState()) {
    _loadState();
  }

  Future<void> _loadState() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final xp = prefs.getInt(_keyXp) ?? 0;
      final streak = prefs.getInt(_keyStreak) ?? 1;
      final completed = prefs.getStringList(_keyCompleted)?.toSet() ?? {};

      state = ElifBaProgressState(
        totalXp: xp,
        streakDays: streak,
        completedLessonIds: completed,
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> completeLesson(String lessonId, int earnedXp) async {
    try {
      final updatedCompleted = Set<String>.from(state.completedLessonIds)..add(lessonId);
      final updatedXp = state.totalXp + earnedXp;

      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setInt(_keyXp, updatedXp);
      await prefs.setStringList(_keyCompleted, updatedCompleted.toList());

      state = state.copyWith(
        totalXp: updatedXp,
        completedLessonIds: updatedCompleted,
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

final elifBaProgressProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<ElifBaProgressNotifier, ElifBaProgressState>((ref) {
  return ElifBaProgressNotifier();
});

`dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/theme_provider.dart';
import '../../prayer_times/models/prayer_time_model.dart';

/// Tüm uygulamanın ve ana ekranın namaz vaktine göre tek bir bütün olarak
/// (alt bar ve diğer sekmelerle %100 aynı renk uzayında) değişmesini sağlayan atmosfer modeli.
class DynamicPrayerAtmosphere {
  final List<Color> backgroundGradient;
  final List<Color> cardGradient;
  final Color appBarColor;
  final Color accentGold;
  final Color glowColor;
  final Color cardBorder;
  final Color actionCardBg;
  final Color actionCardBorder;

  const DynamicPrayerAtmosphere({
    required this.backgroundGradient,
    required this.cardGradient,
    required this.appBarColor,
    required this.accentGold,
    required this.glowColor,
    required this.cardBorder,
    required this.actionCardBg,
    required this.actionCardBorder,
  });

  static DynamicPrayerAtmosphere forPrayer(PrayerName? prayer) {
    final palette = ThemeNotifier.paletteForPrayer(
      prayer,
      fallback: BeyanColors.palette,
    );
    Color t(int argb) => BeyanColors.toneFor(palette, argb);

    return DynamicPrayerAtmosphere(
      backgroundGradient: [
        palette.darkBackground,
        t(0xFF0A221E),
        t(0xFF041210),
      ],
      cardGradient: palette.prayerCardGradient,
      appBarColor: palette.darkSurface,
      accentGold: palette.accentGoldLight,
      glowColor: palette.prayerCardGlow,
      cardBorder: palette.accentGold,
      actionCardBg: palette.darkSurface,
      actionCardBorder: t(0xFF133B34),
    );
  }
}

/// Ana Ekran – Beyân lüks İslami kontrol merkezi.
class HomeScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends ConsumerState<HomeScreen> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final themeState = ref.watch(themeProvider);
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final prayerAsync = ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider);
    final lastRead = ref.watch(lastReadProvider);
    final allSurahs = ref.watch(allSurahsProvider).valueOrNull ?? [];
    final nextReligiousDay = HijriCalendarService.instance.getNextReligiousDay();
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final isFriday = DateTime.now().weekday == DateTime.friday;

    final nextPrayer = prayerAsync.valueOrNull?.nextPrayerEntry?.name;
    final atmosphere = (themeState.isDynamicPrayerTheme && isDark)
        ? DynamicPrayerAtmosphere.forPrayer(nextPrayer)
        : null;

    final scaffoldBg = isDark ? effectivePalette.darkBackground : effectivePalette.lightBackground;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: scaffoldBg,
      body: Container(
        decoration: atmosphere != null
            ? BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  colors: atmosphere.backgroundGradient,
                  begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                  end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                ),
              )
            : null,
        child: CustomScrollView(
          physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
          slivers: [
            // ── Lüks İslami AppBar ────────────────────────────────
            _IslamicAppBar(atmosphere: atmosphere),

            // ── Cuma Tebriği & Kehf Sûresi Sünneti Kartı ────────────
            if (isFriday)
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: _FridayKahfBanner(
                  allSurahs: allSurahs,
                  atmosphere: atmosphere,
                ),
              ),

            // ── Yaklaşan Dini Gün / Kandil Bildirimi ────────────────
            if (nextReligiousDay != null)
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: _UpcomingReligiousDayBanner(
                  day: nextReligiousDay,
                  atmosphere: atmosphere,
                ),
              ),

            // ── Namaz Vakti Kartı (Zümrüt & Altın) ─────────────────
            // ignore: prefer_const_constructors
            SliverToBoxAdapter(child: PrayerCardWidget()),

            // ── Son Okunan Kur'an'a Devam Etme Kartı ────────────────
            if (lastRead != null)
              SliverToBoxAdapter(
                child: _LastReadQuranCard(
                  lastRead: lastRead,
                  allSurahs: allSurahs,
                  atmosphere: atmosphere,
                ),
              ),

            // ── Hızlı Erişim Butonları (Genişletilmiş İslami Matris) ───
            SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: _QuickActionGrid(
                atmosphere: atmosphere,
                onOpenPrayers: () => ref.read(selectedTabProvider.notifier).state = 1,
                onOpenQibla: () {
                  Navigator.push(
                    context,
                    LuxuryPageRoute(page: const QiblaCompassScreen()),
                  );
                },
                onOpenZikr: () => ref.read(selectedTabProvider.notifier).state = 3,

          SliverToBoxAdapter(

          ),

          // ── Günlük Vakitler & Rekat Bilgileri Başlığı ─────────
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 20, 20, 10),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 4,
                    height: 18,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    strings.tabPrayers,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      letterSpacing: 0.3,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      strings.diyanetMethod,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),

          // ── Günlük Vakit Kartları (Rekat Bilgileri ile) ────────
          prayerAsync.when(
            loading: () => SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
                child: Center(
                  child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            error: (e, _) => SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 12),
                child: Text(
                  strings.prayerTimesLoadError(e),
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.redAccent),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            data: (daily) => SliverToBoxAdapter(
              child: _DailyPrayersCardList(daily: daily),
            ),
          ),

          // ── Günün Ayeti (Zarif & Kompakt Kart) ────────────────
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 10),
              child: _DailyVerseCompactCard(),
            ),
          ),

          // ── Günün Doğrulanmış Duası Kartı ──────────────────────
          // ignore: prefer_const_constructors
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            // ignore: prefer_const_constructors
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 4, 20, 12),
              // ignore: prefer_const_constructors
              child: _DailyFeaturedDuaCard(),
            ),
          ),

          // ── Saygılı Alt Banner Reklam (Premium'da otomatik gizlenir) ──
          const SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: BannerAdWidget(),
          ),

          // Alt boşluk (Yüzen lüks dock için ferah alan)
          const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 110)),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  );
}
}

class _UpcomingReligiousDayBanner extends ConsumerWidget {
  final dynamic day; // ReligiousDay
  final DynamicPrayerAtmosphere? atmosphere;

  const _UpcomingReligiousDayBanner({required this.day, this.atmosphere});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final days = day.daysRemaining as int;
    final isToday = day.isToday as bool;
    final statusText = isToday ? strings.today : strings.daysRemainingText(days);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        onTap: () {
          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
          Navigator.push(
            context,
            LuxuryPageRoute(page: const HijriCalendarScreen()),
          );
        },
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              colors: atmosphere != null
                  ? atmosphere!.cardGradient
                  : [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF03312B), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01241F)],
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(
              color: (atmosphere?.cardBorder ?? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: const Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: Colors.black, size: 14),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  '${day.localizedTitle(strings.language.code)} • $statusText',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                strings.calendarArrow,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 11),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LastReadQuranCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final LastReadPosition lastRead;
  final List<Surah> allSurahs;
  final DynamicPrayerAtmosphere? atmosphere;

  const _LastReadQuranCard({
    required this.lastRead,
    required this.allSurahs,
    this.atmosphere,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 0),
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        onTap: () {
          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
          final targetSurah = allSurahs.firstWhere(
            (s) => s.id == lastRead.surahId,
            orElse: () => allSurahs.isNotEmpty ? allSurahs.first : const Surah(
              id: 1,
              nameArabic: 'الفاتحة',
              nameTurkish: 'Fâtiha',
              nameEnglish: 'Al-Fatiha',
              revelationType: 'meccan',
              verseCount: 7,
            ),
          );
          Navigator.push(
            context,
            LuxuryPageRoute(
              page: SurahDetailScreen(
                surah: targetSurah,
                initialScrollToVerse: lastRead.verseNumber,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(
              colors: atmosphere != null
                  ? atmosphere!.cardGradient
                  : [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF02463B)],
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
              width: 1,
            ),
            boxShadow: [
              BoxShadow(
                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                blurRadius: 10,
                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(Icons.menu_book_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 20),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      strings.continueReadingQuran,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Günün Vakitleri ve Rekat Detayları Listesi
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class _DailyPrayersCardList extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;
  const _DailyPrayersCardList({required this.daily});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    final prayerService = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);
    final prayers = daily.prayers;
    final nextPrayer = daily.nextPrayerEntry;

    final rekatMap = {
      PrayerName.fajr: strings.rakatFajr,
      PrayerName.sunrise: strings.rakatSunrise,
      PrayerName.dhuhr: strings.rakatDhuhr,
      PrayerName.asr: strings.rakatAsr,
      PrayerName.maghrib: strings.rakatMaghrib,
      PrayerName.isha: strings.rakatIsha,
    };

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF071F1B) : Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          border: Border.all(
            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.2),
            width: 1,
          ),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.04),
              blurRadius: 14,
              offset: const Offset(0, 4),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          child: Column(
            children: prayers.map((p) {
              final isNext = nextPrayer?.name == p.name;
              final rekatText = rekatMap[p.name] ?? '';
              final timeStr = prayerService.formatTime(p.time);
              final localizedName = p.name.localizedName(strings.language.code);

              return Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isNext
                      ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.12 : 0.08)
                      : Colors.transparent,
                  border: Border(
                    bottom: BorderSide(
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white10 : Colors.grey.shade200,
                      width: 0.8,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 38,
                      height: 38,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: isNext
                            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
                            : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F322C) : Colors.grey.shade100),
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: isNext
                              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                              : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                          width: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Center(
                        child: Text(
                          p.name.arabic,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: isNext
                                ? Colors.black87
                                : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.teal),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),

                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                localizedName,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 15,
                                  fontWeight: isNext ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
                                  color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (isNext) ...[
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                                  ),
                                  child: Text(
                                    strings.nextPrayerLabel,
                                    style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 10,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                      color: Colors.black,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ],
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                            rekatText,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: isDark ? Colors.white60 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    Text(
                      timeStr,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: isNext ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                        color: isNext
                            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
                            : (isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DailyVerseCompactCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final dayOfYear = now.difference(DateTime(now.year, 1, 1)).inDays;
    final todayVerseIndex = (now.year * 365 + dayOfYear) % ShortVerseNotification.pool.length;
    final verse = ShortVerseNotification.pool[todayVerseIndex];

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: [
            BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
            BeyanColors.tone(0xFF023E36),
            isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011C19) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012723),
          ],
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
          width: 1,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
            blurRadius: 14,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  Icons.menu_book_rounded,
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  size: 16,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Text(
                strings.dailyVerseTitle,
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  fontSize: 13,
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              Text(
                verse.localizedReference(strings.language.code),
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white70,
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Text(
            verse.arabicText,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Amiri',
              fontSize: 17,
              height: 1.6,
              color: Colors.white,
            ),
            textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            verse.localizedText(strings.language.code),
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12,
              height: 1.45,
              color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.8),
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// Lüks İslami AppBar
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class _IslamicAppBar extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DynamicPrayerAtmosphere? atmosphere;
  const _IslamicAppBar({this.atmosphere});

  String _getSpiritualGreeting(AppStrings strings) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    if (now.weekday == DateTime.friday) {
      return strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Cumanız Mübarek Olsun 🕊️' : 'Jummah Mubarak 🕊️';
    }
    final hour = now.hour;
    if (hour >= 4 && hour < 11) {
      return strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Hayırlı Sabahlar 🌅' : 'Good Morning 🌅';
    } else if (hour >= 11 && hour < 17) {
      return strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Hayırlı Günler 🌿' : 'Blessed Day 🌿';
    } else if (hour >= 17 && hour < 21) {
      return strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Hayırlı Akşamlar 🌇' : 'Good Evening 🌇';
    } else {
      return strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Hayırlı Geceler 🌙' : 'Peaceful Night 🌙';
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);

    return SliverAppBar(
      floating: false,
      pinned: true,
      elevation: 0,
      backgroundColor: atmosphere?.appBarColor ?? (Theme.of(context).appBarTheme.backgroundColor ?? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201D)),
      centerTitle: false,
      toolbarHeight: 64,
      title: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Container(
            width: 32,
            height: 32,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                width: 1.2,
              ),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
                  blurRadius: 6,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: ClipOval(
              child: Image.asset(
                'assets/images/app_logo.png',
                width: 32,
                height: 32,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 10),
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Text(
                'Beyân',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  letterSpacing: 0.4,
                  height: 1.1,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                _getSpiritualGreeting(strings),
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  letterSpacing: 0.2,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
      actions: [
        // Lüks Ayarlar Butonu (Tek & Ferah)
        IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined, color: Colors.white),
          tooltip: strings.settings,
          onPressed: () => SettingsScreen.show(context),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 6),
      ],
    );
  }
}
