/// Ana ekranın üst kısmında yer alan lüks zümrüt & altın namaz vakti kartı.
class PrayerCardWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  const PrayerCardWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final prayerAsync = ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider);

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: prayerAsync.when(
        loading: () => _LoadingCard(),
        error: (e, _) => _ErrorCard(message: e.toString()),
        data: (daily) => _PrayerCard(daily: daily),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Yüklenme sırasında iskelet kart.

      height: 220,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),

}

/// Ana namaz vakti kartı – zümrüt degrade, 24K altın detaylar, rekat bilgisi.
class _PrayerCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;

  const _PrayerCard({
    required this.daily,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final langCode = strings.language.code;
    final next = daily.nextPrayerEntry;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final timeRemaining = next != null ? next.time.difference(now) : Duration.zero;
    final isApproaching = timeRemaining.inMinutes < 15 && !timeRemaining.isNegative;

    // Tüm ekran ve alt bar ile %100 aynı birleşik palet gradyanı
    final List<Color> gradientColors = effectivePalette.prayerCardGradient;
    final Color glowColor = effectivePalette.prayerCardGlow;
    final Color borderColor = isApproaching
        ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
        : effectivePalette.accentGold.withValues(alpha: 0.42);

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 0),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          colors: gradientColors,
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          stops: const [0.0, 0.5, 1.0],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
        border: Border.all(
          color: borderColor,
          width: isApproaching ? 1.6 : 1.2,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: (isApproaching ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : glowColor).withValues(alpha: isApproaching ? 0.3 : 0.22),
            blurRadius: isApproaching ? 28 : 20,
            offset: const Offset(0, 8),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          // ── Ana İçerik ────────────────────────────────────────
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 20, 22, 16),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                // Konum + Tarih satırı
                _LocationRow(daily: daily, language: strings.language),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Namaz adı + Saat
                Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Sol: Namaz adları & Rekat bilgisi
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            strings.nextPrayer,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                              letterSpacing: 0.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 4),
                          Text(
                            next?.name.localizedName(langCode) ?? '--',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontSize: 32,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              height: 1.1,
                            ),
                          ),
                          // İkincil isim (Arapça veya Türkçe)
                          Text(
                            strings.language == AppLanguage.arabic
                                ? (next?.name.turkish ?? '')
                                : (next?.name.arabic ?? ''),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontFamily: strings.language == AppLanguage.arabic ? null : 'Amiri',
                              color: Colors.white60,
                              fontSize: 17,
                              height: 1.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                          // ── Rekat Bilgisi Rozeti ─────────────────
                          if (next != null && next.name.rakatTotal > 0) ...[
                            const SizedBox(height: 8),
                            GestureDetector(
                              onTap: () => PrayerGuideSheet.show(context, ref, next.name, next.time),
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4.5),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                                    width: 1,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: [
                                    Icon(
                                      Icons.mosque_outlined,
                                      size: 13,
                                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 5),
                                    Flexible(
                                      child: Text(
                                        next.name.localizedRakat(langCode),
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                          letterSpacing: 0.2,
                                        ),
                                        maxLines: 1,
                                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                    Icon(
                                      Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                      size: 11,
                                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),

                            fontSize: 36,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
                            fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 6),
                        Consumer(
                          builder: (context, ref, _) {
                            final countdownAsync = ref.watch(countdownStringProvider);
                            final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
                            return countdownAsync.when(
                              data: (s) => _CountdownBadge(
                                text: '$s ${strings.remainingTime}',
                              ),
                              loading: () => const SizedBox.shrink(),
                              error: (_, __) => const SizedBox.shrink(),

                      ],

                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // İlerleme Çubuğu
                Consumer(

          // ── Alt: Tüm Vakitler Mini Listesi ────────────────────
          _MiniPrayerRow(daily: daily, langCode: langCode),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _fmt(DateTime dt) {
    final h = dt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final m = dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$h:$m';
  }
}

/// Konum ve tarih satırı.
class _LocationRow extends StatelessWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;
  final AppLanguage language;
  const _LocationRow({required this.daily, required this.language});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final hijri = HijriCalendarService.instance.getHijriDate(now);
    String dateStr;
    try {
      String localeTag;
      switch (language) {
        case AppLanguage.indonesian:
          localeTag = 'id_ID';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.english:
          localeTag = 'en_US';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.arabic:
          localeTag = 'ar_SA';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.french:
          localeTag = 'fr_FR';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.urdu:
          localeTag = 'ur_PK';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.german:
          localeTag = 'de_DE';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.russian:
          localeTag = 'ru_RU';
          break;
        case AppLanguage.turkish:
          localeTag = 'tr_TR';
          break;
      }
      dateStr = DateFormat('d MMM', localeTag).format(now);
    } catch (_) {
      dateStr = '${now.day}.${now.month}';
    }

    final hijriStr = '${hijri.day} ${hijri.localizedMonthName(language.code)}';

    final strings = AppStrings(language);
    final locationName = daily.locationName == 'Mevcut Konum'
        ? strings.currentLocation
        : daily.locationName;

    return Row(
      children: [
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () {
            HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
            Navigator.push(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const NearbyMosquesScreen()),
            );
          },
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.location_on_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 14),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Text(
                locationName,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 1.5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                  border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.35), width: 0.8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.mosque_rounded, size: 10, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 3),
                    Text(
                      strings.mosquesPill,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                        fontSize: 9.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const Spacer(),
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3), width: 0.8),
          ),
          child: Text(
            '$hijriStr • $dateStr',
            style: TextStyle(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Gerçek zamanlı geri sayım rozeti.
class _CountdownBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  final String text;
  const _CountdownBadge({required this.text});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 1),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.timer_outlined, size: 13, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
          const SizedBox(width: 5),
          Text(
            text,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Mevcut → Sıradaki vakit ilerleme çubuğu.
/// Mevcut → Sıradaki vakit canlı ve aktif ilerleme çubuğu.
class _ProgressBar extends StatelessWidget {
  final double progress;
  final String fromLabel;
  final String toLabel;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  const _ProgressBar({
    required this.progress,
    required this.fromLabel,
    required this.toLabel,
    this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final clamped = progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final percent = (clamped * 100).toInt();

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Stack(
            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
            children: [
              Container(
                height: 7,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
              TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: 0, end: clamped),
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                builder: (context, val, _) {
                  return FractionallySizedBox(
                    widthFactor: val.clamp(0.01, 1.0),
                    child: Container(
                      height: 7,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: LinearGradient(
                          colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), const Color(0xFFFFF3B0)],
                        ),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                        boxShadow: [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                            blurRadius: 6,
                            spreadRadius: 1,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 7),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Container(
                    width: 6,
                    height: 6,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                  Text(fromLabel, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                ],
              ),
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1.5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  '%$percent',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  Text(toLabel, style: TextStyle(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                  Container(
                    width: 6,
                    height: 6,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Kartın alt şeridinde tüm vakitlerin mini satırı.
class _MiniPrayerRow extends StatelessWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;
  final String langCode;
  const _MiniPrayerRow({required this.daily, required this.langCode});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final nextName = daily.nextPrayerEntry?.name;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.22),
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.only(
          bottomLeft: Radius.circular(24),
          bottomRight: Radius.circular(24),
        ),
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 10),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
        children: daily.prayers
            .where((p) => p.name != PrayerName.sunrise)
            .map((p) => _MiniPrayerItem(
                  entry: p,
                  isActive: p.name == nextName,
                  langCode: langCode,
                ))
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Mini vakit satırındaki tek vakit hücresi (Dokunulduğunda namaz rehberini açar).
class _MiniPrayerItem extends ConsumerWidget {
  final PrayerEntry entry;
  final bool isActive;
  final String langCode;

  const _MiniPrayerItem({
    required this.entry,
    required this.isActive,
    required this.langCode,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final h = entry.time.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final m = entry.time.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => PrayerGuideSheet.show(context, ref, entry.name, entry.time),
      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isActive ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.24) : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: isActive
              ? Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.55), width: 1)
              : null,
        ),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Text(
              entry.name.localizedName(langCode),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: isActive ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white60,
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            Text(
              '$h:$m',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: isActive ? Colors.white : Colors.white70,
                fontSize: 13,
                fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w400,
                fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 2),
            // Küçük rekat göstergesi (ör: 4R, 10R, 8R)
            if (entry.name.rakatTotal > 0)
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 1),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  '${entry.name.rakatTotal}R',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: isActive ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white38,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../quran/models/surah.dart';

/// Sure listesinde bir satırı gösteren yüksek performanslı (120 FPS optimize) widget.
class SurahListItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final Surah surah;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final String langCode;

  const SurahListItem({
    super.key,
    required this.surah,
    required this.onTap,
    this.langCode = 'tr',
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return RepaintBoundary(
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 3.5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D2823) : Colors.white,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF133B34) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE5ECE9),
            width: 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Material(
          color: Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
          child: InkWell(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
            onTap: onTap,
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  // ── Numara Rozeti (Hafif ve Geometrik) ─────────────
                  _SurahNumber(number: surah.id, isDark: isDark),
                  const SizedBox(width: 13),

                  // ── Dil Bazlı İsim + Bilgi Etiketleri ─────────────
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          surah.localizedName(langCode),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 15.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF11221F),
                            letterSpacing: 0.1,
                          ),
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 3),
                        Row(
                          children: [
                            _InfoChip(
                              label: surah.localizedRevelation(langCode),
                              color: surah.isMeccan
                                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0A685A)
                                  : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF996515),
                              isDark: isDark,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 6),
                            Text(
                              surah.localizedVerseCount(langCode),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11.5,
                                color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF5B6E6A),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),

                  // ── Sağ: Arapça İsim (Hafif Amiri Tipografisi) ──────
                  Text(
                    surah.nameArabic,
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                      fontSize: 20.0,
                      height: 1.4,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFE082) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Sure numarası – hafif altın vurgulu köşeli rozet
class _SurahNumber extends StatelessWidget {
  final int number;
  final bool isDark;
  const _SurahNumber({required this.number, required this.isDark});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: 38,
      height: 38,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark
            ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.12)
            : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35).withValues(alpha: 0.06),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.65),
          width: 1.2,
        ),
      ),
      child: Center(
        child: Text(
          '$number',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: number > 99 ? 11 : 13,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Mekki/Medeni bilgi etiketi.
class _InfoChip extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final Color color;
  final bool isDark;
  const _InfoChip({
    required this.label,
    required this.color,
    required this.isDark,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 1.5),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.2 : 0.1),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 10.5,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: color,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/live_makkah/screens/mecca_medina_live_screen.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import 'package:webview_flutter/webview_flutter.dart';
import 'package:webview_flutter_wkwebview/webview_flutter_wkwebview.dart';

import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';

/// 24/7 Mekke & Medine Uygulama İçi Canlı Yayın Ekranı (In-App Live Stream Player)
class MeccaMedinaLiveScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const MeccaMedinaLiveScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<MeccaMedinaLiveScreen> createState() => _MeccaMedinaLiveScreenState();
}

class _MeccaMedinaLiveScreenState extends ConsumerState<MeccaMedinaLiveScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final TabController _tabController;

  // Saudi Quran TV (Makkah): @SaudiQuranTv
  // Saudi Sunnah TV (Madinah): @SaudiSunnahTv
  static const String _makkahDefaultVideoId = 'eC4LfEVxvKg';
  static const String _madinahDefaultVideoId = 'Rs7St51oDDc';
  static const String _makkahHandle = '@SaudiQuranTv';
  static const String _madinahHandle = '@SaudiSunnahTv';

  String _makkahVideoId = _makkahDefaultVideoId;
  String _madinahVideoId = _madinahDefaultVideoId;

  late final WebViewController _makkahController;
  late final WebViewController _madinahController;

  bool _isMakkahLoading = true;
  bool _isMadinahLoading = true;
  bool _isFullScreen = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _tabController = TabController(length: 2, vsync: this);
    _tabController.addListener(() {
      if (!mounted) return;
      if (_tabController.indexIsChanging) return;
      // İki yayının aynı anda ses çalmasını önlemek için aktif olmayan sekmedeki videoyu durdur
      if (_tabController.index == 0) {
        _madinahController
            .runJavaScript(
                'try { if(window.player && player.pauseVideo){player.pauseVideo();} var v=document.querySelector("video"); if(v){v.pause();} } catch(e){}')
            .catchError((_) {});
      } else {
        _makkahController
            .runJavaScript(
                'try { if(window.player && player.pauseVideo){player.pauseVideo();} var v=document.querySelector("video"); if(v){v.pause();} } catch(e){}')
            .catchError((_) {});
      }
      setState(() {});
    });

    _initControllers();
    _fetchLiveVideoIds();
  }

  static const String _browserUserAgent =
      'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_5 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.5 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1';

  /// Gömülü oynatıcı için uygulamaya ait geçerli bir HTTPS origin.
  /// YouTube, origin/referrer olarak youtube.com taklit eden gömmeleri
  /// "Hata 152-4" ile reddeder; bu yüzden kendi origin'imizi kullanıyoruz.
  static const String _embedOrigin = 'https://beyan.app';

  // Gömülü oynatıcı hata verirse otomatik olarak mobil izleme sayfasına geçildi mi?
  bool _makkahFallbackUsed = false;
  bool _madinahFallbackUsed = false;

  WebViewController _createController(
    String name,
    VoidCallback onFinished,
    VoidCallback onPlayerError,
  ) {
    late final PlatformWebViewControllerCreationParams params;
    if (WebViewPlatform.instance is WebKitWebViewPlatform) {
      params = WebKitWebViewControllerCreationParams(
        allowsInlineMediaPlayback: true,
        mediaTypesRequiringUserAction: const <PlaybackMediaTypes>{},
      );
    } else {
      params = const PlatformWebViewControllerCreationParams();
    }

    late final WebViewController controller;
    controller = WebViewController.fromPlatformCreationParams(params)
      ..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)
      ..setBackgroundColor(Colors.black)
      ..setUserAgent(_browserUserAgent)
      ..addJavaScriptChannel(
        'BeyanPlayer',
        onMessageReceived: (message) {
          debugPrint('$name player event: ${message.message}');
          if (message.message.startsWith('error')) {
            onPlayerError();
          } else if (message.message == 'ready' || message.message == 'playing') {
            onFinished();
          }
        },
      )
      ..setNavigationDelegate(
        NavigationDelegate(
          onPageFinished: (url) {
            onFinished();
          },
          onWebResourceError: (error) {
            debugPrint('$name stream error: ${error.description}');
            onFinished();
          },
          onNavigationRequest: (request) {
            // Uygulama dışına (youtube://, App Store vb.) yönlendirmeleri engelle
            final uri = Uri.tryParse(request.url);
            if (uri == null) return NavigationDecision.prevent;
            if (uri.scheme == 'https' || uri.scheme == 'http' || uri.scheme == 'about') {
              return NavigationDecision.navigate;
            }
            return NavigationDecision.prevent;
          },
        ),
      );
    return controller;
  }

  void _initControllers() {
    _makkahController = _createController(
      'Makkah',
      () {
        if (mounted && _isMakkahLoading) setState(() => _isMakkahLoading = false);
      },
      () {
        if (!_makkahFallbackUsed && mounted) {
          _makkahFallbackUsed = true;
          _loadWatchPage(_makkahController, _makkahVideoId);
        }
      },
    );
    _loadStream(_makkahController, _makkahVideoId);

    _madinahController = _createController(
      'Madinah',
      () {
        if (mounted && _isMadinahLoading) setState(() => _isMadinahLoading = false);
      },
      () {
        if (!_madinahFallbackUsed && mounted) {
          _madinahFallbackUsed = true;
          _loadWatchPage(_madinahController, _madinahVideoId);
        }
      },
    );
    _loadStream(_madinahController, _madinahVideoId);
  }

  /// YouTube IFrame Player API ile gömülü oynatıcıyı yükler.
  /// Oynatıcı hata verirse (gömme kısıtlaması vb.) Flutter'a bildirir.
  void _loadStream(WebViewController controller, String videoId) {
    final html = '''
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
  <meta name="referrer" content="strict-origin-when-cross-origin">
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; background-color: #000; }
    html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #000; }
    #player { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="player"></div>
  <script>
    function post(m) { try { BeyanPlayer.postMessage(m); } catch (e) {} }
    var player;
    function onYouTubeIframeAPIReady() {
      player = new YT.Player('player', {
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        videoId: '$videoId',
        playerVars: {
          autoplay: 1, playsinline: 1, rel: 0, modestbranding: 1, fs: 1,
          origin: '$_embedOrigin',
          widget_referrer: '$_embedOrigin'
        },
        events: {
          onReady: function(e) { post('ready'); try { e.target.playVideo(); } catch (x) {} },
          onStateChange: function(e) { if (e.data === 1) { started = true; post('playing'); } },
          onError: function(e) { post('error:' + e.data); }
        }
      });
    }
    var started = false;
    // Oynatıcı hata ekranında kalıp hiç oynatmazsa (ör. Hata 152) yedek moda geç
    setTimeout(function() { if (!started) post('error:noplay'); }, 15000);
    var tag = document.createElement('script');
    tag.src = 'https://www.youtube.com/iframe_api';
    tag.onerror = function() { post('error:api'); };
    document.head.appendChild(tag);
    // API 12 sn içinde hazır olmazsa yedek moda geç
    setTimeout(function() { if (!player) post('error:timeout'); }, 12000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
''';
    controller.loadHtmlString(html, baseUrl: _embedOrigin);
  }

  /// Yedek mod: YouTube mobil izleme sayfasını doğrudan uygulama içinde oynatır.
  void _loadWatchPage(WebViewController controller, String videoId) {
    controller.loadRequest(
      Uri.parse('https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=$videoId&autoplay=1&playsinline=1'),
      headers: const {'Referer': 'https://m.youtube.com/'},
    );
  }

  /// Kanalın /live sayfasındaki canonical bağlantıdan güncel canlı yayın ID'sini çözer.
  Future<String?> _resolveLiveVideoId(HttpClient client, String handle) async {
    try {
      final req = await client.getUrl(Uri.parse('https://www.youtube.com/$handle/live'));
      req.followRedirects = true;
      req.headers.set('Accept-Language', 'en-US,en;q=0.8');
      req.headers.set('Cookie', 'CONSENT=YES+1');
      final res = await req.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      final body = await utf8.decoder.bind(res).join();
      final canonical = RegExp(
        r'<link rel="canonical" href="https://www\.youtube\.com/watch\?v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})"',
      ).firstMatch(body);
      if (canonical != null) return canonical.group(1);
    } catch (_) {}
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _fetchLiveVideoIds() async {
    final client = HttpClient()..userAgent = _browserUserAgent;
    try {
      final makkahId = await _resolveLiveVideoId(client, _makkahHandle);
      if (makkahId != null && makkahId != _makkahVideoId && mounted) {
        _makkahVideoId = makkahId;
        _makkahFallbackUsed = false;
        _loadStream(_makkahController, _makkahVideoId);
      }

      final madinahId = await _resolveLiveVideoId(client, _madinahHandle);
      if (madinahId != null && madinahId != _madinahVideoId && mounted) {
        _madinahVideoId = madinahId;
        _madinahFallbackUsed = false;
        _loadStream(_madinahController, _madinahVideoId);
      }
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  void _reloadCurrentStream() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    if (_tabController.index == 0) {
      setState(() => _isMakkahLoading = true);
      _makkahFallbackUsed = false;
      _loadStream(_makkahController, _makkahVideoId);
    } else {
      setState(() => _isMadinahLoading = true);
      _madinahFallbackUsed = false;
      _loadStream(_madinahController, _madinahVideoId);
    }
  }

  /// "Doğrudan" modu: gömülü oynatıcıyı atlayıp canlı yayını uygulama içinde
  /// YouTube mobil izleme sayfasından oynatır.
  void _loadDirectStream() {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    if (_tabController.index == 0) {
      setState(() => _isMakkahLoading = true);
      _makkahFallbackUsed = true;
      _loadWatchPage(_makkahController, _makkahVideoId);
    } else {
      setState(() => _isMadinahLoading = true);
      _madinahFallbackUsed = true;
      _loadWatchPage(_madinahController, _madinahVideoId);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openOfficialLiveChannel(String channelHandle) async {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    final appUri = Uri.parse('youtube://www.youtube.com/$channelHandle/live');
    final webUri = Uri.parse('https://www.youtube.com/$channelHandle/live');
    try {
      if (await canLaunchUrl(appUri)) {
        await launchUrl(appUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (await canLaunchUrl(webUri)) {
      await launchUrl(webUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    try {
      _makkahController.loadRequest(Uri.parse('about:blank'));
      _madinahController.loadRequest(Uri.parse('about:blank'));
    } catch (_) {}
    _tabController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);

    if (_isFullScreen) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Colors.black,
        body: SafeArea(
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              Positioned.fill(
                child: WebViewWidget(
                  controller: _tabController.index == 0 ? _makkahController : _madinahController,
                ),
              ),
              Positioned(
                top: 16,
                right: 16,
                child: IconButton.filled(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.fullscreen_exit_rounded, color: Colors.white),
                  style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                  ),
                  onPressed: () => setState(() => _isFullScreen = false),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011815),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          strings.liveBroadcastTitle,
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
            tooltip: strings.refreshStream,
            onPressed: _reloadCurrentStream,
          ),
        ],
        bottom: TabBar(
          controller: _tabController,
          indicatorColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
          indicatorWeight: 3,
          labelColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
          unselectedLabelColor: Colors.white60,
          tabs: [
            Tab(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.mosque_rounded),
              text: strings.makkahLiveTitle,
            ),
            Tab(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.nightlight_round),
              text: strings.madinahLiveTitle,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      body: TabBarView(
        controller: _tabController,
        children: [
          _buildLiveTab(
            controller: _makkahController,
            isLoading: _isMakkahLoading,
            title: strings.makkahLiveTitle,
            subtitle: strings.makkahLiveSubtitle,
            badge: strings.liveBadgeMakkah,
            accentColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
            handle: _makkahHandle,
            description: strings.makkahLiveDesc,
            hadith: strings.makkahLiveHadith,
            strings: strings,
          ),
          _buildLiveTab(
            controller: _madinahController,
            isLoading: _isMadinahLoading,
            title: strings.madinahLiveTitle,
            subtitle: strings.madinahLiveSubtitle,
            badge: strings.liveBadgeMadinah,
            accentColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF2DD4BF),
            handle: _madinahHandle,
            description: strings.madinahLiveDesc,
            hadith: strings.madinahLiveHadith,
            strings: strings,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLiveTab({
    required WebViewController controller,
    required bool isLoading,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required String badge,
    required Color accentColor,
    required String handle,
    required String description,
    required String hadith,
    required AppStrings strings,
  }) {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 32),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // ── 1. Uygulama İçi Video Oynatıcı Kartı ──────────────────────
          Container(
            height: 230,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.black,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              border: Border.all(
                color: accentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                width: 1.5,
              ),
              boxShadow: [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                  blurRadius: 18,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 6),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              child: Stack(
                children: [
                  Positioned.fill(
                    child: WebViewWidget(controller: controller),
                  ),

                  // Yükleniyor İndikatörü
                  if (isLoading)
                    Positioned.fill(
                      child: Container(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032620),
                        child: Center(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              CircularProgressIndicator(color: accentColor),
                              const SizedBox(height: 12),
                              Text(
                                '$badge ${strings.connectingLive}',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: accentColor,
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                  // Tam Ekran Butonu (Sağ Üst)
                  Positioned(
                    top: 8,
                    right: 8,
                    child: IconButton.filled(
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.fullscreen_rounded, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                      style: IconButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                      ),
                      tooltip: strings.fullscreenTooltip,
                      onPressed: () {
                        HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                        setState(() => _isFullScreen = true);
                      },
                    ),
                  ),

                  // Canlı Rozeti (Sol Üst)
                  Positioned(
                    top: 12,
                    left: 12,
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.9),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        boxShadow: [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                            blurRadius: 8,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            width: 6,
                            height: 6,
                            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 5),
                          Text(
                            badge,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              fontSize: 10,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              letterSpacing: 0.5,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),

          // ── 2. Kontrol ve Aksiyon Butonları ─────────────────────────
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _reloadCurrentStream,
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh_rounded, size: 18),
                  label: Text(strings.refreshStream),
                  style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                    foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                    side: BorderSide(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: _loadDirectStream,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.bolt_rounded, size: 18),
                label: Text(strings.directStream),
                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF2DD4BF),
                  side: BorderSide(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF2DD4BF).withValues(alpha: 0.5)),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12, horizontal: 10),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: ElevatedButton.icon(

/// Beyân Premium Üyelik Paketleri
enum PremiumTier {
  /// Aylık Abonelik
  monthly,

  /// Yıllık Abonelik (En Popüler - %45 Tasarruf)
  yearly,

  /// Ömür Boyu Tek Seferlik (Beyân Hâmisi)
  lifetime,
}

extension PremiumTierExtension on PremiumTier {
  String get productId {
    switch (this) {
      case PremiumTier.monthly:
        return 'beyan_premium_monthly';
      case PremiumTier.yearly:
        return 'beyan_premium_yearly';
      case PremiumTier.lifetime:
        return 'beyan_premium_lifetime';
    }
  }

  String get title {
    switch (this) {
      case PremiumTier.monthly:
        return 'Aylık Abonelik';
      case PremiumTier.yearly:
        return 'Yıllık Abonelik';
      case PremiumTier.lifetime:
        return 'Ömür Boyu Hâmî';
    }
  }

  String get defaultPriceText {
    switch (this) {
      case PremiumTier.monthly:
        return '₺49,99 / ay';
      case PremiumTier.yearly:
        return '₺299,99 / yıl';
      case PremiumTier.lifetime:
        return '₺499,99 (Tek Seferlik)';
    }
  }

  String get badgeText {
    switch (this) {
      case PremiumTier.monthly:
        return '';
      case PremiumTier.yearly:
        return '%60 İNDİRİM';
      case PremiumTier.lifetime:
        return 'EN DEĞERLİ';
    }
  }

  String get subtitle {
    switch (this) {
      case PremiumTier.monthly:
        return 'İstediğiniz zaman iptal edebilirsiniz';
      case PremiumTier.yearly:
        return 'Ayda yalnızca ₺19,99 (3 Gün Ücretsiz Deneme)';
      case PremiumTier.lifetime:
        return 'Bir kez ödeyin, sonsuza dek reklamsız kullanın';
    }
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/monetization/providers/premium_provider.dart

`dart
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../models/premium_product.dart';
import '../services/premium_service.dart';

class PremiumState {
  final bool isPremium;
  final PremiumTier? activeTier;
  final bool isLoading;
  final bool isTrialActive;
  final int trialDaysRemaining;
  final bool hasWidgetAccess;

  const PremiumState({
    this.isPremium = true,
    this.activeTier = PremiumTier.lifetime,
    this.isLoading = false,
    this.isTrialActive = true,
    this.trialDaysRemaining = 999,
    this.hasWidgetAccess = true,
  });

  PremiumState copyWith({
    bool? isPremium,
    PremiumTier? activeTier,
    bool? isLoading,
    bool? isTrialActive,
    int? trialDaysRemaining,
    bool? hasWidgetAccess,
  }) {
    return PremiumState(
      isPremium: isPremium ?? this.isPremium,
      activeTier: activeTier ?? this.activeTier,
      isLoading: isLoading ?? this.isLoading,
      isTrialActive: isTrialActive ?? this.isTrialActive,
      trialDaysRemaining: trialDaysRemaining ?? this.trialDaysRemaining,
      hasWidgetAccess: hasWidgetAccess ?? this.hasWidgetAccess,
    );
  }
}

class PremiumNotifier extends StateNotifier<PremiumState> {
  final PremiumService _service;

  PremiumNotifier(this._service)
      : super(PremiumState(
          isPremium: _service.isPremium,
          activeTier: _service.activeTier,
          isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
          trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
          hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
        )) {
    _service.premiumStatusStream.listen((isPrem) {
      state = state.copyWith(
        isPremium: isPrem,
        activeTier: _service.activeTier,
        isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
        trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
        hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
      );
    });
  }

  Future<void> activateFreeTrial() async {
    await _service.activateFreeTrial();
    state = state.copyWith(
      isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
      trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
      hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
    );
  }

  Future<bool> buyTier(PremiumTier tier) async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
    final success = await _service.buyTier(tier);
    state = state.copyWith(
      isPremium: _service.isPremium,
      activeTier: _service.activeTier,
      isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
      trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
      hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
      isLoading: false,
    );
    return success;
  }

  Future<bool> restorePurchases() async {
    state = state.copyWith(isLoading: true);
    final success = await _service.restorePurchases();
    state = state.copyWith(
      isPremium: _service.isPremium,
      activeTier: _service.activeTier,
      isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
      trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
      hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
      isLoading: false,
    );
    return success;
  }

  Future<void> toggleDevPremium() async {
    await _service.toggleDevPremium();
    state = state.copyWith(
      isPremium: _service.isPremium,
      activeTier: _service.activeTier,
      isTrialActive: _service.isTrialActive,
      trialDaysRemaining: _service.trialDaysRemaining,
      hasWidgetAccess: _service.hasWidgetAccess,
    );
  }
}

final premiumProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<PremiumNotifier, PremiumState>((ref) {
  return PremiumNotifier(PremiumService.instance);
});

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../models/premium_product.dart';
import '../providers/premium_provider.dart';
import '../services/premium_service.dart';

/// Lüks Beyân Premium Satın Alma & Ücretsiz Deneme Ekranı
///
/// Ana Premium Kozları:
/// 1. Kilit Ekranı & Ana Ekran Canlı Widget'ları
/// 2. Tüm Ezan Makamları & Meşhur Müezzinler
/// 3. %100 Reklamsız Huşû Dolu Deneyim
/// 4. Lüks Gece & OLED Temaları
///
/// Öne Çıkan Paketler:
/// - Yıllık Plan (3 Gün Ücretsiz Deneme ile - En Popüler)
/// - Ömür Boyu Sahip Ol (Tek Seferlik Ödeme - En Avantajlı)
class OnboardingTrialPaywallScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final bool isDismissible;
  final VoidCallback? onDismiss;

  const OnboardingTrialPaywallScreen({
    super.key,
    this.isDismissible = true,
    this.onDismiss,
  });

  static Future<void> show(
    BuildContext context, {
    bool isDismissible = true,
    VoidCallback? onDismiss,
  }) async {
    // v1.0 sürümünde tüm özellikler ücretsiz sunulur; satın alma paywall'u açılmaz.
    if (onDismiss != null) onDismiss();
    return;
  }

  @override
  ConsumerState<OnboardingTrialPaywallScreen> createState() =>
      _OnboardingTrialPaywallScreenState();
}

class _OnboardingTrialPaywallScreenState
    extends ConsumerState<OnboardingTrialPaywallScreen> {
  // Varsayılan olarak Yıllık (3 gün denemeli) seçili
  PremiumTier _selectedTier = PremiumTier.yearly;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    // Ekran açıldığı an ilk açılış durumunu hemen kaydet.
    // Böylece uygulama her yeniden açıldığında tekrar zorla ekrana gelmez!
    PremiumService.instance.markLaunchPaywallSeen();
  }

  void _close() {
    PremiumService.instance.markLaunchPaywallSeen();
    if (widget.onDismiss != null) {
      widget.onDismiss!();
    } else {
      Navigator.of(context).pop();
    }
  }

  String _t(AppLanguage lang, {required String tr, required String en, required String ar, String? id}) {
    switch (lang) {
      case AppLanguage.turkish:
        return tr;
      case AppLanguage.arabic:
      case AppLanguage.urdu:
        return ar;
      case AppLanguage.indonesian:
        return id ?? en;
      default:
        return en;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _startPurchase() async {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      // 1. Eğer yıllık paket seçildiyse 3 günlük ücretsiz denemeyi yerel olarak aktifleştir
      if (_selectedTier == PremiumTier.yearly) {
        await ref.read(premiumProvider.notifier).activateFreeTrial();
      } else {
        await PremiumService.instance.markLaunchPaywallSeen();
      }

      // 2. Uygulama içi satın alma akışını mağazaya gönder
      await ref.read(premiumProvider.notifier).buyTier(_selectedTier);

      if (mounted) {
        final strings = ref.read(appStringsProvider);
        final lang = strings.language;
        final successMsg = _selectedTier == PremiumTier.yearly
            ? _t(lang,
                tr: '3 Günlük Ücretsiz Denemeniz Başlatıldı!',
                en: 'Your 3-day free trial has started!',
                ar: 'بدأت تجربتك المجانية لـ ٣ أيام!',
                id: 'Uji coba gratis 3 hari Anda telah dimulai!')
            : (_selectedTier == PremiumTier.lifetime
                ? _t(lang,
                    tr: 'Ömür Boyu Üyeliğiniz Başlatılıyor!',
                    en: 'Activating your lifetime membership!',
                    ar: 'جاري تفعيل عضويتك مدى الحياة!',
                    id: 'Mengaktifkan keanggotaan seumur hidup Anda!')
                : _t(lang,
                    tr: 'Aboneliğiniz Başlatılıyor!',
                    en: 'Starting your subscription!',
                    ar: 'جاري بدء اشتراكك!',
                    id: 'Memulai langganan Anda!'));

        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(successMsg),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
        _close();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Satın alma başlatma hatası: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        _close();
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _restore() async {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    final success = await ref.read(premiumProvider.notifier).restorePurchases();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      final strings = ref.read(appStringsProvider);
      final lang = strings.language;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            success
                ? _t(lang,
                    tr: 'Satın alımlarınız başarıyla geri yüklendi!',
                    en: 'Purchases restored successfully!',
                    ar: 'تم استعادة مشترياتك بنجاح!',
                    id: 'Pembelian Anda berhasil dipulihkan!')
                : _t(lang,
                    tr: 'Aktif bir abonelik bulunamadı.',
                    en: 'No active subscription found.',
                    ar: 'لم يتم العثور على اشتراك نشط.',
                    id: 'Tidak ada langganan aktif yang ditemukan.'),
          ),
          backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
      if (success) _close();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final billingStartDate = now.add(const Duration(days: 3));
    final billingDateFormatted =
        DateFormat('d MMM yyyy', strings.language.code).format(billingStartDate);

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021612),
      body: Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        height: double.infinity,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            colors: [
              BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011410),
              BeyanColors.tone(0xFF04261F),
              BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011511),
            ],
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          ),
        ),
        child: SafeArea(
          child: Column(
            children: [
              // ── Üst Çubuk (Geri Yükle & Kapat Butonu) ────────────────────────
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 0),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    // Geri Yükle Butonu (Apple Kuralı)
                    TextButton(
                      onPressed: _restore,
                      style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                        minimumSize: Size.zero,
                        tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                      ),

                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    // Kapat (✕) Butonu
                    InkWell(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      onTap: _close,
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                          shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        ),
                        child: const Icon(
                          Icons.close_rounded,
                          color: Colors.white70,
                          size: 20,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // ── Kaydırılabilir Gövde ─────────────────────────────────────────
              Expanded(
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 6, 22, 20),
                  physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,

  Widget _buildFeatureRow({
    required IconData icon,
    required String? tag,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(
          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
        ),

        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(9),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Icon(
              icon,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              size: 22,

          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        title,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 14.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,

                      ),

                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),

                            fontSize: 9,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,

                      ),

                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                Text(
                  subtitle,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                    fontSize: 12,
                    height: 1.3,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTimelineStep({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required bool isLast,
  }) {
    return IntrinsicHeight(
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Column(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFBCE3CE),

          Expanded(

              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: isLast ? 0 : 18),

                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 14,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.72),
                      fontSize: 12,
                      height: 1.35,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPricingCard({
    String? topBadge,
    String? subBadge,
    required String title,
    required String price,
    String? oldPrice,
    String? totalPrice,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        onTap();
      },
      child: Stack(
        clipBehavior: Clip.none,
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 15),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isSelected
                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06332B)
                  : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF08221D),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
              border: Border.all(
                color: isSelected
                    ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                    : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                width: isSelected ? 1.8 : 1,
              ),
              boxShadow: isSelected
                  ? [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                        blurRadius: 16,
                        spreadRadius: 1,
                      ),
                    ]
                  : null,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 22,
                  height: 22,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    color: isSelected
                        ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                        : Colors.transparent,
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: isSelected
                          ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                          : Colors.white38,
                      width: 1.5,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: isSelected
                      ? Icon(
                          Icons.check_rounded,
                          size: 15,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032620),
                        )
                      : null,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        title,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          fontSize: 15,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (subBadge != null) ...[
                        const SizedBox(height: 3),
                        Text(
                          subBadge,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: isSelected ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white60,
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      price,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                        fontSize: 16,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (totalPrice != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 3),
                      Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          if (oldPrice != null) ...[
                            Text(
                              oldPrice,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white38,
                                fontSize: 10.5,
                                decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          ],
                          Text(
                            totalPrice,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: isSelected
                                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                                  : Colors.white70,
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // Üst İndirim / Vurgu Rozeti
          if (topBadge != null)
            Positioned(
              top: -10,
              right: 12,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 3),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)],
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                      blurRadius: 4,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Text(
                  topBadge,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032B24),
                    fontSize: 9.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                    letterSpacing: 0.2,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFooterLink(String label, VoidCallback onTap) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          fontSize: 11,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/monetization/services/ad_service.dart

`dart
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';

/// Google AdMob Reklam Yönetim Servisi
/// Premium aboneler için %100 reklamsız deneyim sağlar.
class AdService {
  static final AdService instance = AdService._internal();
  factory AdService() => instance;
  AdService._internal();

  bool _isInitialized = false;

  /// v1.0 sürümünde reklamlar tamamen kapalıdır (reklamsız manevi deneyim).
  static const bool kAdsEnabled = false;

  /// Kullanıcının reklamsız deneyim hakkı var mı?
  /// Premium üyelik sahibi olan kullanıcılara hiçbir reklam gösterilmez.
  bool isAdFree = false;

  /// Premium durumuna göre reklamsız deneyimi günceller.
  void updateAdFreeStatus(bool premium) {
    isAdFree = premium;
  }

  /// AdMob SDK'sını başlatır.
  /// Eğer kullanıcı Premium aboneyse veya reklamlar devre dışıysa AdMob SDK başlatılmaz.
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    if (_isInitialized || isAdFree || !kAdsEnabled) {
      debugPrint('[AdService] Reklamlar kapalı: %100 Reklamsız Deneyim aktif, AdMob SDK başlatılmadı.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await MobileAds.instance.initialize();
      _isInitialized = true;
      debugPrint('AdMob SDK başarıyla başlatıldı.');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('AdMob başlatma hatası: $e');
    }
  }

  static const String iosTestBannerId = 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/2934735716';
  static const String androidTestBannerId = 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/6300978111';

  /// Resmi Google Test Banner Ad Unit ID'si
  String get testBannerAdUnitId {
    if (isAdFree) return '';
    if (Platform.isAndroid) return androidTestBannerId;
    if (Platform.isIOS) return iosTestBannerId;
    return '';
  }

  /// Platforma göre Banner Reklam Birimi Kimliği (Ad Unit ID).
  /// Not: Geliştirme ve test aşamasında Google'ın resmi test kimlikleri kullanılır.
  String get bannerAdUnitId {
    if (isAdFree) return '';
    if (kDebugMode) {
      return testBannerAdUnitId;
    }

    // Canlı Prodüksiyon ID'leri
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      return 'ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/6300978111';
    } else if (Platform.isIOS) {
      return 'ca-app-pub-1904469452707859/3170946984';
    }
    return '';
  }
}

/// Beyân Uygulama İçi Satın Alma (In-App Purchase) ve Premium Servisi
class PremiumService {
  static final PremiumService instance = PremiumService._internal();
  factory PremiumService() => instance;
  PremiumService._internal();

  static const String keyIsPremium = 'beyan_is_premium';
  static const String keyTier = 'beyan_premium_tier';
  static const String keyWidgetTrialStart = 'beyan_widget_trial_start';
