  static const String _integritySalt = 'B3y4n_Pr3m1um_S3cur1ty_S4lt_2026';

  final InAppPurchase _iap = InAppPurchase.instance;
  StreamSubscription<List<PurchaseDetails>>? _subscription;

  bool _isPremium = true;
  PremiumTier? _activeTier = PremiumTier.lifetime;
  DateTime? _trialStartDate;
  final _changeController = StreamController<bool>.broadcast();

  // v1.0 için tüm özellikler (widgetlar, ezan makamları, temalar, yapay zeka) tamamen ücretsizdir.
  bool get isPremium => true;
  PremiumTier? get activeTier => _activeTier;
  DateTime? get trialStartDate => _trialStartDate;
  Stream<bool> get premiumStatusStream => _changeController.stream;

  bool get isTrialActive => true;
  int get trialDaysRemaining => 999;
  bool get hasWidgetAccess => true;

  List<ProductDetails> _products = [];
  List<ProductDetails> get products => _products;

  /// Servisi başlatır, yerel SharedPreferences durumunu ve mağaza bağlantısını yükler.
  Future<void> initialize() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final savedPremium = prefs.getBool(keyIsPremium) ?? false;
    final tierStr = prefs.getString(keyTier);
    final savedHash = prefs.getString(keyIntegrityHash);

    // Güvenlik doğrulaması: Yerel veri tahrifatı (tampering / jailbreak plist edit) kontrolü
    if (savedPremium) {
      final expectedHash = _computeIntegrityHash(true, tierStr ?? '');
      if (savedHash == expectedHash) {
        _isPremium = true;
        if (tierStr != null) {
          try {
            _activeTier = PremiumTier.values.firstWhere((t) => t.name == tierStr);
          } catch (_) {}
        }
      } else {
        // Tahrifat tespit edildi; manipüle edilmiş yetkiyi temizle
        debugPrint('[Güvenlik] Premium doğrulama imzası uyuşmadı! Değişiklik sıfırlandı.');
        _isPremium = false;
        _activeTier = null;
        await prefs.setBool(keyIsPremium, false);
        await prefs.remove(keyTier);
        await prefs.remove(keyIntegrityHash);
      }
    } else {
      _isPremium = false;
    }

    final trialStr = prefs.getString(keyWidgetTrialStart);
    if (trialStr != null) {
      _trialStartDate = DateTime.tryParse(trialStr);
    } else {
      final now = DateTime.now();
      _trialStartDate = now;
      await prefs.setString(keyWidgetTrialStart, now.toIso8601String());
    }

    // Reklamsız deneyim durumunu senkronize et
    AdService.instance.updateAdFreeStatus(_isPremium);

    // Satın alma akışını dinle
    _subscription = _iap.purchaseStream.listen(
      _handlePurchaseUpdates,
      onDone: () => _subscription?.cancel(),
      onError: (error) {
        debugPrint('InAppPurchase stream hatası: $error');
      },
    );

    // Mağazadaki ürünleri sorgula (çevrimiçi ise)
    await loadProducts();
  }

  /// Güvenlik: Satın alma durumu için tahrif edilemez yerel imza üretir
  static String _computeIntegrityHash(bool isPremium, String tierName) {
    if (!isPremium) return '';
    final raw = '$_integritySalt:$tierName:$isPremium:beyan_verified_secure';
    int hash = 0x811c9dc5;
    for (int i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
      hash ^= raw.codeUnitAt(i);
      hash = (hash * 0x01000193) & 0xFFFFFFFF;
    }
    return base64Encode(utf8.encode('$hash:${raw.length ^ 0x5A}'));
  }

  /// Mağazadaki ürün listesini getirir.
  Future<void> loadProducts() async {
    try {
      final available = await _iap.isAvailable();
      if (!available) {
        debugPrint('In-App Purchase mağazası şu anda kullanılamıyor.');
        return;
      }

      final ids = PremiumTier.values.map((t) => t.productId).toSet();
      final response = await _iap.queryProductDetails(ids);

      if (response.error != null) {
        debugPrint('Ürün sorgulama hatası: ${response.error}');
        return;
      }

      _products = response.productDetails;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Ürünler yüklenirken hata: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Belirtilen paketi satın alma sürecini başlatır.
  Future<bool> buyTier(PremiumTier tier) async {
    try {
      final available = await _iap.isAvailable();
      if (!available) {
        debugPrint('Mağaza mevcut değil.');
        return false;
      }

      ProductDetails? product;
      try {
        product = _products.firstWhere((p) => p.id == tier.productId);
      } catch (_) {
        // Ürün mağazada henüz aktifleşmemişse (Sandbox/Geliştirici testi)
        product = null;
      }

      if (product == null) {
        debugPrint('Ürün detayları bulunamadı: ${tier.productId}');
        return false;
      }

      final purchaseParam = PurchaseParam(productDetails: product);

      if (tier == PremiumTier.lifetime) {
        await _iap.buyNonConsumable(purchaseParam: purchaseParam);
      } else {
        await _iap.buyNonConsumable(purchaseParam: purchaseParam);
      }

      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Satın alma başlatma hatası: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Önceki satın alımları geri yükler (Apple App Store kuralı).
  Future<bool> restorePurchases() async {
    try {
      await _iap.restorePurchases();
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Satın alımları geri yükleme hatası: $e');
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Satın alma akışındaki güncellemeleri işler.
  Future<void> _handlePurchaseUpdates(List<PurchaseDetails> purchases) async {
    for (final purchase in purchases) {
      if (purchase.status == PurchaseStatus.purchased ||
          purchase.status == PurchaseStatus.restored) {
        // Satın alma doğrulandı
        PremiumTier tier = PremiumTier.yearly;
        for (final t in PremiumTier.values) {
          if (t.productId == purchase.productID) {
            tier = t;
            break;
          }
        }
        await _setPremium(true, tier: tier);

        if (purchase.pendingCompletePurchase) {
          await _iap.completePurchase(purchase);
        }
      } else if (purchase.status == PurchaseStatus.error ||
          purchase.status == PurchaseStatus.canceled) {
        debugPrint('Satın alma durumu: ${purchase.status}, hata: ${purchase.error}');
        if (purchase.pendingCompletePurchase) {
          await _iap.completePurchase(purchase);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /// Premium durumunu günceller ve kaydeder.
  Future<void> _setPremium(bool premium, {PremiumTier? tier}) async {
    _isPremium = premium;
    _activeTier = tier;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(keyIsPremium, premium);
    if (tier != null) {
      await prefs.setString(keyTier, tier.name);
      await prefs.setString(keyIntegrityHash, _computeIntegrityHash(true, tier.name));
    } else {
      await prefs.remove(keyTier);
      await prefs.remove(keyIntegrityHash);
    }
    AdService.instance.updateAdFreeStatus(premium);
    _changeController.add(premium);
  }

  /// 3 Günlük Denemeyi kullanıcı onayıyla başlatır
  Future<void> activateFreeTrial() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final now = DateTime.now();
    _trialStartDate = now;
    await prefs.setString(keyWidgetTrialStart, now.toIso8601String());
    await prefs.setBool(keyHasSeenOnboardingPaywall, true);
    _changeController.add(true);
  }

  /// Açılış paywall'unun gösterilip gösterilmeyeceğini kontrol eder (v1.0 için kapalı)
  Future<bool> shouldShowLaunchPaywall() async {
    return false;
  }

  Future<void> markLaunchPaywallSeen() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(keyHasSeenOnboardingPaywall, true);
  }

  /// Geliştirici ve test modu için Premium'u açıp kapatma (Yalnızca kDebugMode!)
  Future<void> toggleDevPremium() async {
    if (!kDebugMode) {
      debugPrint('[Güvenlik Engeli] toggleDevPremium yalnızca Debug modunda çalıştırılabilir.');
      return;
    }
    final next = !_isPremium;
    await _setPremium(next, tier: next ? PremiumTier.lifetime : null);
  }

  void dispose() {
    _subscription?.cancel();
    _changeController.close();
  }
}

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:google_mobile_ads/google_mobile_ads.dart';
import '../providers/premium_provider.dart';
import '../services/ad_service.dart';

/// Saygı ve huzur odaklı alt Banner Reklam Widget'ı.
///
/// Eğer kullanıcı Premium aboneyse veya reklam yüklenemezse hiçbir alan kaplamadan gizlenir (`SizedBox.shrink()`).
class BannerAdWidget extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const BannerAdWidget({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<BannerAdWidget> createState() => _BannerAdWidgetState();
}

class _BannerAdWidgetState extends ConsumerState<BannerAdWidget> {
  BannerAd? _bannerAd;
  bool _isLoaded = false;
  bool _attemptedTestFallback = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadAd();
  }

  void _loadAd({bool isFallback = false}) {
    final isPremium = ref.read(premiumProvider).isPremium;
    if (isPremium) return;

    final unitId = isFallback
        ? AdService.instance.testBannerAdUnitId
        : AdService.instance.bannerAdUnitId;

    if (unitId.isEmpty) return;

    _bannerAd = BannerAd(
      adUnitId: unitId,
      size: AdSize.banner,
      request: const AdRequest(),
      listener: BannerAdListener(
        onAdLoaded: (ad) {
          if (mounted) {
            setState(() => _isLoaded = true);
          }
        },
        onAdFailedToLoad: (ad, error) {
          debugPrint('Banner reklam yüklenemedi (fallback: $isFallback): $error');
          ad.dispose();
          if (mounted) {
            // Eğer canlı reklam henüz onaylanmadıysa veya no-fill (kod 3) verdiyse,
            // uygulamanın test edilmesi için resmi test banner'ına geri düş
            if (!isFallback && !_attemptedTestFallback) {
              _attemptedTestFallback = true;
              debugPrint('AdMob: Canlı reklam doluluk/onay beklemesinde. Test reklam birimine geçiliyor...');
              _loadAd(isFallback: true);
              return;
            }

            setState(() {
              _bannerAd = null;
              _isLoaded = false;
            });
          }
        },
      ),
    )..load();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _bannerAd?.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // Kullanıcı satın alma yapıp Premium olduğunda reklamı derhal yok et
    ref.listen<PremiumState>(premiumProvider, (previous, next) {
      if (next.isPremium && _bannerAd != null) {
        debugPrint('[BannerAdWidget] Kullanıcı Premium oldu: Reklam anında bellekten kaldırılıyor.');
        _bannerAd?.dispose();
        _bannerAd = null;
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _isLoaded = false;
          });
        }
      }
    });

    final isPremium = ref.watch(premiumProvider).isPremium;

    // Premium ise veya henüz yüklenmediyse yer kaplamaz
    if (isPremium) {
      if (_bannerAd != null) {
        _bannerAd?.dispose();
        _bannerAd = null;
        _isLoaded = false;
      }
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    if (!_isLoaded || _bannerAd == null) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      child: Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF071F1B) : Colors.grey.shade50,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
            width: 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            // Küçük, kibar etiket
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
              child: Text(
                'REKLAM',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 8,
                  letterSpacing: 1.2,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white38 : Colors.grey.shade500,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(
              width: _bannerAd!.size.width.toDouble(),
              height: _bannerAd!.size.height.toDouble(),
              child: AdWidget(ad: _bannerAd!),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

`dart
import 'dart:math' as math;

/// Yakındaki Cami Modeli
class NearbyMosque {
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final double latitude;
  final double longitude;
  final double distanceMeters;
  final String? address;
  final double bearingDegrees; // Kullanıcıdan camiye olan pusula açısı
  final bool isCuratedFallback; // Çevrimdışı yedek veri mi?

  const NearbyMosque({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.latitude,
    required this.longitude,
    required this.distanceMeters,
    this.address,
    this.bearingDegrees = 0.0,
    this.isCuratedFallback = false,
  });

  NearbyMosque copyWith({
    String? id,
    String? name,
    double? latitude,
    double? longitude,
    double? distanceMeters,
    String? address,
    double? bearingDegrees,
    bool? isCuratedFallback,
  }) {
    return NearbyMosque(
      id: id ?? this.id,
      name: name ?? this.name,
      latitude: latitude ?? this.latitude,
      longitude: longitude ?? this.longitude,
      distanceMeters: distanceMeters ?? this.distanceMeters,
      address: address ?? this.address,
      bearingDegrees: bearingDegrees ?? this.bearingDegrees,
      isCuratedFallback: isCuratedFallback ?? this.isCuratedFallback,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id,
    'name': name,
    'lat': latitude,
    'lng': longitude,
    'dist': distanceMeters,
    'addr': address,
    'bearing': bearingDegrees,
    'isFallback': isCuratedFallback,
  };

  factory NearbyMosque.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => NearbyMosque(
    id: json['id'] as String? ?? '',
    name: json['name'] as String? ?? 'Cami',
    latitude: (json['lat'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
    longitude: (json['lng'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
    distanceMeters: (json['dist'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
    address: json['addr'] as String?,
    bearingDegrees: (json['bearing'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0.0,
    isCuratedFallback: json['isFallback'] as bool? ?? false,
  );

  /// Formatlı mesafe metni (Örn: "450 m" veya "1.8 km")
  String get formattedDistance {
    if (distanceMeters < 1000) {
      return '${distanceMeters.round()} m';
    } else {
      return '${(distanceMeters / 1000).toStringAsFixed(1)} km';
    }
  }

  /// Tahmini yürüme süresi (ortalama 5 km/s hız ile)
  int get estimatedWalkingMinutes {
    final minutes = (distanceMeters / 83.33).round();
    return minutes < 1 ? 1 : minutes;
  }

  /// Pusula yönü metni (K, KD, D, GD, G, GB, B, KB)
  String get compassDirection {
    final d = (bearingDegrees + 360) % 360;
    if (d >= 337.5 || d < 22.5) return 'Kuzey (K)';
    if (d >= 22.5 && d < 67.5) return 'Kuzeydoğu (KD)';
    if (d >= 67.5 && d < 112.5) return 'Doğu (D)';
    if (d >= 112.5 && d < 157.5) return 'Güneydoğu (GD)';
    if (d >= 157.5 && d < 202.5) return 'Güney (G)';
    if (d >= 202.5 && d < 247.5) return 'Güneybatı (GB)';
    if (d >= 247.5 && d < 292.5) return 'Batı (B)';
    return 'Kuzeybatı (KB)';
  }

  /// Haversine formülü ile iki koordinat arası metre hesabı
  static double calculateDistanceMeters(
    double lat1,
    double lon1,
    double lat2,
    double lon2,
  ) {
    const r = 6371000.0; // Dünya yarıçapı (metre)
    final dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * math.pi / 180.0;
    final dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * math.pi / 180.0;

    final a = math.sin(dLat / 2) * math.sin(dLat / 2) +
        math.cos(lat1 * math.pi / 180.0) *
            math.cos(lat2 * math.pi / 180.0) *
            math.sin(dLon / 2) *
            math.sin(dLon / 2);

    final c = 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1 - a));
    return r * c;
  }

  /// İki nokta arası pusula açısı hesabı (Bearing)
  static double calculateBearing(
    double lat1,
    double lon1,
    double lat2,
    double lon2,
  ) {
    final phi1 = lat1 * math.pi / 180.0;
    final phi2 = lat2 * math.pi / 180.0;
    final deltaLambda = (lon2 - lon1) * math.pi / 180.0;

    final y = math.sin(deltaLambda) * math.cos(phi2);
    final x = math.cos(phi1) * math.sin(phi2) -
        math.sin(phi1) * math.cos(phi2) * math.cos(deltaLambda);

    final theta = math.atan2(y, x);
    return (theta * 180.0 / math.pi + 360.0) % 360.0;
  }
}

`dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:geolocator/geolocator.dart';
import 'package:geocoding/geocoding.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/app_constants.dart';
import '../../prayer_times/services/prayer_time_service.dart';
import '../models/nearby_mosque_model.dart';
import '../services/nearby_mosques_service.dart';

/// Yakındaki Camiler & Harita Navigasyonu Ekranı
class NearbyMosquesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const NearbyMosquesScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<NearbyMosquesScreen> createState() => _NearbyMosquesScreenState();
}

class _NearbyMosquesScreenState extends State<NearbyMosquesScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _searchCtrl = TextEditingController();
  final NearbyMosquesService _service = NearbyMosquesService.instance;
  StreamSubscription<Position>? _positionSub;

  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isGpsActive = false;
  bool _hasAccurateGpsLock = false;
  double? _gpsAccuracyMeters;
  String _userLocationTitle = 'Canlı GPS konumu alınıyor...';
  double _userLat = AppConstants.defaultLatitude;
  double _userLng = AppConstants.defaultLongitude;

  List<NearbyMosque> _allMosques = [];
  double? _maxDistanceFilter; // null: Tümü, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000
  String _searchQuery = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initSavedLocationAndLoad();
  }

  Future<void> _initSavedLocationAndLoad() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final sLat = prefs.getDouble('beyan_verified_gps_lat');
      final sLng = prefs.getDouble('beyan_verified_gps_lng');
      final sTitle = prefs.getString('beyan_verified_gps_title');
      final isDefaultFallback = sLat != null &&
          sLng != null &&
          (sLat - AppConstants.defaultLatitude).abs() < 0.0005 &&
          (sLng - AppConstants.defaultLongitude).abs() < 0.0005;
      if (sLat != null && sLng != null && !isDefaultFallback && mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _userLat = sLat;
          _userLng = sLng;
          _isGpsActive = true;
          if (sTitle != null && sTitle.isNotEmpty) {
            _userLocationTitle = '$sTitle (Canlı GPS 📍)';
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    _loadNearbyMosques();
  }

  void _startLivePositionStream() {
    _positionSub?.cancel();
    try {
      _positionSub = Geolocator.getPositionStream(
        locationSettings: const LocationSettings(
          accuracy: LocationAccuracy.best,
          distanceFilter: 20,
        ),
      ).listen((pos) async {
        if (!mounted) return;
        // Eğer elimizde yüksek hassasiyetli (<= 45m) bir GPS kilidi varsa ve yeni gelen paket
        // baz istasyonu kaynaklı kaba bir sapmaysa (> 120m hata payı), hassas konumu ezme!
        if (_hasAccurateGpsLock && pos.accuracy > 120) {
          return;
        }
        final movedDist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(
          _userLat,
          _userLng,
          pos.latitude,
          pos.longitude,
        );
        setState(() {
          _userLat = pos.latitude;
          _userLng = pos.longitude;
          _gpsAccuracyMeters = pos.accuracy;
          _isGpsActive = true;
          if (pos.accuracy <= 65) {
            _hasAccurateGpsLock = true;
          }
          if (_allMosques.isNotEmpty) {
            _allMosques = _allMosques.map((m) {
              final d = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(pos.latitude, pos.longitude, m.latitude, m.longitude);
              final b = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(pos.latitude, pos.longitude, m.latitude, m.longitude);
              return m.copyWith(distanceMeters: d, bearingDegrees: b);
            }).toList()
              ..sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters.compareTo(b.distanceMeters));
          }
        });
        // Konum ilk tahminden >120 metre daha hassas bir noktaya oturduysa camileri yeniden tara
        if (movedDist > 120) {
          final mosques = await _service.findNearbyMosques(
            userLat: pos.latitude,
            userLng: pos.longitude,
            radiusMeters: 5000,
            forceRefresh: true,
          );
          if (mounted && mosques.isNotEmpty) {
            setState(() => _allMosques = mosques);
          }
        }
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _positionSub?.cancel();
    _searchCtrl.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadNearbyMosques({bool forceRefresh = false}) async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      // 1. Konum servisleri açık mı kontrol et
      final isServiceEnabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
      if (!isServiceEnabled && mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: const Text('Cihaz konum servisi (GPS) kapalı. Lütfen GPS\'i açın.'),
            action: SnackBarAction(
              label: 'Ayarları Aç',
              textColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              onPressed: () => Geolocator.openLocationSettings(),
            ),
            backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032D26),
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          ),
        );
      }

      // 2. İzin kontrolü ve talep
      LocationPermission perm = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
      if (perm == LocationPermission.denied) {
        perm = await Geolocator.requestPermission();
      }

      if (perm == LocationPermission.deniedForever && mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: const Text('Konum izni kalıcı reddedildi. Ayarlardan izin verin.'),
            action: SnackBarAction(
              label: 'Uygulama İzinleri',
              textColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              onPressed: () => Geolocator.openAppSettings(),
            ),
            backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032D26),
            duration: const Duration(seconds: 5),
          ),
        );
      }

      // 3. YÜKSEK HASSASİYETLİ (BEST ACCURACY) CANLI DONANIM GPS TESPİTİ
      if (perm == LocationPermission.always || perm == LocationPermission.whileInUse) {
        _startLivePositionStream();
        if (!_hasAccurateGpsLock) {
          try {
            final lastPos = await Geolocator.getLastKnownPosition();
            if (lastPos != null && (_gpsAccuracyMeters == null || lastPos.accuracy <= _gpsAccuracyMeters!)) {
              _userLat = lastPos.latitude;
              _userLng = lastPos.longitude;
              _gpsAccuracyMeters = lastPos.accuracy;
              _isGpsActive = true;
              if (lastPos.accuracy <= 65) {
                _hasAccurateGpsLock = true;
              }
            }
          } catch (_) {}
        }

        try {
          final livePos = await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(
            desiredAccuracy: LocationAccuracy.best,
            timeLimit: const Duration(seconds: 8),
          );
          if (!_hasAccurateGpsLock || livePos.accuracy <= (_gpsAccuracyMeters ?? 9999) + 35) {
            _userLat = livePos.latitude;
            _userLng = livePos.longitude;
            _gpsAccuracyMeters = livePos.accuracy;
            _isGpsActive = true;
            if (livePos.accuracy <= 65) {
              _hasAccurateGpsLock = true;
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {
          // Best accuracy zaman aşımına uğrarsa ve henüz hassas kilit yoksa high ile yedek dene
          if (!_hasAccurateGpsLock) {
            try {
              final fallbackPos = await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(
                desiredAccuracy: LocationAccuracy.high,
                timeLimit: const Duration(seconds: 4),
              );
              if (_gpsAccuracyMeters == null || fallbackPos.accuracy <= _gpsAccuracyMeters!) {
                _userLat = fallbackPos.latitude;
                _userLng = fallbackPos.longitude;
                _gpsAccuracyMeters = fallbackPos.accuracy;
                _isGpsActive = true;
                if (fallbackPos.accuracy <= 65) {
                  _hasAccurateGpsLock = true;
                }
              }
            } catch (_) {}
          }
        }
      }

      // 4. GPS hiç alınamamışsa (izin yoksa veya GPS kapalıysa) namaz servisinin şehrini kullan
      if (!_isGpsActive && _userLat == AppConstants.defaultLatitude && _userLng == AppConstants.defaultLongitude) {
        final loc = await PrayerTimeService.instance.getCurrentLocation();
        _userLat = loc.latitude;
        _userLng = loc.longitude;
        _userLocationTitle = '${loc.cityName} (${loc.isFromGPS ? "GPS Konumu 📍" : "Kayıtlı Şehir"})';
        _isGpsActive = loc.isFromGPS;
      }

      // 5. İlçe / Mahalle Ters Jeokodlama (Reverse Geocoding)
      if (_isGpsActive) {
        String readableLocation = 'Canlı GPS Konumu';
        try {
          final placemarks = await placemarkFromCoordinates(_userLat, _userLng).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
          if (placemarks.isNotEmpty) {
            final p = placemarks.first;
            final subLoc = p.subLocality?.trim() ?? '';
            final street = p.thoroughfare?.trim() ?? '';
            final locality = p.locality?.trim() ?? '';
            final subAdmin = p.subAdministrativeArea?.trim() ?? '';
            final admin = p.administrativeArea?.trim() ?? '';

            final neighborhood = subLoc.isNotEmpty ? subLoc : street;
            final district = locality.isNotEmpty ? locality : subAdmin;

            if (neighborhood.isNotEmpty && district.isNotEmpty && neighborhood != district) {
              readableLocation = '$neighborhood, $district';
            } else if (district.isNotEmpty && admin.isNotEmpty && district != admin) {
              readableLocation = '$district, $admin';
            } else if (district.isNotEmpty) {
              readableLocation = district;
            } else if (admin.isNotEmpty) {
              readableLocation = admin;
            }
          }
        } catch (_) {}

        final accStr = _gpsAccuracyMeters != null && _gpsAccuracyMeters! > 0
            ? ' • ±${_gpsAccuracyMeters!.round()}m'
            : '';
        _userLocationTitle = '$readableLocation (Canlı GPS 📍$accStr)';

        // Widget ve konum önbelleğini canlı GPS ile güncelle
        try {
          final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
          await prefs.setDouble('beyan_verified_gps_lat', _userLat);
          await prefs.setDouble('beyan_verified_gps_lng', _userLng);
          await prefs.setString('beyan_verified_gps_title', readableLocation);
          await prefs.setDouble('beyan_widget_lat', _userLat);
          await prefs.setDouble('beyan_widget_lng', _userLng);
          await prefs.setString('beyan_widget_city', readableLocation);
        } catch (_) {}
      }

      // 6. Çevredeki camileri ara (Dar mahalle kutusu + Photon + Overpass paralel)
      final mosques = await _service.findNearbyMosques(
        userLat: _userLat,
        userLng: _userLng,
        radiusMeters: 5000,
        forceRefresh: forceRefresh,
      );

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          // MESAFE ZIPLAMA KORUMASI:
          // Eğer ekranda daha önce gerçek camiler listelenmişse ve yeni dönen liste sadece fallback ise
          // gerçek camileri koru ve mesafelerini anlık konuma göre yeniden hesapla
          if (_allMosques.any((m) => !m.isCuratedFallback) && mosques.every((m) => m.isCuratedFallback)) {
            _allMosques = _allMosques.map((m) {
              final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(_userLat, _userLng, m.latitude, m.longitude);
              final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(_userLat, _userLng, m.latitude, m.longitude);
              return m.copyWith(distanceMeters: dist, bearingDegrees: bearing);
            }).toList()..sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters.compareTo(b.distanceMeters));
          } else {
            _allMosques = mosques;
          }
          _isLoading = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  List<NearbyMosque> get _filteredMosques {
    return _allMosques.where((m) {
      final matchesSearch = _searchQuery.isEmpty ||
          m.name.toLowerCase().contains(_searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
          (m.address ?? '').toLowerCase().contains(_searchQuery.toLowerCase());

      final matchesDist = _maxDistanceFilter == null || m.distanceMeters <= _maxDistanceFilter!;
      return matchesSearch && matchesDist;
    }).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final filtered = _filteredMosques;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011815),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Yakındaki Camiler',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.my_location_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),

              _loadNearbyMosques(forceRefresh: true);
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            // ── 1. Radar Başlık Alanı ─────────────────────────────────
            Container(

                ),

  Widget _buildDistFilterChip(String label, double? dist) {
    final isSelected = _maxDistanceFilter == dist;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
      child: ChoiceChip(
        label: Text(label),
        selected: isSelected,
        onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _maxDistanceFilter = dist),
        selectedColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
        backgroundColor: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
        labelStyle: TextStyle(
          color: isSelected ? Colors.black : Colors.white70,
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
          fontSize: 11.5,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

                Expanded(

                      Text(
                        mosque.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white,
                          fontSize: 14.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        mosque.address ?? 'Yakın Çevre',

                          fontSize: 12,
                        ),
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ],

                ),

                // Mesafe Rozeti
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),

              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),

            // Alt Bilgi Şeridi: Yürüme Süresi, Pusula Yönü ve Yol Tarifi Butonu

              children: [
                // Yürüme Süresi

                const SizedBox(width: 4),
                Text(
                  '~${mosque.estimatedWalkingMinutes} dk',

                // Yön
                Icon(Icons.navigation_rounded, size: 12, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF2DD4BF).withValues(alpha: 0.8)),

                // Yol Tarifi Al Düğmesi (Google Maps / Apple Maps)

                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();

## Dosya: lib/features/mosque_finder/services/nearby_mosques_service.dart

`dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:math' as math;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:url_launcher/url_launcher.dart';
import '../models/nearby_mosque_model.dart';

/// Yakındaki Camileri Arama ve Harita Navigasyon Servisi
class NearbyMosquesService {
  static final NearbyMosquesService instance = NearbyMosquesService._internal();
  factory NearbyMosquesService() => instance;
  NearbyMosquesService._internal();

  static const String _prefCachedMosquesKey = 'beyan_cached_real_mosques_v3';

  // Gerçek yerel camilerin bellek içi önbelleği (kesintisiz stabilite için)
  static final List<NearbyMosque> _inMemoryRealCache = [];
  static DateTime? _lastNetworkFetch;
  static double? _lastCachedLat;
  static double? _lastCachedLng;

  /// Önbelleğe alınmış gerçek yerel camileri kullanıcı koordinatlarına göre yeniden hesaplar
  List<NearbyMosque> _getCachedRealMosques(double userLat, double userLng, double radiusMeters) {
    if (_inMemoryRealCache.isEmpty) return [];

    final list = _inMemoryRealCache.map((m) {
      final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(userLat, userLng, m.latitude, m.longitude);
      final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(userLat, userLng, m.latitude, m.longitude);
      return m.copyWith(distanceMeters: dist, bearingDegrees: bearing);
    }).where((m) => m.distanceMeters <= radiusMeters && !m.isCuratedFallback).toList();

    list.sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters.compareTo(b.distanceMeters));
    return list;
  }

  /// Yeni bulunan gerçek camileri önbelleğe ekler ve mesafeleri günceller
  void _saveToCache(List<NearbyMosque> newMosques, double userLat, double userLng) {
    final realMosques = newMosques.where((m) => !m.isCuratedFallback).toList();
    if (realMosques.isEmpty) return;

    for (final nm in realMosques) {
      final exists = _inMemoryRealCache.any((em) =>
          em.id == nm.id ||
          (em.name.toLowerCase() == nm.name.toLowerCase() &&
              NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(em.latitude, em.longitude, nm.latitude, nm.longitude) < 60));
      if (!exists) {
        _inMemoryRealCache.add(nm);
      }
    }

    _lastNetworkFetch = DateTime.now();
    _lastCachedLat = userLat;
    _lastCachedLng = userLng;

    _persistCacheAsync();
  }

  /// Kalıcı depolamaya arka planda JSON olarak kaydet
  Future<void> _persistCacheAsync() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final jsonList = _inMemoryRealCache.take(60).map((m) => m.toJson()).toList();
      await prefs.setString(_prefCachedMosquesKey, jsonEncode(jsonList));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Uygulama ilk açıldığında kalıcı önbellekten camileri yükle
  Future<void> _loadCacheFromPrefs() async {
    if (_inMemoryRealCache.isNotEmpty) return;
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final raw = prefs.getString(_prefCachedMosquesKey);
      if (raw != null && raw.isNotEmpty) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(raw) as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
        for (final item in decoded) {
          if (item is Map<String, dynamic>) {
            final m = NearbyMosque.fromJson(item);
            if (!m.isCuratedFallback && !_inMemoryRealCache.any((x) => x.id == m.id)) {
              _inMemoryRealCache.add(m);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  /// Verilen koordinatlar etrafındaki camileri bulur.
  /// Arama Sırası:
  /// 1. Gerçek cami önbelleği kontrolü (peş peşe yenilemelerde mesafe zıplamasını ve 429'u önler)
  /// 2. Google Places API (yalnızca geçerli bir Google Maps API anahtarı sağlandıysa)
  /// 3. OpenStreetMap Nominatim Bounded API (kesin koordinat sınırlı, hızlı ve yerel camiler)
  /// 4. Komoot Photon POI API (hızlı OSM arama motoru yedeği)
  /// 5. OpenStreetMap Overpass API (POST istekli harita sunucu yedeği)
  /// 6. Çevrimdışı zengin cami veritabanı (yalnızca hiçbir gerçek cami bulunamazsa)
  Future<List<NearbyMosque>> findNearbyMosques({
    required double userLat,
    required double userLng,
    double radiusMeters = 5000,
    String? googleApiKey,
    bool forceRefresh = false,
  }) async {
    // 0. Kalıcı önbelleği belleğe yükle
    if (_inMemoryRealCache.isEmpty) {
      await _loadCacheFromPrefs();
    }

    final localCached = _getCachedRealMosques(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters);

    // KULLANICI "YENİLE" BUTONUNA BASTIĞINDA:
    // Yalnızca son 10 saniye içinde aynı noktada (<35m) arama yapılmışsa VE
    // önbellekte gerçekten 1.5 km içinde yakın mahalle camileri varsa önbellekten dön:
    final hasCloseMosqueInCache = localCached.any((m) => m.distanceMeters < 1500);
    final hasRecentCache = _lastNetworkFetch != null &&
        DateTime.now().difference(_lastNetworkFetch!).inSeconds < 10 &&
        _lastCachedLat != null &&
        _lastCachedLng != null &&
        NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(userLat, userLng, _lastCachedLat!, _lastCachedLng!) < 35;

    if (!forceRefresh && hasRecentCache && hasCloseMosqueInCache) {
      return localCached;
    }

    final mergedMap = <String, NearbyMosque>{};

    void addMosques(List<NearbyMosque> list) {
      for (final m in list) {
        if (m.distanceMeters > radiusMeters) continue;
        // 55 metre içindeki mükerrer kayıtları birleştir
        final duplicateKey = mergedMap.keys.cast<String?>().firstWhere(
          (k) {
            final existing = mergedMap[k]!;
            final d = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(
              existing.latitude,
              existing.longitude,
              m.latitude,
              m.longitude,
            );
            return d < 55;
          },
          orElse: () => null,
        );
        if (duplicateKey == null) {
          mergedMap[m.id] = m;
        } else {
          final existing = mergedMap[duplicateKey]!;
          // Daha detaylı isme veya adrese sahip olanı tercih et
          if ((existing.name == 'Cami' && m.name != 'Cami') ||
              (existing.address == null && m.address != null)) {
            mergedMap[duplicateKey] = m;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 1. Google Places API (Yalnızca geçerli bir Places anahtarı sağlandıysa)
    if (googleApiKey != null && googleApiKey.trim().isNotEmpty && !googleApiKey.startsWith('AIzaSy')) {
      try {
        final googleMosques = await _fetchFromGooglePlaces(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters, googleApiKey.trim());
        addMosques(googleMosques);
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    // 2. TÜM KAYNAKLARI PARALEL ÇALIŞTIR VE BİRLEŞTİR!
    // (Dar yarıçaplı Nominatim + Photon Yakınlık Motoru ("camii", "cami", "mescit") + Overpass BBox)
    // Böylece tek bir kaynağın 4 km ötedeki ünlü camileri döndürüp mahalle camilerini atlaması %100 önlenir.
    try {
      final parallelBatches = await Future.wait<List<NearbyMosque>>([
        _fetchFromNominatim(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters),
        _fetchFromPhoton(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters),
        _fetchFromOverpass(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters),
      ]);
      for (final batch in parallelBatches) {
        addMosques(batch);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    final liveResults = mergedMap.values.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters.compareTo(b.distanceMeters));

    // 5. SONUÇLARI DEĞERLENDİRME & MESAFE ZIPLAMA KORUMASI:
    if (liveResults.isNotEmpty) {
      _saveToCache(liveResults, userLat, userLng);
      final finalCombined = _getCachedRealMosques(userLat, userLng, radiusMeters);
      if (finalCombined.isNotEmpty) {
        return finalCombined;
      }
      return liveResults;
    }

    // AĞ HATASI / 429 RATE LIMIT / ZAMAN AŞIMI DURUMUNDA:
    // Eğer önbellekte daha önce bulunmuş gerçek yerel camiler varsa,
    // ASLA 4 km uzaktaki seçkin cami listesine düşme! Gerçek camileri koru:
    if (localCached.isNotEmpty) {
      return localCached;
    }

    // 6. Yalnızca ilk açılışta ve hiçbir gerçek veri bulunamadıysa çalışan seçkin camiler
    final fallbackList = _getCuratedFallbackMosques(userLat, userLng);
    fallbackList.sort((a, b) => a.distanceMeters.compareTo(b.distanceMeters));
    return fallbackList;
  }

  /// Bir yerin gerçek bir cami/mescid olup olmadığını filtreler; kilise, havra, sokak ve dükkanları eler
  static bool isMosqueCandidate(String name, String? addressOrDisplayName, {bool isConfirmedWorshipPlace = false}) {
    final lowerName = name.toLowerCase().trim();
    final combined = '$lowerName ${addressOrDisplayName?.toLowerCase() ?? ''}';

    // Gayrimüslim ibadethaneleri, mezarlık/hazire ve cami isimli dükkan/duraklar elenir
    const excludeTerms = [
      'kilise', 'kilisesi', 'church', 'sinagog', 'sinagogu', 'synagogue',
      'havra', 'patrikhane', 'metropolit', 'şapel', 'chapel', 'monastery',
      'manastır', 'katedral', 'cathedral', 'cemevi', 'haziresi', 'mezarlığı',
      'türbesi', 'türbe', 'kafe', 'cafe', 'kahve', 'restoran', 'lokanta',
      'market', 'bakkal', 'eczane', 'ecza', 'otopark', 'durağı', 'istasyonu',
      'apartmanı', 'sitesi', 'ilkokulu', 'ortaokulu', 'lisesi'
    ];
    for (final term in excludeTerms) {
      if (lowerName.contains(term) || combined.contains(term)) return false;
    }

    // Doğrudan isimde İslami ibadethane terimi geçiyorsa kabul et
    const includeTerms = [
      'cami', 'camii', 'mescid', 'mescit', 'mescidi', 'mosque', 'masjid',
      'namazgâh', 'namazgah', 'külliye', 'külliyesi'
    ];
    for (final term in includeTerms) {
      if (lowerName.contains(term)) return true;
    }

    // OSM'de doğrudan place_of_worship olarak işaretlenmişse ve gayrimüslim değilse kabul et
    if (isConfirmedWorshipPlace && lowerName.isNotEmpty) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  /// Google Places API (Nearby Search) ile resmi Google cami verilerini alma
  Future<List<NearbyMosque>> _fetchFromGooglePlaces(
    double lat,
    double lng,
    double radiusMeters,
    String apiKey,
  ) async {
    final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 5);
    try {
      final uri = Uri.parse(
        'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/nearbysearch/json?location=$lat,$lng&radius=$radiusMeters&type=mosque&language=tr&key=$apiKey',
      );
      final request = await client.getUrl(uri);
      final response = await request.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
      if (response.statusCode != HttpStatus.ok) return [];

      final responseBody = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
      final data = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final status = data['status'] as String? ?? '';
      if (status != 'OK') return [];

      final results = data['results'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
      final mosques = <NearbyMosque>[];

      for (final item in results) {
        if (item is! Map<String, dynamic>) continue;
        final geom = item['geometry'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
        final loc = geom?['location'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
        final mLat = (loc?['lat'] as num?)?.toDouble();
        final mLng = (loc?['lng'] as num?)?.toDouble();
        if (mLat == null || mLng == null) continue;

        final name = (item['name'] as String? ?? 'Cami').trim();
        final address = (item['vicinity'] as String? ?? item['formatted_address'] as String?)?.trim();
        if (!isMosqueCandidate(name, address)) continue;

        final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
        final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
        final placeId = (item['place_id'] as String?) ?? '$mLat,$mLng';

        mosques.add(
          NearbyMosque(
            id: placeId,
            name: name,
            latitude: mLat,
            longitude: mLng,
            distanceMeters: dist,
            address: address,
            bearingDegrees: bearing,
          ),
        );
      }
      return mosques;
    } catch (_) {
      return [];
    } finally {
      client.close();
    }
  }

  /// OpenStreetMap Nominatim Kademeli (Önce 1.4 km Dar Mahalle Kutusu, Sonra 4 km Kutu) Sorgusu
  Future<List<NearbyMosque>> _fetchFromNominatim(double lat, double lng, double radiusMeters) async {
    final cosLat = math.cos(lat * math.pi / 180.0);
    final safeCos = cosLat.abs() < 0.001 ? 1.0 : cosLat.abs();

    // 1. Kademe: Kullanıcının hemen etrafındaki 1.4 km'lik mahalle kutusu!
    // (Böylece Nominatim 4 km ötedeki büyük camileri değil, 50m-1km içindeki tüm mahalle camilerini döndürür)
    const tightDeltaLat = 1.4 / 111.0;
    final tightDeltaLng = 1.4 / (111.0 * safeCos);

    // 2. Kademe: 3.8 km'lik orta kutu
    final medKm = math.min(radiusMeters / 1000.0, 3.8);
    final medDeltaLat = medKm / 111.0;
    final medDeltaLng = medKm / (111.0 * safeCos);

    final urls = <String>[
      // Dar 1.4 km kutuda tüm ibadethaneler (en yakın mahalle cami ve mescitleri):
      'https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=[amenity=place_of_worship]&limit=50'
          '&viewbox=${lng - tightDeltaLng},${lat + tightDeltaLat},${lng + tightDeltaLng},${lat - tightDeltaLat}&bounded=1&addressdetails=1',
      // Orta 3.8 km kutuda "camii" ve "cami":
      'https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?format=json&q=camii&limit=50'
          '&viewbox=${lng - medDeltaLng},${lat + medDeltaLat},${lng + medDeltaLng},${lat - medDeltaLat}&bounded=1&addressdetails=1',
    ];

    final allResults = <NearbyMosque>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0) {
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 950));
      }
      final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 5);
      try {
        final request = await client.getUrl(Uri.parse(urls[i]));
        request.headers.set('User-Agent', 'BeyanIslamicApp/2.0 (https://beyan.app)');
        final response = await request.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 6));
        if (response.statusCode == HttpStatus.ok) {
          final responseBody = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
          final list = jsonDecode(responseBody) as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
          allResults.addAll(_parseNominatimResults(list, lat, lng));
        }
      } catch (_) {
      } finally {
        client.close();
      }
    }
    return allResults;
  }

  List<NearbyMosque> _parseNominatimResults(List<dynamic> list, double lat, double lng) {
    final results = <NearbyMosque>[];
    final seenIds = <String>{};

    for (final el in list) {
      if (el is! Map<String, dynamic>) continue;
      final osmClass = (el['class'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase();
      final osmType = (el['type'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase();
      if (osmClass == 'highway' || osmClass == 'shop' || osmClass == 'public_transport') {
        continue;
      }

      final rawLat = el['lat'];
      final rawLng = el['lon'];
      if (rawLat == null || rawLng == null) continue;

      final mLat = double.tryParse('$rawLat');
      final mLng = double.tryParse('$rawLng');
      if (mLat == null || mLng == null || (mLat == 0.0 && mLng == 0.0)) continue;

      final rawName = (el['name'] as String? ?? '').trim();
      final displayName = (el['display_name'] as String? ?? '').trim();
      final name = rawName.isNotEmpty
          ? rawName
          : (displayName.split(',').first.trim().isNotEmpty ? displayName.split(',').first.trim() : 'Cami');

      final isWorship = osmType == 'place_of_worship' || osmType == 'mosque';
      if (!isMosqueCandidate(name, displayName, isConfirmedWorshipPlace: isWorship)) continue;

      // Detaylı adres ayrıştırma
      String? address;
      final addrMap = el['address'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      if (addrMap != null) {
        final parts = <String>[];
        if (addrMap['road'] != null) parts.add('${addrMap['road']}');
        if (addrMap['neighbourhood'] != null) {
          parts.add('${addrMap['neighbourhood']}');
        } else if (addrMap['suburb'] != null) {
          parts.add('${addrMap['suburb']}');
        }
        if (addrMap['city_district'] != null) {
          parts.add('${addrMap['city_district']}');
        } else if (addrMap['city'] != null) {
          parts.add('${addrMap['city']}');
        }
        if (parts.isNotEmpty) address = parts.join(', ');
      }
      if (address == null || address.isEmpty) {
        final parts = displayName.split(',');
        if (parts.length > 1) {
          address = parts.skip(1).take(2).map((s) => s.trim()).join(', ');
        }
      }

      final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
      final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
      final id = '${el['place_id'] ?? '${mLat.toStringAsFixed(4)},${mLng.toStringAsFixed(4)}'}';

      if (seenIds.add(id)) {
        results.add(
          NearbyMosque(
            id: id,
            name: name,
            latitude: mLat,
            longitude: mLng,
            distanceMeters: dist,
            address: address,
            bearingDegrees: bearing,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  /// Komoot Photon POI API Sorgusu ("camii", "cami", "mescit", "mosque" paralel yakınlık araması)
  /// Not: Türkiye'de camilerin %90'ı "X Camii" (çift i) olarak kayıtlı olduğundan hem "camii" hem "cami" sorgulanır!
  Future<List<NearbyMosque>> _fetchFromPhoton(double lat, double lng, double radiusMeters) async {
    const queries = ['camii', 'cami', 'mescit', 'mescidi', 'mosque'];
    final results = <NearbyMosque>[];
    final seenIds = <String>{};

    final batches = await Future.wait<List<dynamic>>(
      queries.map((q) async {
        final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 4);
        try {
          final uri = Uri.parse('https://photon.komoot.io/api/?q=$q&lat=$lat&lon=$lng&limit=50');
          final request = await client.getUrl(uri);
          request.headers.set('User-Agent', 'BeyanIslamicApp/2.0 (https://beyan.app)');
          final response = await request.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 5));
          if (response.statusCode != HttpStatus.ok) return const [];
          final body = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
          final data = jsonDecode(body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
          return data['features'] as List<dynamic>? ?? const [];
        } catch (_) {
          return const [];
        } finally {
          client.close();
        }
      }),
    );

    for (final features in batches) {
      for (final f in features) {
        if (f is! Map<String, dynamic>) continue;
        final geom = f['geometry'] as Map<String, dynamic>?;
        final coords = geom?['coordinates'] as List<dynamic>?;
        if (coords == null || coords.length < 2) continue;

        final mLng = (coords[0] as num).toDouble();
        final mLat = (coords[1] as num).toDouble();
        final props = f['properties'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};

        final osmKey = (props['osm_key'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase();
        final osmValue = (props['osm_value'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase();
        // "Cami Sokak" gibi sokakları, otobüs duraklarını ve dükkanları ele
        if (osmKey == 'highway' || osmKey == 'shop' || osmKey == 'railway' || osmKey == 'public_transport') {
          continue;
        }

        final name = (props['name'] as String? ?? '').trim();
        if (name.isEmpty) continue;
        final street = props['street'] as String?;
        final district = props['district'] as String? ?? props['city'] as String?;
        final address = street != null ? '$street, ${district ?? ''}'.trim() : district;

        final isWorship = osmValue == 'place_of_worship' || osmValue == 'mosque';
        if (!isMosqueCandidate(name, address, isConfirmedWorshipPlace: isWorship)) continue;

        final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
        if (dist > radiusMeters) continue;

        final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
        final id = '${props['osm_id'] ?? '${mLat.toStringAsFixed(4)},${mLng.toStringAsFixed(4)}'}';

        if (seenIds.add(id)) {
          results.add(
            NearbyMosque(
              id: id,
              name: name,
              latitude: mLat,
              longitude: mLng,
              distanceMeters: dist,
              address: address,
              bearingDegrees: bearing,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  /// OpenStreetMap Overpass API sorgusu (Hızlı Bounding-Box ile 2.5 km içindeki tüm cami ve mescitler)
  Future<List<NearbyMosque>> _fetchFromOverpass(double lat, double lng, double radius) async {
    final boxKm = math.min(radius / 1000.0, 2.5);
    final dLat = boxKm / 111.0;
    final cosLat = math.cos(lat * math.pi / 180.0);
    final dLng = boxKm / (111.0 * (cosLat.abs() < 0.001 ? 1.0 : cosLat.abs()));
    final minLat = (lat - dLat).toStringAsFixed(5);
    final minLng = (lng - dLng).toStringAsFixed(5);
    final maxLat = (lat + dLat).toStringAsFixed(5);
    final maxLng = (lng + dLng).toStringAsFixed(5);

    final query = '[out:json][timeout:4];(nwr["amenity"="place_of_worship"]($minLat,$minLng,$maxLat,$maxLng););out center 60;';

    final endpoints = [
      'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
      'https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter',
    ];

    for (final ep in endpoints) {
      final client = HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 3);
      try {
        final request = await client.postUrl(Uri.parse(ep));
        request.headers.set('User-Agent', 'BeyanIslamicApp/2.0 (https://beyan.app)');
        request.headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded');
        request.write('data=${Uri.encodeQueryComponent(query)}');

        final response = await request.close().timeout(const Duration(seconds: 4));
        if (response.statusCode != HttpStatus.ok) continue;

        final responseBody = await response.transform(utf8.decoder).join();
        final data = jsonDecode(responseBody) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final elements = data['elements'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
        final result = <NearbyMosque>[];

        for (final el in elements) {
          if (el is! Map<String, dynamic>) continue;
          final tags = el['tags'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
          final religion = (tags['religion'] as String? ?? '').toLowerCase();
          if (religion.isNotEmpty && religion != 'muslim' && religion != 'islam') continue;

          final name = (tags['name'] as String? ?? tags['name:tr'] as String? ?? 'Cami').trim();
          final street = tags['addr:street'] as String?;
          final district = tags['addr:district'] as String? ?? tags['addr:city'] as String?;
          final address = street != null ? '$street, ${district ?? ''}'.trim() : district;

          if (!isMosqueCandidate(name, address, isConfirmedWorshipPlace: true)) continue;

          double mLat = 0.0;
          double mLng = 0.0;
          if (el['lat'] != null && el['lon'] != null) {
            mLat = (el['lat'] as num).toDouble();
            mLng = (el['lon'] as num).toDouble();
          } else if (el['center'] != null) {
            mLat = (el['center']['lat'] as num).toDouble();
            mLng = (el['center']['lon'] as num).toDouble();
          }
          if (mLat == 0.0 || mLng == 0.0) continue;

          final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);
          if (dist > radius) continue;
          final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(lat, lng, mLat, mLng);

          result.add(
            NearbyMosque(
              id: '${el['id']}',
              name: name,
              latitude: mLat,
              longitude: mLng,
              distanceMeters: dist,
              address: address,
              bearingDegrees: bearing,
            ),
          );
        }

        if (result.isNotEmpty) return result;
      } catch (_) {
      } finally {
        client.close();
      }
    }
    return [];
  }

  /// Google Haritalar veya Apple Haritalar uygulamasında çevredeki tüm camileri arama
  Future<void> openAllNearbyMosquesInMaps({
    required double userLat,
    required double userLng,
  }) async {
    // 1. Google Maps uygulaması yüklüyse doğrudan aç
    final googleAppUri = Uri.parse('comgooglemaps://?q=cami&center=$userLat,$userLng&zoom=15');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(googleAppUri)) {
      await launchUrl(googleAppUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Google Maps evrensel web URL'si
    final googleMapsUri = Uri.parse('https://www.google.com/maps/search/cami/@$userLat,$userLng,15z');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(googleMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(googleMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 3. Apple Maps arama (iOS Haritalar doğrudan çevredeki camileri döker)
    final appleMapsUri = Uri.parse('maps://?q=cami&sll=$userLat,$userLng');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(appleMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(appleMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 4. Web Apple Maps evrensel bağlantı
    final webMapsUri = Uri.parse('https://maps.apple.com/?q=cami&sll=$userLat,$userLng');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(webMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(webMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    }
  }

  /// Google Haritalar'da çevredeki tüm camileri doğrudan canlı arama
  Future<void> openGoogleMapsNearby({
    required double userLat,
    required double userLng,
  }) async {
    await openAllNearbyMosquesInMaps(userLat: userLat, userLng: userLng);
  }

  /// Haritalarda Belli Bir Camiye Yürüme Rotası Açma (Önce Google Maps, sonra Apple Maps)
  Future<void> openWalkingDirections({
    required double lat,
    required double lng,
    required String mosqueName,
  }) async {
    // 1. Google Maps uygulaması yüklüyse
    final googleAppUri = Uri.parse('comgooglemaps://?daddr=$lat,$lng&directionsmode=walking');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(googleAppUri)) {
      await launchUrl(googleAppUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Google Maps evrensel web navigasyon linki
    final googleMapsUri = Uri.parse('https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=$lat,$lng&travelmode=walking');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(googleMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(googleMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 3. Apple Maps yürüme rotası: maps://?daddr=lat,lng&dirflg=w
    final appleMapsUri = Uri.parse('maps://?daddr=$lat,$lng&dirflg=w');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(appleMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(appleMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
      return;
    }

    // 4. Web tabanlı harita linki
    final webMapsUri = Uri.parse('https://maps.apple.com/?daddr=$lat,$lng&dirflg=w');
    if (await canLaunchUrl(webMapsUri)) {
      await launchUrl(webMapsUri, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
    }
  }

  /// İnternet olmasa dahi çalışan zengin seçkin cami veritabanı (isCuratedFallback: true)

      {'name': 'Mescid-i Aksâ', 'lat': 31.7761, 'lng': 35.2358, 'addr': 'Kudüs-ü Şerif'},
    ];

    return rawList.map((item) {
      final mLat = item['lat'] as double;
      final mLng = item['lng'] as double;
      final dist = NearbyMosque.calculateDistanceMeters(userLat, userLng, mLat, mLng);
      final bearing = NearbyMosque.calculateBearing(userLat, userLng, mLat, mLng);

      return NearbyMosque(
        id: item['name'] as String,
        name: item['name'] as String,
        latitude: mLat,
        longitude: mLng,
        distanceMeters: dist,
        address: item['addr'] as String,
        bearingDegrees: bearing,
        isCuratedFallback: true,
      );
    }).toList();
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

/// Ezan makamları ve ses tonu seçenekleri.
enum AdhanMakam {
  /// Sabah Vakti - Sabâ Makamı (Uyanış ve derin huşû)
  saba,

  rast,

  /// İkindi Vakti - Hicaz / İstanbul Makamı (Geleneksel vakarlı Türk ezanı)
  istanbul,

  /// Akşam Vakti - Segâh Makamı (Günün batışında huzur ve teslimiyet)
  segah,

  /// Yatsı Vakti - Uşşak Makamı (Geceye hazırlayan sükunet ve teskin)
  ussak,

  /// Kâbe-i Muazzama / Mekke-i Mükerreme Makamı
  mecca,

  /// Mescid-i Nebevî / Medine-i Münevvere Makamı
  medina,

  /// Kısa Sade Tekbir (İş ve toplantı ortamları için nezaketli ton)
  tekbir,

  bell,

  silent,
}

## Dosya: lib/features/notifications/models/short_verse_notification.dart

`dart
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'id_verse_translations.dart';

/// Kısa, Öz ve İlham Verici Âyet Bildirim Modeli (TR, EN, AR)
class ShortVerseNotification {
  final String surahNameTr;
  final String surahNameEn;
  final String surahNameAr;
  final String verseReference;
  final String arabicText;
  final String textTr;
  final String textEn;
  final String textAr;

  const ShortVerseNotification({
    required this.surahNameTr,
    required this.surahNameEn,
    required this.surahNameAr,
    required this.verseReference,
    required this.arabicText,
    required this.textTr,
    required this.textEn,
    required this.textAr,
  });

  /// Seçili dile göre kısa ve vurucu meal metnini döner
  String localizedText(String langCode) {
    if (langCode == 'ar' || langCode == 'ur') return textAr;
    if (langCode == 'id') {
      return kIndonesianShortVerses[verseReference] ?? textEn;
    }
    if (langCode == 'en' || langCode == 'fr' || langCode == 'de' || langCode == 'ru') {
      return textEn;
    }
    return textTr;
  }

  /// Seçili dile göre sûre ve âyet referansını döner (örn: Ash-Sharh 94:5-6)
  String localizedReference(String langCode) {
    final parts = verseReference.split(' ');
    final nums = parts.length > 1 ? parts.sublist(1).join(' ') : '';
    if (langCode == 'ar' || langCode == 'ur') {
      final cleanSurah = surahNameAr.replaceAll('سورة ', '');
      return nums.isNotEmpty ? '$cleanSurah $nums' : surahNameAr;
    }
    if (langCode != 'tr') {
      final cleanSurah = surahNameEn.replaceAll('Surah ', '');
      return nums.isNotEmpty ? '$cleanSurah $nums' : surahNameEn;
    }
    return verseReference;
  }

  /// Seçili dile göre bildirim başlığını döner
  String localizedTitle(String langCode, {bool isEvening = false}) {
    final ref = localizedReference(langCode);
    if (isEvening) {
      if (langCode == 'en') return 'Evening Reflection 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'ar') return 'تأمل المساء 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'id') return 'Renungan Malam 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'fr') return 'Méditation du Soir 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'ur') return 'شام کی فکر 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'de') return 'Abend-Besinnung 🌙 $ref';
      if (langCode == 'ru') return 'Вечернее размышление 🌙 $ref';
      return 'Akşam Tefekkürü 🌙 $ref';
    }
    if (langCode == 'en') return 'Verse of the Day 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'ar') return 'آية اليوم 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'id') return 'Ayat Hari Ini 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'fr') return 'Verset du Jour 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'ur') return 'آج کی آیت 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'de') return 'Vers des Tages 📖 $ref';
    if (langCode == 'ru') return 'Аят Дня 📖 $ref';
    return 'Günün Âyeti 📖 $ref';
  }

  static int _rotationCounter = 0;

  /// Test veya anlık gönderimlerde her tıklamada sırayla ve KESİNLİKLE FARKLI bir ayet seçer.
  static Future<ShortVerseNotification> getNextRotatingVerse() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      int lastIndex = prefs.getInt('beyan_last_verse_notif_idx') ?? 0;
      final nextIndex = (lastIndex + 1) % pool.length;
      await prefs.setInt('beyan_last_verse_notif_idx', nextIndex);
      return pool[nextIndex];
    } catch (_) {
      _rotationCounter = (_rotationCounter + 1) % pool.length;
      return pool[_rotationCounter];
    }
  }

  /// Belirli bir indeksteki kısa ayeti döner (zamanlamalar için)
  static ShortVerseNotification getByIndex(int index) {
    return pool[index.abs() % pool.length];
  }

  /// Önümüzdeki n gün veya saat için ASLA TEKRAR ETMEYEN eşsiz bir ayet listesi üretir.
  /// Son 60 gönderilmiş ayet geçmişini SharedPreferences'ta saklayarak mükerrerliği %100 önler.
  static Future<List<ShortVerseNotification>> getNonRepeatingBatch(int count) async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      List<String> rawHistory = prefs.getStringList('beyan_verse_history_indices') ?? [];
      List<int> history = rawHistory.map((s) => int.tryParse(s) ?? 0).toList();

      List<ShortVerseNotification> result = [];
      List<int> newlyPicked = [];

      // Havuz içinde geçmişte OLMAYAN indeksleri bul
      List<int> available = [];
      for (int i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
        if (!history.contains(i)) {
          available.add(i);
        }
      }

      // Eğer kalan ayet sayısı istenen sayıdan azsa geçmişi sıfırla/döndür
      if (available.length < count) {
        history.clear();
        available = List.generate(pool.length, (i) => i);
      }

      // Deterministik ama düzenli sırada ilerle
      int cursor = prefs.getInt('beyan_batch_cursor') ?? 0;
      for (int step = 0; step < count; step++) {
        final pickIndex = available[(cursor + step) % available.length];
        result.add(pool[pickIndex]);
        newlyPicked.add(pickIndex);
      }

      // Geçmişe ekle ve son 60 kayıtta sınırla
      history.addAll(newlyPicked);
      if (history.length > 60) {
        history = history.sublist(history.length - 60);
      }

      await prefs.setStringList('beyan_verse_history_indices', history.map((e) => e.toString()).toList());
      await prefs.setInt('beyan_batch_cursor', (cursor + count) % pool.length);

      return result;
    } catch (_) {
      // Fallback
      return List.generate(count, (i) => pool[(i * 3) % pool.length]);
    }
  }

    ),

## Dosya: lib/features/notifications/screens/adhan_makam_selector_sheet.dart

`dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/theme_provider.dart';
import '../models/adhan_makam.dart';
import '../services/adhan_audio_player_service.dart';
import '../services/notification_service.dart';

/// Ezan Makamları Seçim ve Önizleme Dinleme Ekranı
class AdhanMakamSelectorSheet extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const AdhanMakamSelectorSheet({super.key});

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) => const AdhanMakamSelectorSheet(),
    );
  }

  @override
  ConsumerState<AdhanMakamSelectorSheet> createState() =>
      _AdhanMakamSelectorSheetState();
}

class _AdhanMakamSelectorSheetState
    extends ConsumerState<AdhanMakamSelectorSheet> {
  final _audioService = AdhanAudioPlayerService.instance;
  StreamSubscription<AdhanMakam?>? _playingSub;
  AdhanMakam _selectedMakam = AdhanMakam.istanbul;
  AdhanMakam? _playingMakam;
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSelectedMakam();
    _playingSub = _audioService.currentlyPlayingStream.listen((makam) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _playingMakam = makam);
      }
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadSelectedMakam() async {
    final makam = await NotificationService.instance.getSelectedMakam();
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedMakam = makam;
        _isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _playingSub?.cancel();
    _audioService.stop();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final themeState = ref.watch(themeProvider);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final gold = themeState.palette.accentGold;
    final bg = isDark ? themeState.palette.darkSurface : Colors.white;

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: bg,
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.35),
            blurRadius: 30,
            offset: const Offset(0, -10),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 12, 20, 32),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // Çekme çubuğu
          Center(
            child: Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 5,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? Colors.white24 : Colors.black12,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2.5),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),

          // Başlık
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: gold.withValues(alpha: 0.18),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                ),
                child: Icon(Icons.music_note_rounded, color: gold, size: 22),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      strings.adhanMakamsAndAudio,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                        fontSize: 22,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white : AppColors.textPrimary,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      strings.adhanMakamsDesc,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 14),

          if (_isLoading)
            const Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(32.0),
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
              ),
            )
          else
            Flexible(
              child: ListView(
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                children: AdhanMakam.values.map((makam) {
                  final isSelected = _selectedMakam == makam;
                  final isPlaying = _playingMakam == makam;

                  return _buildMakamCard(
                    makam: makam,
                    isSelected: isSelected,
                    isPlaying: isPlaying,
                    gold: gold,
                    isDark: isDark,
                    strings: strings,
                  );
                }).toList(),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMakamCard({
    required AdhanMakam makam,
    required bool isSelected,
    required bool isPlaying,
    required Color gold,
    required bool isDark,
    required AppStrings strings,
  }) {
    final borderColor = isSelected
        ? gold
        : (isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08) : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.08));

    final cardBg = isDark
        ? (isSelected ? gold.withValues(alpha: 0.12) : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.03))
        : (isSelected ? gold.withValues(alpha: 0.10) : Colors.white);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () async {
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
          setState(() => _selectedMakam = makam);
          await NotificationService.instance.setSelectedMakam(makam);
        },
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: cardBg,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: isSelected ? 1.8 : 1),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              // Sol İkon
              Container(
                width: 40,
                height: 40,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isSelected
                      ? gold.withValues(alpha: 0.2)
                      : (isDark ? Colors.white10 : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.04)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
                child: Icon(
                  makam.icon,
                  color: isSelected ? gold : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black54),
                  size: 20,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),

              // Bilgi
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Flexible(
                          child: Text(
                            makam.localizedTitle(strings.language.code),
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 14.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: isDark ? Colors.white : AppColors.textPrimary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (makam.vakitTag != null) ...[
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 1.5),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: gold.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withValues(alpha: 0.4), width: 0.8),
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              makam.vakitTag!,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 9.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: gold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      makam.localizedDescription(strings.language.code),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white60 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // Dinle / Önizleme Butonu (Sessiz hariç - PRO dahil herkes dinleyebilir)
              if (makam != AdhanMakam.silent)
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: isPlaying ? strings.stopAudio : strings.listenAudio,
                  icon: AnimatedSwitcher(
                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
                    child: Container(
                      key: ValueKey(isPlaying),
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                      decoration: isPlaying
                          ? BoxDecoration(
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                              color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                              boxShadow: [
                                BoxShadow(
                                  color: Colors.amber.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                                  blurRadius: 8,
                                ),
                              ],
                            )
                          : null,
                      child: Icon(
                        isPlaying ? Icons.stop_circle_rounded : Icons.play_circle_outline_rounded,
                        color: isPlaying ? Colors.amber : gold,
                        size: 28,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  onPressed: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    _audioService.togglePlayPreview(makam);
                  },
                ),

              // Seçili Onayı
              if (isSelected)
                Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 4),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: gold,
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.check,
                    color: Colors.black,
                    size: 14,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
