      'وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ\n'
      'اللّٰهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ '
      'وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ';
  static const _arRabbena =
      'رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ\n'
      'رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ';
  static const _arSelam = 'السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللّٰهِ';

  // ── Adım Üreticileri ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  static PrayerHowToStep _fatihaStep(AppLanguage lang, {required String title, required String desc}) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: title,
      description: desc,
      arabic: _arFatiha,
      transliteration: _translit(
        lang,
        'Elhamdü lillâhi rabbil\'âlemîn. Errahmânir\'rahîm. Mâliki yevmiddîn. '
            'İyyâke na\'büdü ve iyyâke neste\'în. İhdinas\'sırâtel müstakîm. '
            'Sırâtellezîne en\'amte aleyhim ğayril mağdûbi aleyhim ve leddâllîn. (Âmîn)',
        'Al-hamdu lillahi rabbil-\'alamin. Ar-rahmanir-rahim. Maliki yawmid-din. '
            'Iyyaka na\'budu wa iyyaka nasta\'in. Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim. '
            'Siratal-ladhina an\'amta \'alayhim ghayril-maghdubi \'alayhim wa lad-dallin. (Amin)',
      ),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'Hamd, âlemlerin Rabbi, Rahmân ve Rahîm, din gününün sahibi Allah\'a mahsustur. '
            'Yalnız Sana ibadet eder, yalnız Senden yardım dileriz. Bizi doğru yola ilet; '
            'nimet verdiklerinin yoluna, gazaba uğrayanların ve sapanların yoluna değil.',
        'All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful, '
            'Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help. '
            'Guide us to the straight path, the path of those You have blessed, '
            'not of those who earned Your anger nor of those who went astray.',
        'Segala puji bagi Allah, Tuhan seluruh alam, Yang Maha Pengasih, Maha Penyayang, '
            'Pemilik hari pembalasan. Hanya kepada-Mu kami menyembah dan hanya kepada-Mu kami memohon pertolongan. '
            'Tunjukilah kami jalan yang lurus, jalan orang-orang yang Engkau beri nikmat, '
            'bukan jalan mereka yang dimurkai dan bukan pula jalan mereka yang sesat.',
      ),
    );
  }

  static PrayerHowToStep _zammStep(AppLanguage lang, String title) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: title,
      description: _l(
        lang,
        'Fâtiha\'dan sonra Kur\'an\'dan en az üç kısa âyet veya bir kısa sûre okunur. Örnek: İhlâs Sûresi.',
        'After Al-Fatiha, recite at least three short verses or a short surah. Example: Surah Al-Ikhlas.',
        'Setelah Al-Fatihah, bacalah minimal tiga ayat pendek atau satu surah pendek. Contoh: Surah Al-Ikhlas.',
        'بعد الفاتحة تُقرأ ثلاث آيات قصيرة على الأقل أو سورة قصيرة. مثال: سورة الإخلاص.',
      ),
      arabic: _arIhlas,
      transliteration: _translit(
        lang,
        'Kul hüvallâhü ehad. Allâhüssamed. Lem yelid ve lem yûled. Ve lem yekün lehû küfüven ehad.',
        'Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.',
      ),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'De ki: O, Allah\'tır, bir tektir. Allah Samed\'dir (her şey O\'na muhtaçtır). '
            'O doğurmamış ve doğurulmamıştır. Hiçbir şey O\'na denk değildir.',
        'Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, '
            'and there is none comparable to Him.',
        'Katakanlah: Dialah Allah, Yang Maha Esa. Allah tempat meminta segala sesuatu. '
            'Dia tidak beranak dan tidak diperanakkan, dan tidak ada sesuatu pun yang setara dengan-Nya.',
      ),
    );
  }

  static PrayerHowToStep _rukuStep(AppLanguage lang) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: _l(lang, 'Rükû', 'Ruku (Bowing)', 'Rukuk', 'الركوع'),
      description: _l(
        lang,
        '"Allâhu Ekber" diyerek eğilinir. Eller dizlere konur, sırt ve baş düz tutulur. '
            'Gözler ayak uçlarına bakar ve en az 3 kez okunur:',
        'Say "Allahu Akbar" and bow. Place your hands on your knees, keep your back and head level, '
            'look at your feet and recite at least 3 times:',
        'Ucapkan "Allahu Akbar" lalu membungkuk. Letakkan tangan di lutut, punggung dan kepala lurus, '
            'pandangan ke ujung kaki, lalu baca minimal 3 kali:',
        'يُكبّر وينحني واضعًا يديه على ركبتيه مستوي الظهر والرأس، وينظر إلى قدميه ويقول ثلاثًا على الأقل:',
      ),
      arabic: _arRuku,
      transliteration: _translit(lang, 'Sübhâne rabbiyel azîm (3 kez)', 'Subhana rabbiyal-\'azim (3 times)'),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'Yüce Rabbimi her türlü noksanlıktan tenzih ederim.',
        'Glory be to my Lord, the Magnificent.',
        'Maha Suci Tuhanku Yang Maha Agung.',
      ),
      note: _l(
        lang,
        'Kadınlar erkeklere göre daha az eğilir; parmaklar bitişik olarak dizler üzerine konur.',
        'Women bow slightly less deeply, with fingers together on the knees.',
        'Perempuan membungkuk sedikit lebih ringan, dengan jari-jari rapat di atas lutut.',
        'تنحني المرأة أقل من الرجل، وتضع يديها على ركبتيها مضمومة الأصابع.',
      ),
    );
  }

  static PrayerHowToStep _kavmeStep(AppLanguage lang) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: _l(lang, 'Rükûdan Doğrulma (Kavme)', 'Rising from Ruku (Qawmah)', 'I\'tidal', 'الرفع من الركوع'),
      description: _l(
        lang,
        'Rükûdan kalkarken "Semi\'allâhü limen hamideh" denir, tam doğrulunca "Rabbenâ lekel hamd" denir.',
        'While rising say "Sami\'allahu liman hamidah", and once fully upright say "Rabbana lakal-hamd".',
        'Saat bangkit ucapkan "Sami\'allahu liman hamidah", setelah tegak sempurna ucapkan "Rabbana lakal-hamd".',
        'يقول عند الرفع: سمع الله لمن حمده، فإذا استوى قائمًا قال: ربنا لك الحمد.',
      ),
      arabic: _arKavme,
      transliteration: _translit(
        lang,
        'Semi\'allâhü limen hamideh. Rabbenâ lekel hamd.',
        'Sami\'allahu liman hamidah. Rabbana lakal-hamd.',
      ),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'Allah, kendisine hamd edeni işitir. Rabbimiz! Hamd yalnız Sana mahsustur.',
        'Allah hears the one who praises Him. Our Lord, all praise is Yours.',
        'Allah mendengar orang yang memuji-Nya. Ya Tuhan kami, segala puji bagi-Mu.',
      ),
    );
  }

  static PrayerHowToStep _secdeStep(AppLanguage lang) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: _l(lang, 'İki Secde', 'Two Prostrations (Sujud)', 'Dua Kali Sujud', 'السجدتان'),
      description: _l(
        lang,
        '"Allâhu Ekber" diyerek secdeye varılır: önce dizler, sonra eller, sonra burun ve alın yere konur. '
            'En az 3 kez okunur. Sonra "Allâhu Ekber" ile oturulur (celse), bir an durulur ve ikinci secdeye '
            'varılıp aynı tesbih tekrar okunur.',
        'Say "Allahu Akbar" and prostrate: knees first, then hands, then nose and forehead on the ground. '
            'Recite at least 3 times. Then sit up briefly with "Allahu Akbar" (jalsah) and perform the second '
            'prostration in the same way.',
        'Ucapkan "Allahu Akbar" lalu sujud: lutut dulu, kemudian tangan, lalu hidung dan dahi menyentuh lantai. '
            'Baca minimal 3 kali. Lalu duduk sejenak dengan "Allahu Akbar" dan lakukan sujud kedua dengan cara yang sama.',
        'يكبّر ويسجد واضعًا ركبتيه ثم يديه ثم أنفه وجبهته، ويسبّح ثلاثًا على الأقل، ثم يجلس مكبّرًا '
            'جلسة خفيفة، ثم يسجد السجدة الثانية كالأولى.',
      ),
      arabic: _arSecde,
      transliteration: _translit(lang, 'Sübhâne rabbiyel a\'lâ (3 kez)', 'Subhana rabbiyal-a\'la (3 times)'),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'En yüce olan Rabbimi her türlü noksanlıktan tenzih ederim.',
        'Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.',
        'Maha Suci Tuhanku Yang Maha Tinggi.',
      ),
      note: _l(
        lang,
        'Erkekler kollarını yanlardan ayırır; kadınlar kollarını yanlarına ve karınlarını uyluklarına yaklaştırarak secde eder.',
        'Men keep their arms away from their sides; women keep their arms close and abdomen near the thighs.',
        'Laki-laki merenggangkan lengan dari lambung; perempuan merapatkan lengan dan perut ke paha.',
        'يُجافي الرجل عضديه عن جنبيه، وتضمّ المرأة عضديها وتُلصق بطنها بفخذيها.',
      ),
    );
  }

  static PrayerHowToStep _tehiyyatStep(AppLanguage lang, {required bool isFinal}) {
    return PrayerHowToStep(
      title: isFinal
          ? _l(lang, 'Son Oturuş (Ka\'de-i Âhire)', 'Final Sitting (Tashahhud)', 'Tasyahud Akhir', 'القعود الأخير')
          : _l(lang, 'İlk Oturuş (Ka\'de-i Ûlâ)', 'First Sitting (Tashahhud)', 'Tasyahud Awal', 'القعود الأول'),
      description: isFinal
          ? _l(
              lang,
              'Son rekatın ikinci secdesinden sonra oturulur ve sırasıyla Ettehiyyâtü, Allâhümme Salli, '
                  'Allâhümme Bârik ve Rabbenâ duaları okunur.',
              'After the second prostration of the last rak\'ah, sit and recite At-Tahiyyat, '
                  'then the Salawat (Allahumma Salli & Barik) and the Rabbana supplications.',
              'Setelah sujud kedua di rakaat terakhir, duduk lalu membaca Tahiyyat, Shalawat '
                  '(Allahumma Shalli & Barik), dan doa Rabbana.',
              'بعد السجدة الثانية من الركعة الأخيرة يجلس ويقرأ التحيات ثم الصلاة الإبراهيمية ثم دعاء ربنا.',
            )
          : _l(
              lang,
              '2. rekatın ikinci secdesinden sonra oturulur ve SADECE Ettehiyyâtü okunur. '
                  'Ardından "Allâhu Ekber" diyerek 3. rekata kalkılır.',
              'After the second prostration of the 2nd rak\'ah, sit and recite ONLY At-Tahiyyat, '
                  'then stand up for the 3rd rak\'ah saying "Allahu Akbar".',
              'Setelah sujud kedua di rakaat ke-2, duduk dan HANYA membaca Tahiyyat, '
                  'lalu berdiri untuk rakaat ke-3 sambil mengucapkan "Allahu Akbar".',
              'بعد السجدة الثانية من الركعة الثانية يجلس ويقرأ التحيات فقط، ثم يقوم إلى الثالثة مكبّرًا.',
            ),
      arabic: _arTehiyyat,
      transliteration: _translit(
        lang,
        'Ettehiyyâtü lillâhi vessalevâtü vettayyibât. Esselâmü aleyke eyyühen\'nebiyyü ve rahmetullâhi ve '
            'berakâtüh. Esselâmü aleynâ ve alâ ibâdillâhis\'sâlihîn. Eşhedü en lâ ilâhe illallâh ve eşhedü '
            'enne Muhammeden abdühû ve rasûlüh.',
        'At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat. As-salamu \'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi '
            'wa barakatuh. As-salamu \'alayna wa \'ala \'ibadillahis-salihin. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah, '
            'wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan \'abduhu wa rasuluh.',
      ),
      meaning: _meaning(
        lang,
        'Bütün tahiyyeler, dualar ve güzel sözler Allah\'a mahsustur. Ey Peygamber! Allah\'ın selâmı, rahmeti '
            've bereketi senin üzerine olsun. Selâm bizim ve Allah\'ın salih kullarının üzerine olsun. '
            'Şahitlik ederim ki Allah\'tan başka ilah yoktur ve yine şahitlik ederim ki Muhammed O\'nun kulu ve elçisidir.',
        'All greetings, prayers and good words are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah '
            'and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there '
            'is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.',
        'Segala penghormatan, shalawat dan kebaikan hanya milik Allah. Semoga keselamatan, rahmat dan berkah Allah '
            'tercurah kepadamu wahai Nabi. Semoga keselamatan tercurah kepada kami dan hamba-hamba Allah yang saleh. '
            'Aku bersaksi tiada tuhan selain Allah dan aku bersaksi bahwa Muhammad adalah hamba dan utusan-Nya.',
      ),
      note: _l(
        lang,
        'Erkekler sol ayağı yatırıp üzerine oturur, sağ ayağı dikerler. Kadınlar ayaklarını sağ taraftan çıkararak otururlar.',
        'Men sit on the left foot with the right foot upright; women sit with both feet extended to the right.',
        'Laki-laki duduk di atas kaki kiri dengan kaki kanan ditegakkan; perempuan duduk dengan kedua kaki dikeluarkan ke kanan.',
        'يفترش الرجل رجله اليسرى وينصب اليمنى، وتجلس المرأة متورّكة مخرجةً رجليها من الجانب الأيمن.',
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Seçilen vakte göre adım adım namaz kılınışını döndürür.
  static List<PrayerHowToStep> steps(PrayerName p, AppLanguage lang) {
    final rakats = exampleRakats(p);
    final name = _prayerNameForNiyet(p, lang);
    final isNafile = p == PrayerName.sunrise;

    final niyetTr = isNafile
        ? 'Niyet ettim Allah rızası için kuşluk namazı kılmaya.'
        : 'Niyet ettim Allah rızası için bugünkü $name namazının farzını kılmaya.';
    final niyetEn = isNafile
        ? '"I intend to pray 2 rak\'ahs of Duha for the sake of Allah."'
        : '"I intend to pray the $rakats rak\'ah Fard of $name for the sake of Allah."';
    final niyetId = isNafile
        ? '"Aku berniat shalat Dhuha 2 rakaat karena Allah Ta\'ala."'
        : '"Aku berniat shalat fardhu $name $rakats rakaat karena Allah Ta\'ala."';

    final list = <PrayerHowToStep>[
      // 1. Hazırlık
      PrayerHowToStep(
        title: _l(lang, 'Hazırlık: Abdest & Kıble', 'Preparation: Wudu & Qibla', 'Persiapan: Wudhu & Kiblat', 'التهيؤ: الوضوء والقبلة'),
        description: _l(
          lang,
          'Abdestli olarak, temiz bir yerde, avret yerleri örtülü şekilde kıbleye dönülür. Vaktin girmiş olduğundan emin olunur.',
          'Make sure you have wudu, your body and place are clean, your \'awrah is covered, the prayer time has entered, and face the Qibla.',
          'Pastikan dalam keadaan berwudhu, badan dan tempat suci, aurat tertutup, waktu shalat telah masuk, lalu menghadap kiblat.',
          'يتوضأ ويستر عورته ويتأكد من طهارة المكان ودخول الوقت، ثم يستقبل القبلة.',
        ),
      ),
      // 2. Niyet
      PrayerHowToStep(
        title: _l(lang, 'Niyet', 'Intention (Niyyah)', 'Niat', 'النية'),
        description: _l(
          lang,
          'Hangi namazı kılacağınızı kalben belirlersiniz. Dil ile söylemek de güzeldir: "$niyetTr"',
          'Make the intention in your heart for the prayer you are about to perform, e.g. $niyetEn',
          'Niatkan di dalam hati shalat yang akan dikerjakan, misalnya: $niyetId',
          'ينوي بقلبه الصلاة التي يريد أداءها، كأن ينوي صلاة $name.',
        ),
        note: _l(
          lang,
          'Cemaatle kılınıyorsa "Uydum hazır olan imama" diye eklenir.',
          'If praying in congregation, also intend to follow the imam.',
          'Jika berjamaah, niatkan juga mengikuti imam (makmum).',
          'إن كان مأمومًا نوى الاقتداء بالإمام.',
        ),
      ),
      // 3. İftitah Tekbiri
      PrayerHowToStep(
        title: _l(lang, 'İftitah (Başlangıç) Tekbiri', 'Opening Takbir', 'Takbiratul Ihram', 'تكبيرة الإحرام'),
        description: _l(
          lang,
          'Eller kaldırılır; erkekler başparmaklarını kulak memelerine değdirir, kadınlar ellerini omuz hizasına kaldırır '
              've "Allâhu Ekber" denilerek namaza başlanır.',
          'Raise your hands (men: thumbs to earlobes; women: to shoulder level) and say "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer.',
          'Angkat kedua tangan (laki-laki: ibu jari menyentuh daun telinga; perempuan: sejajar bahu) dan ucapkan "Allahu Akbar".',
          'يرفع يديه (الرجل إلى شحمتي أذنيه والمرأة إلى منكبيها) ويقول: الله أكبر.',
        ),
        arabic: 'اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ',
        transliteration: _translit(lang, 'Allâhu Ekber', 'Allahu Akbar'),
        meaning: _meaning(lang, 'Allah en büyüktür.', 'Allah is the Greatest.', 'Allah Maha Besar.'),
      ),
      // 4. Kıyam + Sübhaneke
      PrayerHowToStep(
        title: _l(lang, 'Kıyam & Sübhaneke', 'Standing & Opening Supplication', 'Berdiri & Doa Iftitah', 'القيام ودعاء الاستفتاح'),
        description: _l(
          lang,
          'Erkekler sağ eli sol elin üzerine koyarak göbek altında bağlar; kadınlar ellerini göğüs üzerinde bağlar. '
              'Gözler secde yerine bakar ve Sübhaneke okunur.',
          'Men place the right hand over the left below the navel; women place them on the chest. '
              'Look at the place of prostration and recite the Thana:',
          'Laki-laki meletakkan tangan kanan di atas tangan kiri di bawah pusar; perempuan di atas dada. '
              'Pandangan ke tempat sujud dan membaca doa iftitah (Tsana):',
          'يضع الرجل يمينه على شماله تحت السرة، والمرأة على صدرها، وينظر إلى موضع سجوده ويقرأ الثناء:',
        ),
        arabic: _arSubhaneke,
        transliteration: _translit(
          lang,
          'Sübhânekellâhümme ve bi hamdik ve tebârekesmük ve teâlâ ceddük ve lâ ilâhe ğayrük.',
          'Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika wa tabarakasmuka wa ta\'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruk.',
        ),
        meaning: _meaning(
          lang,
          'Allah\'ım! Seni her türlü eksiklikten tenzih eder, Sana hamd ederim. Senin adın mübarektir, '
              'şanın yücedir. Senden başka ilah yoktur.',
          'Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your majesty. '
              'There is no god but You.',
          'Maha Suci Engkau ya Allah, dengan memuji-Mu. Maha Berkah nama-Mu, Maha Tinggi keagungan-Mu, '
              'dan tiada tuhan selain Engkau.',
        ),
      ),
      // 5. Eûzü-Besmele
      PrayerHowToStep(
        title: _l(lang, 'Eûzü - Besmele', 'Ta\'awwudh & Basmalah', 'Ta\'awudz & Basmalah', 'التعوذ والبسملة'),
        description: _l(
          lang,
          'Sübhaneke\'den sonra sessizce Eûzü ve Besmele çekilir.',
          'After the Thana, silently seek refuge in Allah and say the Basmalah.',
          'Setelah doa iftitah, baca ta\'awudz dan basmalah secara pelan.',
          'بعد الثناء يتعوّذ ويبسمل سرًّا.',
        ),
        arabic: _arEuzuBesmele,
        transliteration: _translit(
          lang,
          'Eûzü billâhi mineş\'şeytânir\'racîm. Bismillâhir\'rahmânir\'rahîm.',
          'A\'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim. Bismillahir-rahmanir-rahim.',
        ),
        meaning: _meaning(
          lang,
          'Kovulmuş şeytandan Allah\'a sığınırım. Rahmân ve Rahîm olan Allah\'ın adıyla.',
          'I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.',
          'Aku berlindung kepada Allah dari setan yang terkutuk. Dengan nama Allah Yang Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang.',
        ),
      ),
      // 6. Fâtiha
      _fatihaStep(
        lang,
        title: _l(lang, '1. Rekat: Fâtiha Sûresi', '1st Rak\'ah: Al-Fatiha', 'Rakaat 1: Al-Fatihah', 'الركعة الأولى: الفاتحة'),
        desc: _l(
          lang,
          'Fâtiha Sûresi okunur ve sonunda sessizce "Âmîn" denir.',
          'Recite Surah Al-Fatiha and say "Amin" silently at the end.',
          'Baca Surah Al-Fatihah dan ucapkan "Amin" di akhir.',
          'يقرأ سورة الفاتحة ويقول في آخرها: آمين.',
        ),
      ),
      // 7. Zamm-ı Sûre
      _zammStep(lang, _l(lang, '1. Rekat: Zamm-ı Sûre', '1st Rak\'ah: Additional Surah', 'Rakaat 1: Surah Pendek', 'الركعة الأولى: سورة قصيرة')),

import 'package:adhan/adhan.dart';

/// Uygulamada kullanılan namaz vakti isimlerini temsil eden enum.
/// [adhan] kütüphanesinin [Prayer] enum'una karşılık gelir.
enum PrayerName {
  fajr(
    turkish: 'İmsak',
    arabic: 'الفجر',
    english: 'Fajr',
    key: 'fajr',
    rakatTotal: 4,

  );

  /// Türkçe adı
  final String turkish;

  /// Arapça adı – Amiri fontu ile gösterilmeli
  final String arabic;

  /// İngilizce adı
  final String english;

  /// adhan kütüphanesi ile eşleşen key
  final String key;

  /// Toplam rekat sayısı
  final int rakatTotal;

  /// Rekat dökümü (Türkçe)
  final String rakatSummaryTurkish;

  /// Rekat dökümü (İngilizce)
  final String rakatSummaryEnglish;

  /// Rekat dökümü (Arapça)
  final String rakatSummaryArabic;

  const PrayerName({
    required this.turkish,
    required this.arabic,
    required this.english,
    required this.key,

  });

  /// Dile göre isim
  String localizedName(String langCode) {
    switch (langCode) {
      case 'en':
        return english;
      case 'ar':
        return arabic;

  String localizedRakat(String langCode) {

        return rakatSummaryArabic;

        }
      case 'fr':
        switch (this) {

          case PrayerName.dhuhr: return '10 Rakats (4 Sounnah + 4 Fard + 2 Sounnah)';
          case PrayerName.asr: return '8 Rakats (4 Sounnah + 4 Fard)';

      case 'ur':

          case PrayerName.sunrise: return 'طلوع آفتاب / وقت کراہت';
          case PrayerName.dhuhr: return '۱۰ رکعت (۴ سنت + ۴ فرض + ۲ سنت)';
          case PrayerName.asr: return '۸ رکعت (۴ سنت + ۴ فرض)';
          case PrayerName.maghrib: return '۵ رکعت (۳ فرض + ۲ سنت)';
          case PrayerName.isha: return '۱۳ رکعت (۴ سنت + ۴ فرض + ۲ سنت + ۳ وتر)';
        }
      case 'de':
        switch (this) {
          case PrayerName.fajr: return '4 Raka\'at (2 Sunnah + 2 Fard)';
          case PrayerName.sunrise: return 'Sonnenaufgang (Eingeschränkte Zeit)';
          case PrayerName.dhuhr: return '10 Raka\'at (4 Sunnah + 4 Fard + 2 Sunnah)';
          case PrayerName.asr: return '8 Raka\'at (4 Sunnah + 4 Fard)';
          case PrayerName.maghrib: return '5 Raka\'at (3 Fard + 2 Sunnah)';
          case PrayerName.isha: return '13 Raka\'at (4 Sunnah + 4 Fard + 2 Sunnah + 3 Witr)';
        }
      case 'ru':
        switch (this) {
          case PrayerName.fajr: return '4 ракаата (2 сунна + 2 фард)';
          case PrayerName.sunrise: return 'Восход солнца (время карахата)';
          case PrayerName.dhuhr: return '10 ракаатов (4 сунна + 4 фард + 2 сунна)';
          case PrayerName.asr: return '8 ракаатов (4 сунна + 4 фард)';
          case PrayerName.maghrib: return '5 ракаатов (3 фард + 2 сунна)';
          case PrayerName.isha: return '13 ракаатов (4 сунна + 4 фард + 2 сунна + 3 витр)';
        }
      case 'tr':
      default:
        return rakatSummaryTurkish;
    }
  }

  /// adhan [Prayer] enum'undan dönüştürür.
  static PrayerName fromAdhan(Prayer prayer) {
    switch (prayer) {
      case Prayer.fajr:    return PrayerName.fajr;
      case Prayer.sunrise: return PrayerName.sunrise;
      case Prayer.dhuhr:   return PrayerName.dhuhr;
      case Prayer.asr:     return PrayerName.asr;
      case Prayer.maghrib: return PrayerName.maghrib;
      case Prayer.isha:    return PrayerName.isha;
      case Prayer.none:    return PrayerName.isha; // gece yarısı sonrası
    }
  }
}

/// Tek bir namaz vaktini temsil eden veri sınıfı.
class PrayerEntry {
  /// Namaz adı (enum)
  final PrayerName name;

  /// Hesaplanan vakit (yerel saat dilimiyle)
  final DateTime time;

  const PrayerEntry({required this.name, required this.time});

  /// Namaz henüz geçmedi mi?
  bool get isFuture => time.isAfter(DateTime.now());

  /// Bu vaktin üzerinden ne kadar geçti / ne kadar kaldı.
  Duration get timeUntil {
    final diff = time.difference(DateTime.now());
    return diff.isNegative ? Duration.zero : diff;
  }

  @override
  String toString() => 'PrayerEntry(${name.turkish}: $time)';
}

/// Günün tüm namaz vakitlerini ve meta verilerini tutan model.
class DailyPrayerTimes {
  /// Hesaplama tarihi
  final DateTime date;

  /// Konum adı (ör: "İstanbul" veya koordinatlar)
  final String locationName;

  /// Hesaplama için kullanılan enlem
  final double latitude;

  /// Hesaplama için kullanılan boylam
  final double longitude;

  /// 6 vakit listesi (İmsak → Yatsı)
  final List<PrayerEntry> prayers;

  /// adhan nesnesi – ileri sorgulamalar için
  final PrayerTimes prayerTimes;

  const DailyPrayerTimes({
    required this.date,
    required this.locationName,
    required this.latitude,
    required this.longitude,
    required this.prayers,
    required this.prayerTimes,
  });

  // ── Kolaylık Getter'ları ──────────────────────────────────

  PrayerEntry get fajr    => prayers[0];
  PrayerEntry get sunrise => prayers[1];
  PrayerEntry get dhuhr   => prayers[2];
  PrayerEntry get asr     => prayers[3];
  PrayerEntry get maghrib => prayers[4];
  PrayerEntry get isha    => prayers[5];

  /// Şu anki vakti döner ([adhan] kullanılır).
  Prayer get currentPrayer => prayerTimes.currentPrayer();

  /// Sıradaki namaz vakti [PrayerEntry]'i döner.
  /// Eğer günün tüm vakitleri geçmişse (ör: Yatsı sonrası), yarının İmsak vaktini döner.
  PrayerEntry? get nextPrayerEntry {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    for (final p in prayers) {
      if (p.time.isAfter(now)) {
        return p;
      }
    }
    // Tüm vakitler geçmiş -> Yarının İmsak vakti
    return PrayerEntry(
      name: PrayerName.fajr,
      time: fajr.time.add(const Duration(days: 1)),
    );
  }

  /// Sıradaki vakte kalan süre.
  Duration get timeUntilNextPrayer {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final next = nextPrayerEntry;
    if (next == null) return Duration.zero;
    final diff = next.time.difference(now);
    return diff.isNegative ? Duration.zero : diff;
  }

  /// Şimdiki ve sıradaki vaktin Türkçe adları
  String get currentPrayerName {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    PrayerEntry? current;
    for (final p in prayers) {
      if (p.time.isBefore(now)) {
        current = p;
      }
    }
    return current?.name.turkish ?? 'Yatsı';
  }

  String get nextPrayerName => nextPrayerEntry?.name.turkish ?? 'İmsak';

  PrayerEntry? get currentPrayerEntry {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    PrayerEntry? current;
    for (final p in prayers) {
      if (p.time.isBefore(now)) {
        current = p;
      }
    }
    return current;
  }

  String localizedCurrentPrayerName(String langCode) {
    return currentPrayerEntry?.name.localizedName(langCode) ??
        (langCode == 'en' ? 'Isha' : (langCode == 'ar' ? 'العشاء' : 'Yatsı'));
  }

  String localizedNextPrayerName(String langCode) {
    return nextPrayerEntry?.name.localizedName(langCode) ??
        (langCode == 'en' ? 'Fajr' : (langCode == 'ar' ? 'الفجر' : 'İmsak'));
  }
}

/// Konum verisi – GPS veya varsayılan İstanbul
class LocationData {
  final double latitude;
  final double longitude;
  final String cityName;

  /// true → GPS'ten alındı, false → varsayılan (İstanbul)
  final bool isFromGPS;

  const LocationData({
    required this.latitude,
    required this.longitude,
    required this.cityName,
    required this.isFromGPS,
  });

  @override
  String toString() =>
      'LocationData($cityName, $latitude, $longitude, GPS: $isFromGPS)';
}

## Dosya: lib/features/prayer_times/providers/prayer_time_providers.dart

`dart
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../notifications/services/notification_service.dart';
import '../../widget_service/widget_service.dart';
import '../models/prayer_time_model.dart';
import '../services/prayer_time_service.dart';

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Servis Provider'ı
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// [PrayerTimeService] singleton provider'ı.
final prayerTimeServiceProvider = Provider<PrayerTimeService>((ref) {
  return PrayerTimeService();
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Konum Provider'ı
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Kullanıcının konumunu asenkron olarak döner.
/// GPS alınamazsa İstanbul varsayılanını kullanır.
final locationProvider = FutureProvider<LocationData>((ref) async {
  final service = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);
  return service.getCurrentLocation();
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Namaz Vakitleri Provider'ı
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Bugünün namaz vakitlerini hesaplar ve döner.
///
/// Tek gerçek doğruluk kaynağı olan [prayerTimesNotifierProvider]'a delege eder.
final dailyPrayerTimesProvider = FutureProvider<DailyPrayerTimes>((ref) async {
  return ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.future);
});

/// Belirli bir tarih için namaz vakitlerini hesaplar.
/// Ana ekranda haftalık görünüm için kullanılabilir.
final prayerTimesForDateProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose.family<
  DailyPrayerTimes,
  DateTime
>((ref, date) async {
  final service = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);
  final location = await ref.watch(locationProvider.future);
  return service.calculatePrayerTimes(location: location, date: date);
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Sıradaki Namaz Provider'ı
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Sıradaki namaz vakti bilgisi – sadece ilgili alanları döner.
final nextPrayerProvider = FutureProvider.autoDispose<PrayerEntry?>((ref) async {
  final daily = await ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.future);
  return daily.nextPrayerEntry;
});

/// Namaz vakitleri ilerleme oranı (0.0 → 1.0).
/// Mevcut vakitten sonraki vakite kadar geçen sürenin oranı.
/// [StreamProvider] ile saniyede bir dinamik olarak güncellenir.
final prayerProgressProvider = StreamProvider.autoDispose<double>((ref) async* {
  final daily = await ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.future);
  final service = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);

  yield service.getProgressToNextPrayer(daily);

  final timer = Stream.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  await for (final _ in timer) {
    yield service.getProgressToNextPrayer(daily);
  }
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Countdown Timer (Gerçek Zamanlı Geri Sayım)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Sıradaki namaz vaktine kalan süreyi saniyede bir güncelleyen provider.
final prayerCountdownProvider = StreamProvider.autoDispose<Duration>((ref) async* {
  final daily = await ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.future);

  yield daily.timeUntilNextPrayer;

  final timer = Stream.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  await for (final _ in timer) {
    yield daily.timeUntilNextPrayer;
  }
});

/// Countdown'ı formatlanmış string olarak döner (ör: "02:45" veya "1s 30dk").
final countdownStringProvider = StreamProvider.autoDispose<String>((ref) async* {
  final daily = await ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.future);
  final service = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);
  final lang = ref.watch(appLanguageProvider);

  yield service.formatCountdown(daily.timeUntilNextPrayer, lang: lang);

  final timer = Stream.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  await for (final _ in timer) {
    yield service.formatCountdown(daily.timeUntilNextPrayer, lang: lang);
  }
});

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Günlük Sıfırlama Notifier'ı
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/// Gece yarısında namaz vakitlerini otomatik yenileyen notifier.
///
/// Uygulama gece yarısını geçtiğinde yeni günün vakitlerini hesaplar.
class PrayerTimesNotifier extends AsyncNotifier<DailyPrayerTimes> {
  Timer? _midnightTimer;

  @override
  Future<DailyPrayerTimes> build() async {
    // Gece yarısına kadar olan süreyi hesapla
    _scheduleMidnightReset();

    // Dispose edildiğinde timer'ı temizle
    ref.onDispose(() => _midnightTimer?.cancel());

    final service = ref.watch(prayerTimeServiceProvider);
    final location = await ref.watch(locationProvider.future);
    return service.calculatePrayerTimes(location: location);
  }

  /// Gece yarısında vakitleri yeniden hesaplamak için timer kurar.
  void _scheduleMidnightReset() {
    _midnightTimer?.cancel();

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final midnight = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day + 1);
    final untilMidnight = midnight.difference(now);

    _midnightTimer = Timer(untilMidnight, () {
      // Gece yarısı geçince yeniden hesapla
      ref.invalidateSelf();
      NotificationService.instance.scheduleUpcomingPrayers();
      WidgetService().updateAllWidgets();
      _scheduleMidnightReset(); // Bir sonraki gece için tekrar kur
    });
  }

  /// Konumu yenileyerek vakitleri yeniden hesaplar.
  /// Önceki durumu koruyarak arayüzün iskelete düşüp titremesini önler.
  Future<void> refresh() async {
    state = const AsyncLoading<DailyPrayerTimes>().copyWithPrevious(state);
    ref.invalidate(locationProvider); // build() yeni konumla zaten yeniden çalışacak
    try {
      await future; // Notifier'ın kendi yeniden kurulumunu bekle
      NotificationService.instance.scheduleUpcomingPrayers();
      WidgetService().updateAllWidgets();
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

/// Gece yarısı sıfırlamalı namaz vakitleri notifier provider'ı.
/// UI bileşenleri bu provider'ı tercih etmelidir.
final prayerTimesNotifierProvider =
    AsyncNotifierProvider<PrayerTimesNotifier, DailyPrayerTimes>(
  PrayerTimesNotifier.new,
);

import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';

/// Namaz Vakti Hesaplama Yöntemi Seçim Sheet'i
class CalculationMethodSheet extends StatefulWidget {
  final WidgetRef ref;

  const CalculationMethodSheet({super.key, required this.ref});

  static void show(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => CalculationMethodSheet(ref: ref),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<CalculationMethodSheet> createState() => _CalculationMethodSheetState();
}

class _CalculationMethodSheetState extends State<CalculationMethodSheet> {
  PrayerCalculationMethod _currentMethod = PrayerCalculationMethod.diyanet;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final m = await PrayerTimeService.instance.getSavedCalculationMethod();
    if (mounted) setState(() => _currentMethod = m);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = widget.ref.watch(appStringsProvider);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF02211C),
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
        border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), width: 1.5)),
      ),
      child: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white24,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              strings.calculationMethodTitle,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 17,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            Text(
              strings.calculationMethodDesc,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 12),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            ...PrayerCalculationMethod.values.map((method) {
              final isSelected = _currentMethod == method;
              return ListTile(
                leading: Icon(
                  isSelected ? Icons.radio_button_checked : Icons.radio_button_off,
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                ),
                title: Text(
                  method.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
                    fontSize: 14,
                  ),
                ),
                subtitle: Text(
                  strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? method.enName : method.trName,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 11.5),
                ),
                onTap: () async {
                  HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                  await PrayerTimeService.instance.saveCalculationMethod(method);
                  setState(() => _currentMethod = method);
                  widget.ref.read(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.notifier).refresh();
                  if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                },
              );
            }),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  ...steps.map((step) => _buildStepCard(step, isDark)),

                  const SizedBox(height: 20),

                  // ── 2. Bu Vakte Özel Faziletli Sûre ve Âyetler ──────
                  if (featuredSurahs.isNotEmpty) ...[
                    _buildSectionHeader(
                      icon: Icons.stars_rounded,
                      title: strings.recommendedSurahsTitle,
                      badge: strings.tapToReadBadge,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    ...featuredSurahs.map((item) => _buildSurahCard(context, ref, item, isFeatured: true)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  ],

                  // ── 3. Namaz Sûreleri (Zamm-ı Sûreler) ───────────────
                  _buildSectionHeader(
                    icon: Icons.menu_book_rounded,
                    title: strings.surahsRecitedInPrayerTitle,
                    badge: strings.tenShortSurahsBadge,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    strings.prayerSurahTapHint,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.65),
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      height: 1.4,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  ...generalSurahs.map((item) => _buildSurahCard(context, ref, item)),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSectionHeader({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    String? badge,
  }) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 17, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),

  String _howToTitle(AppLanguage lang) {
    switch (lang) {
      case AppLanguage.turkish:
        return 'Namaz Nasıl Kılınır?';
      case AppLanguage.indonesian:
        return 'Tata Cara Shalat';
      case AppLanguage.arabic:
        return 'كيفية أداء الصلاة';
      default:
        return 'How to Pray';
    }
  }

  String _howToBadge(AppLanguage lang, int count) {
    switch (lang) {
      case AppLanguage.turkish:
        return '$count Adım';
      case AppLanguage.indonesian:
        return '$count Langkah';
      case AppLanguage.arabic:
        return '$count خطوة';
      default:
        return '$count Steps';
    }
  }

  Widget _buildHowToStepCard(int index, PrayerHowToStep step, AppLanguage lang) {
    final hasDetails = step.hasRecitation || step.note != null;

    final header = Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 26,
          height: 26,
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.18),
            border: Border.all(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Center(
            child: Text(
              '$index',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                step.title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 13.5,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                step.description,
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.75),
                  fontSize: 11.8,
                  height: 1.4,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );

    final decoration = BoxDecoration(
      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF042F28),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08), width: 1),
    );

    if (!hasDetails) {
      return Container(
        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 11, 14, 11),
        decoration: decoration,
        child: header,
      );
    }

    final readLabel = switch (lang) {
      AppLanguage.turkish => 'Okunuşu ve anlamı için dokun',
      AppLanguage.indonesian => 'Ketuk untuk bacaan & arti',
      AppLanguage.arabic => 'اضغط لعرض النص',
      _ => 'Tap for recitation & meaning',
    };

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      decoration: decoration,
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      child: Theme(
        // ExpansionTile'ın varsayılan ayırıcı çizgilerini gizle
        data: ThemeData(dividerColor: Colors.transparent, splashColor: Colors.transparent),
        child: ExpansionTile(
          tilePadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 4, 8, 4),
          childrenPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 0, 14, 14),
          iconColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
          collapsedIconColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.7),
          title: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              header,
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 36, top: 6),
                child: Text(
                  readLabel,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.75),
                    fontSize: 10.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          children: [
            if (step.arabic != null)
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF021A16),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  border: Border.all(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                    width: 0.8,
                  ),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  step.arabic!,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                    fontSize: 19,
                    height: 1.9,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (step.transliteration != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              _buildHowToLabeledText(
                switch (lang) {
                  AppLanguage.turkish => 'Okunuşu',
                  AppLanguage.indonesian => 'Bacaan',
                  _ => 'Transliteration',
                },
                step.transliteration!,
                italic: true,
              ),
            ],
            if (step.meaning != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              _buildHowToLabeledText(
                switch (lang) {
                  AppLanguage.turkish => 'Anlamı',
                  AppLanguage.indonesian => 'Arti',
                  _ => 'Meaning',
                },
                step.meaning!,
              ),
            ],
            if (step.note != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, size: 14, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                        step.note!,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.8),

                          height: 1.4,

                      ),
                    ),

              ),

              height: 1.45,
              fontStyle: italic ? FontStyle.italic : FontStyle.normal,

  Future<void> _openSurahInQuran(
    BuildContext context,
    WidgetRef ref,
    int surahId, [
    int? verseNumber,
  ]) async {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    final surah = await QuranRepository().getSurahById(surahId);
    if (surah != null && context.mounted) {
      // Bottom sheet'i kapat
      Navigator.of(context).pop();

      // Kur'an Sekmesine Geçiş Yap (Tab 2)
      ref.read(selectedTabProvider.notifier).state = 2;

      // Kök ekrana dön ve Kur'an Detay Sayfasını Aç
      Navigator.of(context).popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
      Navigator.of(context).push(
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => SurahDetailScreen(
            surah: surah,
            initialScrollToVerse: verseNumber,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  IconData _prayerIcon(PrayerName p) {
    switch (p) {
      case PrayerName.fajr:
        return Icons.nights_stay_rounded;
      case PrayerName.sunrise:
        return Icons.wb_sunny_rounded;
      case PrayerName.dhuhr:
        return Icons.wb_sunny_outlined;
      case PrayerName.asr:
        return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
      case PrayerName.maghrib:
        return Icons.wb_twilight_rounded;
      case PrayerName.isha:
        return Icons.bedtime_rounded;
    }
  }

  String _headerSubtitle(PrayerName p, AppLanguage lang) {
    if (p == PrayerName.sunrise) {
      if (lang == AppLanguage.turkish) {
        return 'Kerâhet Vakti • Kuşluk / İşrak Namazı';
      }
      if (lang == AppLanguage.arabic) {
        return 'وقت الكراهة • صلاة الضحى والإشراق';
      }
      if (lang == AppLanguage.indonesian) {
        return 'Waktu Terlarang Shalat • Shalat Dhuha / Isyraq';
      }
      return 'Sunrise (Restricted Time) • Duha/Ishraq Prayer';
    }
    return p.localizedRakat(lang.code);
  }

  List<PrayerRakatStep> _getSteps(PrayerName p, AppLanguage lang) {
    if (lang == AppLanguage.turkish) {
      return _getStepsTr(p);
    } else if (lang == AppLanguage.indonesian) {
      return _getStepsId(p);
    } else if (lang == AppLanguage.arabic) {
      return _getStepsAr(p);
    } else {
      return _getStepsEn(p);
    }
  }

  List<PrayerRakatStep> _getStepsTr(PrayerName p) {
    switch (p) {
      case PrayerName.fajr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rekat Sünnet',
            type: 'Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: 'Peygamber Efendimiz (s.a.v.)\'in en çok önem verdiği sünnettir. 1. rekatta Kâfirûn, 2. rekatta İhlâs sûreleri tavsiye edilir.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rekat Farz',
            type: 'Farz-ı Ayn',
            detail: 'Kıraati cehrî (açıktan) okunan farz namazdır. Cemaatle veya münferit kılınır.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.sunrise:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: 'Kerâhet Vakti (Namaz Kılınmaz)',
            type: 'Mekruh Vakit',
            detail: 'Güneş doğarken ve doğduktan sonraki ilk 40-45 dakika içinde farz veya nafile namaz kılmak mekruhtur.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: 'İşrak & Kuşluk (Duhâ) Namazı',
            type: 'Nafile (2 - 8 Rekat)',
            detail: 'Güneş bir mızrak boyu yükseldikten (doğuşundan ~45 dk sonra) zeval vaktine kadar kılınan çok faziletli nafile namazdır.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.dhuhr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat İlk Sünnet',
            type: 'Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: '1. oturuşta sadece Ettehiyyâtü okunup 3. rekata kalkılır. 3. ve 4. rekatlarda Fâtiha ve zamm-ı sûre okunur.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat Farz',
            type: 'Farz-ı Ayn',
            detail: 'Farzın 3. ve 4. rekatlarında sadece Fâtiha sûresi okunur, zamm-ı sûre eklenmez.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rekat Son Sünnet',
            type: 'Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: 'Sabah namazının sünneti gibi kılınan iki rekatlık müekked sünnettir.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.asr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat Sünnet',
            type: 'Gayr-i Müekkede',
            detail: '1. oturuşta Ettehiyyâtü ile birlikte Salli ve Bârik duaları da okunur. 3. rekata kalkınca Sübhaneke ve Eûzü-Besmele ile başlanır.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat Farz',
            type: 'Farz-ı Ayn',
            detail: '3. ve 4. rekatlarında sadece Fâtiha okunur. Vaktin fazileti ikindi vaktinin korunmasındadır (Salât-ı Vüstâ).',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.maghrib:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '3 Rekat Farz',
            type: 'Farz-ı Ayn (Önce Kılınır)',
            detail: 'Akşam namazında önce farz kılınır. 1. ve 2. rekatta Fâtiha ve zamm-ı sûre; 3. rekatta sadece Fâtiha okunur.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rekat Sünnet',
            type: 'Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: 'Farzdan hemen sonra kılınır. Kâfirûn ve İhlâs sûreleri tavsiye edilir.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.isha:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat İlk Sünnet',
            type: 'Gayr-i Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: 'İkindi sünneti gibidir; 1. oturuşta Salli-Bârik okunur, 3. rekata kalkınca Sübhaneke ile başlanır.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Rekat Farz',
            type: 'Farz-ı Ayn',
            detail: '3. ve 4. rekatlarında sadece Fâtiha okunur.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rekat Son Sünnet',
            type: 'Müekkede Sünnet',
            detail: 'Farzın ardından kılınan iki rekatlık sünnettir.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '3 Rekat Vitir Namazı',
            type: 'Vacip Namaz (Kunût ile)',
            detail: '3. rekatta Fâtiha ve zamm-ı sûre okunduktan sonra eller kulaklara kaldırılıp tekbir alınır ve Kunût duaları okunur.',
          ),
        ];
    }
  }

  List<PrayerRakatStep> _getStepsId(PrayerName p) {
    switch (p) {
      case PrayerName.fajr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rakaat Sunnah Subuh',
            type: 'Sunnah Muakkadah',
            detail: 'Sunnah yang sangat ditekankan oleh Rasulullah ﷺ. Dianjurkan membaca surat Al-Kafirun pada rakaat pertama dan Al-Ikhlas pada rakaat kedua.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Rakaat Fardhu Subuh',
            type: 'Fardhu Ain',
            detail: 'Shalat fardhu dengan bacaan keras (jahri). Dikerjakan berjamaah atau sendiri.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.sunrise:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: 'Waktu Terlarang (Dilarang Shalat)',
            type: 'Waktu Makruh',
            detail: 'Makruh melakukan shalat fardhu atau sunnah saat matahari terbit hingga 40-45 menit pertama.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: 'Shalat Isyraq & Dhuha',
            type: 'Sunnah (2 - 8 Rakaat)',
            detail: 'Shalat sunnah yang sangat utama dikerjakan setelah matahari naik setinggi tombak hingga sebelum waktu zawal.',
          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.dhuhr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(

  List<PrayerRakatStep> _getStepsEn(PrayerName p) {

            title: '2 Final Sunnah Rakats',
            type: 'Emphasized Sunnah',

      case PrayerName.asr:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(

          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Fard Rakats',
            type: 'Obligatory (Fard Ayn)',

          ),
        ];
      case PrayerName.maghrib:
        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '3 Fard Rakats',
            type: 'Obligatory (Prayed First)',
            detail: 'Obligatory prayer is prayed first. Surah recitation in rakats 1 & 2; only Fatiha in rakat 3.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Sunnah Rakats',
            type: 'Emphasized Sunnah',
            detail: 'Prayed immediately after Fard. Surahs Al-Kafirun and Al-Ikhlas are recommended.',
          ),

        return const [
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Initial Sunnah Rakats',
            type: 'Non-Emphasized Sunnah',
            detail: 'Voluntary prayer before the obligatory Isha prayer.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '4 Fard Rakats',
            type: 'Obligatory (Fard Ayn)',
            detail: 'Only Surah Al-Fatiha is recited in the 3rd and 4th rakats.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '2 Final Sunnah Rakats',
            type: 'Emphasized Sunnah',
            detail: 'Two emphasized sunnah rakats prayed after Fard.',
          ),
          PrayerRakatStep(
            title: '3 Witr Rakats',
            type: 'Wajib / Emphasized Night Prayer',
            detail: 'Night prayer concluded with Qunut supplication in the third rakat.',

  List<PrayerRecommendedSurah> _getFeaturedSurahs(PrayerName p, AppLanguage lang) {
    if (lang == AppLanguage.turkish) {
      return _getFeaturedSurahsTr(p);
    } else if (lang == AppLanguage.indonesian) {
      return _getFeaturedSurahsId(p);
    } else if (lang == AppLanguage.arabic) {
      return _getFeaturedSurahsAr(p);
    } else {
      return _getFeaturedSurahsEn(p);
    }
  }

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/theme_provider.dart';
import '../../../core/utils/app_constants.dart';
import '../models/prayer_time_model.dart';
import '../providers/prayer_time_providers.dart';
import '../../../core/widgets/common_widgets.dart' as app_widgets;
import 'city_selector_sheet.dart';
import '../../settings/screens/settings_screen.dart';
import '../../monetization/widgets/banner_ad_widget.dart';
import 'prayer_guide_sheet.dart';

/// Tüm günlük namaz vakitlerini listeleyen tam ekran.
/// Ana ekranın alt kısmında veya ayrı bir sekme olarak kullanılır.
class PrayerTimesScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const PrayerTimesScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final prayerAsync = ref.watch(prayerTimesNotifierProvider);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? effectivePalette.darkBackground : effectivePalette.lightBackground,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? effectivePalette.darkSurface : effectivePalette.primaryColor,
        title: Text(strings.tabPrayers),
        actions: [
          // Şehir / Konum Seçici Buton
          IconButton(
            icon: Icon(Icons.location_on_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
            tooltip: strings.changeCity,
            onPressed: () => CitySelectorSheet.show(context, ref),
          ),
          // Lüks Ayarlar Butonu (Hesaplama Metodu, Ezan Makamları, Bildirimler, Dil vb.)
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined, color: Colors.white),
            tooltip: strings.settings,
            onPressed: () => SettingsScreen.show(context),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
        ],
      ),
      body: prayerAsync.when(
        loading: () => const app_widgets.LoadingWidget(
          message: '...',
        ),
        error: (error, _) => app_widgets.AppErrorWidget(
          message: '$error',
          onRetry: () {
            ref.read(prayerTimesNotifierProvider.notifier).refresh();
          },
        ),
        data: (daily) => _PrayerTimesContent(
          daily: daily,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Namaz vakitleri içerik widget'ı.
class _PrayerTimesContent extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;

  const _PrayerTimesContent({
    required this.daily,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);

    return SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // ── Üst Bilgi Kartı (Konum + Tarih) ──────────────────
          _LocationDateCard(daily: daily, strings: strings),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),

          // ── Sıradaki Vakit Banner ─────────────────────────────
          _NextPrayerBanner(
            daily: daily,
            strings: strings,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 20),

          // ── Günlük Vakit Listesi ──────────────────────────────
          app_widgets.SectionHeader(title: strings.dailyPrayers),
          ...daily.prayers.map(
            (entry) => _PrayerTimeCard(
              entry: entry,
              isNext: daily.nextPrayerEntry?.name == entry.name,
              isCurrent: PrayerName.fromAdhan(daily.currentPrayer) == entry.name,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const BannerAdWidget(),
          const SizedBox(height: 110),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Konum ve tarih bilgisi kartı.
class _LocationDateCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;
  final AppStrings strings;
  const _LocationDateCard({required this.daily, required this.strings});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final dateStr = '${now.day} ${_monthName(now.month, strings.language)} ${now.year}';

    return Card(
      color: isDark ? effectivePalette.darkCard : effectivePalette.lightCard,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(
              Icons.location_on_rounded,
              color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.primary,
              size: 20,
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    daily.locationName == 'Mevcut Konum'
                        ? strings.currentLocation
                        : daily.locationName,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                  ),
                  Text(
                    dateStr,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            // GPS veya varsayılan konum ikonu
            Icon(
              daily.latitude == AppConstants.defaultLatitude
                  ? Icons.location_city_rounded
                  : Icons.gps_fixed_rounded,
              color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : AppColors.textHint,
              size: 16,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _monthName(int month, AppLanguage lang) {
    if (lang == AppLanguage.turkish) {
      const months = ['', 'Ocak', 'Şubat', 'Mart', 'Nisan', 'Mayıs', 'Haziran', 'Temmuz', 'Ağustos', 'Eylül', 'Ekim', 'Kasım', 'Aralık'];
      return months[month];
    }
    if (lang == AppLanguage.arabic) {
      const months = ['', 'يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو', 'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'];
      return months[month];
    }
    if (lang == AppLanguage.indonesian) {
      const months = ['', 'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'];
      return months[month];
    }
    const months = ['', 'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
    return months[month];
  }
}

/// Sıradaki namaz vakti banner'ı – büyük countdown ile.
class _NextPrayerBanner extends ConsumerWidget {
  final DailyPrayerTimes daily;
  final AppStrings strings;

  const _NextPrayerBanner({
    required this.daily,
    required this.strings,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {

/// Tek bir namaz vakti satırı kartı.
class _PrayerTimeCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final PrayerEntry entry;
  final bool isNext;
  final bool isCurrent;

  const _PrayerTimeCard({
    required this.entry,
    required this.isNext,
    required this.isCurrent,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final helper = _PrayerTimeServiceHelper();
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final nextAccentColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.primary;

    // Aktif/sıradaki vakit için yüksek kontrastlı ve palet uyumlu stil
    Color cardColor;
    if (isNext) {
      cardColor = isDark
          ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.16)
          : AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.10);
    } else if (isCurrent) {
      cardColor = AppColors.gold.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.12 : 0.08);
    } else {
      cardColor = isDark ? effectivePalette.darkCard : effectivePalette.lightCard;
    }

    return AnimatedContainer(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: cardColor,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: isNext
            ? Border.all(color: nextAccentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.7), width: 1.5)
            : isCurrent
                ? Border.all(color: AppColors.gold.withValues(alpha: 0.45), width: 1)
                : Border.all(
                    color: isDark
                        ? effectivePalette.accentGold.withValues(alpha: 0.18)
                        : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
                    width: 1,
                  ),
        boxShadow: isNext
            ? [
                BoxShadow(
                  color: nextAccentColor.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  blurRadius: 8,
                  offset: const Offset(0, 3),
                ),
              ]
            : null,
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          onTap: () => PrayerGuideSheet.show(context, ref, entry.name, entry.time),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                // İkon
                Container(
                  width: 42,
                  height: 42,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _iconBgColor(isDark),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: isNext
                          ? nextAccentColor
                          : (isCurrent ? AppColors.gold : (isDark ? Colors.white24 : Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.3))),
                      width: 1,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Center(
                    child: Text(
                      entry.name.arabic,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: isNext || isCurrent ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                        color: _iconTextColor(isDark, nextAccentColor),
                        height: 1.6,
                      ),
                      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 14),

                // Namaz adı ve Rekat Bilgisi
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Flexible(
                            child: Text(
                              entry.name.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                              style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(
                                fontWeight: isNext ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
                                color: isNext
                                    ? nextAccentColor
                                    : (isDark ? Colors.white : AppColors.textPrimary),
                              ),
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          if (isCurrent)
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: AppColors.gold.withValues(alpha: 0.22),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                strings.currentPrayer,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.goldDark,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                              ),
                            )
                          else if (isNext)
                            Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: isDark
                                    ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
                                    : AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                strings.nextPrayer,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                  color: isDark ? Colors.black : AppColors.primary,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 3),
                      // Rekat Bilgisi & Rehber İpucu
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            Icons.mosque_rounded,
                            size: 12,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              entry.name.localizedRakat(strings.language.code),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF8C6D08),
                              ),
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Icon(
                            Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
                            size: 13,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),

                // Saat
                Text(
                  helper.fmt(entry.time),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: isNext ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w400,
                    color: isNext
                        ? nextAccentColor
                        : (isDark ? Colors.white : AppColors.textPrimary),
                    fontFeatures: const [FontFeature.tabularFigures()],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Color _iconBgColor(bool isDark) {
    if (isNext) {
      return isDark
          ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.24)
          : AppColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.15);
    }
    if (isCurrent) return AppColors.gold.withValues(alpha: 0.2);
    return isDark ? Colors.white10 : Colors.grey.shade100;
  }

  Color _iconTextColor(bool isDark, Color nextAccentColor) {
    if (isNext) return nextAccentColor;
    if (isCurrent) return isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : AppColors.goldDark;
    return isDark ? Colors.white70 : AppColors.textSecondary;
  }
}

// Küçük yardımcı – servis import'u olmadan saat formatlamak için
class _PrayerTimeServiceHelper {
  String fmt(DateTime dt) {
    final h = dt.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final m = dt.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$h:$m';
  }
}
