              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final versesAsync = ref.watch(versesBySurahProvider(widget.surah.id));
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final isThisSurahPlaying = ref.watch(
      quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.currentSurahId == widget.surah.id && s.isPlaying),
    );
    final activeVerseNumber = ref.watch(
      quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.currentSurahId == widget.surah.id ? s.activeVerseNumber : null),
    );

    ref.listen<int?>(
      quranAudioProvider.select(
        (s) => (s.currentSurahId == widget.surah.id && s.isPlaying && s.isLiveTrackingEnabled)
            ? s.activeVerseNumber
            : null,
      ),
      (prev, next) {
        if (next != null && next != prev) {
          final verses = versesAsync.valueOrNull;
          if (verses != null && verses.isNotEmpty) {
            _scrollToVerseNumber(next, verses);
          }
        }
      },
    );

    final effectiveZenDark = _isZenMode
        ? (_zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment
            ? false
            : (_zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack ? true : isDark))
        : isDark;

    final zenBgColor = _isZenMode
        ? (_zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment
            ? const Color(0xFFF5EFE1)
            : (_zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack
                ? Colors.black
                : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor))
        : Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor;

    final zenThemeData = _isZenMode
        ? AppTheme.buildTheme(effectivePalette, isDark: effectiveZenDark).copyWith(
            scaffoldBackgroundColor: zenBgColor,
            cardColor: _zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment
                ? const Color(0xFFEFE7D5)
                : (_zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack ? const Color(0xFF0A0A0A) : null),
          )
        : null;

    final scaffold = Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: zenBgColor,
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          versesAsync.when(
            loading: () => _buildLoadingScaffold(context, strings),
            error: (e, _) => _buildErrorScaffold(context, e.toString(), strings),
            data: (verses) => _buildContent(context, verses, effectiveZenDark, isThisSurahPlaying, activeVerseNumber, strings),
          ),
          // Alt Mini Tilavet Oynatıcısı (Zen modunda dikkati dağıtmamak için gizlenir)
          if (!_isZenMode)
            const Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              child: QuranAudioPlayerBar(),
            ),
          // Zen Modundan Çıkış ve Tema Değiştirme Kayan Hapı
          if (_isZenMode)
            Positioned(
              top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + 8,
              right: 16,
              child: SafeArea(
                child: InkWell(
                  onTap: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    setState(() => _isZenMode = false);
                  },
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.75),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                      border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), width: 1.2),
                      boxShadow: [
                        BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                          blurRadius: 10,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        Icon(Icons.fullscreen_exit_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Zen Çıkış' : 'Exit Zen',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
      floatingActionButton: (_showScrollToTop && !_isZenMode)
          ? Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 60),
              child: FloatingActionButton.small(
                onPressed: _scrollToTop,
                backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
                foregroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                child: const Icon(Icons.keyboard_arrow_up_rounded),
              ),
            )
          : null,
    );

    return zenThemeData != null ? Theme(data: zenThemeData, child: scaffold) : scaffold;
  }

  Widget _buildLoadingScaffold(BuildContext context, AppStrings strings) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code))),
      body: app_widgets.LoadingWidget(message: strings.versesLoading),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildErrorScaffold(BuildContext context, String error, AppStrings strings) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code))),
      body: app_widgets.AppErrorWidget(
        message: '${strings.versesLoadError}\n$error',
        onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(versesBySurahProvider(widget.surah.id)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showReadingToolsSheet(BuildContext context, AppStrings strings) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Consumer(
          builder: (context, ref, _) {
            final audioState = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider);
            final isFavoriteSurah = ref.watch(favoriteSurahsProvider).contains(widget.surah.id);
            final isMemorization = ref.watch(quranMemorizationProvider).isActive;
            final isComparative = ref.watch(comparativeMealProvider);
            final isTr = strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish;

            return Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 14, 20, 28),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01241F),
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.45),
                  width: 1.2,
                ),
              ),
              child: SafeArea(
                top: false,
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: [
                      Center(
                        child: Container(
                          width: 42,
                          height: 4,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white24,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 22),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              isTr ? 'Okuma & Tilavet Araçları' : 'Reading & Recitation Tools',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                fontSize: 18,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          _buildDownloadButton(context, audioState, strings),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 14),

                      // Hızlı Butonlar (Favori, Kâri, Yazı Boyutu, Ambiyans/Uyku)
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildToolActionTile(
                              icon: isFavoriteSurah ? Icons.star_rounded : Icons.star_outline_rounded,
                              label: isFavoriteSurah
                                  ? (isTr ? 'Favoride' : 'Favorited')
                                  : (isTr ? 'Favori Ekle' : 'Favorite'),
                              isActive: isFavoriteSurah,
                              onTap: () {
                                HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                                ref.read(favoriteSurahsProvider.notifier).toggleFavorite(widget.surah.id);
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildToolActionTile(
                              icon: Icons.person_outline_rounded,
                              label: isTr ? 'Hafız Seç' : 'Reciter',
                              isActive: false,
                              onTap: () {
                                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                _showReciterSheet(context, strings);
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildToolActionTile(
                              icon: Icons.format_size_rounded,
                              label: isTr ? 'Yazı Boyutu' : 'Font Size',
                              isActive: false,
                              onTap: () {
                                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                _showFontSizeSheet(context, strings);
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: _buildToolActionTile(
                              icon: Icons.bedtime_rounded,
                              label: isTr ? 'Uyku & Ses' : 'Ambience',
                              isActive: audioState.activeAmbience != null ||
                                  audioState.sleepTimerSecondsRemaining != null,
                              onTap: () {
                                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                                SleepAndAmbienceSheet.show(context);
                              },
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 16),

                      // Zen Okuma Zemini Seçimi (Standart / Sepya Kâğıt / OLED Siyah)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Icon(Icons.palette_outlined, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 18),
                              const SizedBox(width: 8),
                              Text(
                                isTr ? 'Okuma Zemini:' : 'Reading Theme:',
                                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                              ),
                              const Spacer(),
                              _buildZenThemePill(
                                label: 'Standart',
                                theme: ZenReadingTheme.standard,
                                isSelected: _zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.standard,
                                onSelect: () => setState(() => _zenTheme = ZenReadingTheme.standard),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 5),
                              _buildZenThemePill(
                                label: 'Sepya 📜',
                                theme: ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment,
                                isSelected: _zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment,
                                onSelect: () => setState(() => _zenTheme = ZenReadingTheme.sepiaParchment),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 5),
                              _buildZenThemePill(
                                label: 'OLED 🌙',
                                theme: ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack,
                                isSelected: _zenTheme == ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack,
                                onSelect: () => setState(() => _zenTheme = ZenReadingTheme.oledBlack),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      // Anahtarlar (Switches)
                      _buildToolSwitchRow(
                        icon: Icons.visibility_off_rounded,
                        title: isTr ? 'Ezber & Hafızlık Testi (Kelimeleri Gizle)' : 'Memorization Mode (Blur Words)',
                        subtitle: isTr ? 'Kelimeleri buğular, dokundukça açarak ezberinizi sınar' : 'Tap blurred words to reveal and test memory',
                        value: isMemorization,
                        onChanged: (_) {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          ref.read(quranMemorizationProvider.notifier).toggleMode();
                        },
                      ),
                      _buildToolSwitchRow(
                        icon: Icons.compare_arrows_rounded,
                        title: isTr ? 'Çift Mealli Karşılaştırma Modu' : 'Comparative Translation Mode',
                        subtitle: isTr ? 'Diyanet ve Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır meallerini alt alta kıyaslar' : 'Compare two translations side by side',
                        value: isComparative,
                        onChanged: (_) {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          ref.read(comparativeMealProvider.notifier).toggle();
                        },
                      ),
                      _buildToolSwitchRow(
                        icon: Icons.auto_stories_rounded,
                        title: isTr ? 'Canlı Âyet Takibi (Otomatik Kaydırma)' : 'Live Verse Auto-Scroll',
                        subtitle: isTr ? 'Tilavet esnasında okunan âyete otomatik kaydırır' : 'Automatically scrolls to active verse',
                        value: audioState.isLiveTrackingEnabled,
                        onChanged: (_) {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).toggleLiveTracking();
                        },
                      ),
                      _buildToolSwitchRow(
                        icon: Icons.spellcheck_rounded,
                        title: strings.wordByWordLiveTracking,
                        subtitle: isTr ? 'Okunan Arapça kelimeyi altın renkle vurgular' : 'Highlights the active Arabic word in gold',
                        value: audioState.isWordHighlightEnabled,
                        onChanged: (_) {
                          HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                          ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).toggleWordHighlight();
                        },
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildZenThemePill({
    required String label,
    required ZenReadingTheme theme,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onSelect,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        onSelect();
      },
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
              : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected
                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                : Colors.white12,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 10.5,
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
            color: isSelected ? Colors.black : Colors.white70,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToolActionTile({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required bool isActive,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
      onTap: onTap,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10, horizontal: 6),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isActive
              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.22)
              : Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isActive
                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.25),
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              color: isActive ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white,
              size: 20,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 5),
            Text(
              label,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10.5,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: isActive ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white,
              ),
              maxLines: 1,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildToolSwitchRow({
    required IconData icon,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required bool value,
    required ValueChanged<bool> onChanged,
  }) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.04),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(
            color: value
                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5)
                : Colors.white10,
          ),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(icon, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 20),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    title,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      fontSize: 13,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    subtitle,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white60, fontSize: 11),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            Switch(
              value: value,
              activeThumbColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              activeTrackColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
              onChanged: onChanged,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildContent(
    BuildContext context,
    List<Verse> verses,
    bool isDark,
    bool isThisSurahPlaying,
    int? activeVerseNumber,
    AppStrings strings,
  ) {
    final hasActiveToolBadge = ref.watch(quranMemorizationProvider).isActive ||
        ref.watch(comparativeMealProvider) ||
        ref.watch(quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.activeAmbience != null || s.sleepTimerSecondsRemaining != null));

    if (_isMushafMode) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).scaffoldBackgroundColor,
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(
            widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code),
            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 18),
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
          centerTitle: false,
          actions: [
            // 1. Ayet Listesi Görünümüne Geçiş
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.format_list_bulleted_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
              tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Ayet Listesi Görünümüne Geç' : 'Switch to Verse List',
              onPressed: () {
                HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                setState(() => _isMushafMode = false);
              },
            ),
            // 2. Tilavet Oynat/Durdur
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(
                isThisSurahPlaying ? Icons.pause_circle_filled_rounded : Icons.play_circle_fill_rounded,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                size: 27,
              ),
              onPressed: () {
                HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                if (isThisSurahPlaying) {
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).togglePlayPause();
                } else {
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).setVerses(verses);
                  final sName = widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code);
                  if (widget.initialScrollToVerse != null &&
                      widget.initialScrollToVerse! > 1 &&
                      ref.read(quranAudioProvider).currentSurahId != widget.surah.id) {
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekToVerse(
                          widget.initialScrollToVerse!,
                          verses,
                          surahName: sName,
                        );
                  } else {
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).playSurah(widget.surah.id, sName);
                  }
                }
              },
            ),
            // 3. Tüm Okuma & Tilavet Araçları (Toplu, Ferah Menü)
            IconButton(
              icon: Badge(
                isLabelVisible: hasActiveToolBadge,
                backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                child: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, color: Colors.white),
              ),
              tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Okuma & Tilavet Araçları' : 'Reading & Audio Tools',
              onPressed: () => _showReadingToolsSheet(context, strings),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
          ],
        ),
        body: MushafPageView(
          surah: widget.surah,
          verses: verses,
          initialVerseNumber: widget.initialScrollToVerse,
          onSwitchToListMode: () => setState(() => _isMushafMode = false),
        ),
      );
    }

    if (!_hasScrolledToInitialVerse &&
        widget.initialScrollToVerse != null &&
        widget.initialScrollToVerse! >= 1) {
      _scrollToInitialVerseIfNeeded(verses);
    }

    return CustomScrollView(
      controller: _scrollController,
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      slivers: [
        // ── Sure Başlığı AppBar (Ferah & Toplu Üst Bar) ─────────────────────────────
        SliverAppBar(
          expandedHeight: 210,
          pinned: true,
          backgroundColor: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01201B) : AppColors.teal,
          title: Text(
            widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code),
            style: const TextStyle(
              color: Colors.white,
              fontSize: 18,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
            maxLines: 1,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
          centerTitle: false,
          actions: [
            // 1. Orijinal Mushaf Sayfa Moduna Geçiş Butonu
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
              tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Orijinal Mushaf Sayfa Modu' : 'Original Mushaf Page View',
              onPressed: () {
                HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                setState(() => _isMushafMode = true);
              },
            ),
            // 2. Tilavet Dinle Butonu
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(
                isThisSurahPlaying ? Icons.pause_circle_filled_rounded : Icons.play_circle_fill_rounded,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                size: 28,
              ),
              tooltip: isThisSurahPlaying
                  ? (strings.language == AppLanguage.english
                      ? 'Pause Recitation'
                      : (strings.language == AppLanguage.arabic ? 'إيقاف مؤقت' : 'Tilaveti Duraklat'))
                  : strings.listenSurahTooltip,
              onPressed: () {
                HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                if (isThisSurahPlaying) {
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).togglePlayPause();
                } else {
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).setVerses(verses);
                  final sName = widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code);
                  if (widget.initialScrollToVerse != null &&
                      widget.initialScrollToVerse! > 1 &&
                      ref.read(quranAudioProvider).currentSurahId != widget.surah.id) {
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekToVerse(
                          widget.initialScrollToVerse!,
                          verses,
                          surahName: sName,
                        );
                  } else {
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).playSurah(widget.surah.id, sName);
                  }
                }
              },
            ),
            // 3. Tüm Okuma & Tilavet Araçları (Favori, Hafız, Ezber, Çift Meal, Uyku/Ambiyans, Boyut)
            IconButton(
              icon: Badge(
                isLabelVisible: hasActiveToolBadge,
                backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                child: const Icon(Icons.tune_rounded, color: Colors.white),
              ),
              tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Okuma & Tilavet Araçları' : 'Reading & Audio Tools',
              onPressed: () => _showReadingToolsSheet(context, strings),
            ),
            // 4. Zen / Fokus Modu Butonu (Sinematik Mushaf)
            IconButton(
              icon: Icon(
                _isZenMode ? Icons.fullscreen_exit_rounded : Icons.spa_rounded,
                color: _isZenMode ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFD54F) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
              ),
              tooltip: _isZenMode
                  ? (strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Zen Modundan Çık' : 'Exit Zen Mode')
                  : (strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Zen / Odaklanma Modu' : 'Zen Focus Mode'),
              onPressed: () {
                HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                setState(() => _isZenMode = !_isZenMode);
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
          ],
          flexibleSpace: FlexibleSpaceBar(
            background: Container(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  colors: isDark
                      ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF064E43), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011B18)]
                      : [AppColors.tealDark, AppColors.primary],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                ),
              ),
              child: SafeArea(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    const SizedBox(height: 30),
                    ArabicText(
                      widget.surah.nameArabic,
                      fontSize: 38.0,
                      lineHeight: 1.6,
                      color: Colors.white,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Text(
                      '${widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code)}  ·  ${strings.language == AppLanguage.english ? widget.surah.nameArabic : widget.surah.nameEnglish}',
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 15, letterSpacing: 0.3),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(
                      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        _StatBadge(icon: Icons.format_list_numbered_rounded, label: strings.surahNumberBadge(widget.surah.id)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        _StatBadge(icon: Icons.text_fields_rounded, label: widget.surah.localizedVerseCount(strings.language.code)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 8),
                        _StatBadge(icon: Icons.place_rounded, label: widget.surah.localizedRevelation(strings.language.code)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),

        // ── Besmele (Tevbe Suresi hariç) ───────────────────
        if (widget.surah.id != 9 && widget.surah.id != 1)
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: _BismillahCard(isDark: isDark),
          ),

        // ── Ayet Listesi ────────────────────────────────────
        SliverList(
          delegate: SliverChildBuilderDelegate(
            (context, index) {
              final verse = verses[index];
              final isTarget = widget.initialScrollToVerse == verse.verseNumber;
              final isPlayingVerse = isThisSurahPlaying && activeVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber;
              final sName = widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code);
              return RepaintBoundary(
                child: VerseCard(
                  key: isPlayingVerse ? _playingVerseKey : (isTarget ? _targetVerseKey : ValueKey('v_${verse.id}')),
                  verse: verse,
                  surahName: sName,
                  isHighlighted: isTarget,
                  isPlaying: isPlayingVerse,
                  onWordTap: (wordIdx) {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekToWord(
                          verse.verseNumber,
                          wordIdx,
                          verses,
                          surahName: sName,
                        );
                  },
                  onTap: () {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekToVerse(
                          verse.verseNumber,
                          verses,
                          surahName: sName,
                        );
                  },
                ),
              );
            },
            childCount: verses.length,
          ),
        ),

        // Alt boşluk (Mini oynatıcı çubuğu için)
        const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 100)),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _StatBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  const _StatBadge({required this.icon, required this.label});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white24),
      ),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Icon(icon, color: Colors.white70, size: 12),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _BismillahCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool isDark;
  const _BismillahCard({required this.isDark});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 16, 16, 4),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18, horizontal: 16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: AppColors.teal.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.15 : 0.07),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        border: Border.all(
          color: AppColors.teal.withValues(alpha: 0.25),
          width: 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          ArabicText.bismillah(
            color: isDark ? AppColors.arabicTextDark : AppColors.tealDark,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 6),
          Text(
            'Bismillâhirrahmânirrahîm',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 14,
              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
              color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
              letterSpacing: 0.3,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

enum _QuranTab { surahs, juzs, versesAndDuas, favorites }
enum _SurahFilter { all, meccan, medinan, famous }

/// Kur'an-ı Kerim Ekranı
/// - 3 Ana Kategori: Sureler (114), Cüzler (30 Cüz), Önemli Âyet & Dualar
/// - Akıllı Arama: Sureler + Âyetü'l-Kürsî ve diğer dualar + Dua Kütüphanesi Köprüsü
/// - 120 FPS Donanım Hızlandırmalı Akıcı Kaydırma (itemExtent optimize)
class SurahListScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const SurahListScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<SurahListScreen> createState() => _SurahListScreenState();
}

class _SurahListScreenState extends ConsumerState<SurahListScreen> {
  final _searchController = TextEditingController();
  _QuranTab _selectedTab = _QuranTab.surahs;
  _SurahFilter _selectedFilter = _SurahFilter.all;

  static const _famousSurahIds = {1, 2, 18, 36, 48, 55, 56, 67, 78, 94, 112, 113, 114};

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _openSurahAtVerse(Surah surah, int verseNumber) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      LuxuryPageRoute(
        page: SurahDetailScreen(
          surah: surah,
          initialScrollToVerse: verseNumber,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _openDuaLibraryWithQuery(String query) {
    HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
    ref.read(duaSearchQueryProvider.notifier).state = query;
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      LuxuryPageRoute(page: const DuaLibraryScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final allSurahsAsync = ref.watch(allSurahsProvider);
    final allSurahs = allSurahsAsync.valueOrNull ?? [];
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final lastRead = ref.watch(lastReadProvider);
    final searchQuery = _searchController.text.trim();
    final isSearching = searchQuery.isNotEmpty;

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: isDark ? effectivePalette.darkBackground : effectivePalette.lightBackground,
      appBar: AppBar(
        backgroundColor: isDark ? effectivePalette.darkSurface : effectivePalette.primaryColor,
        title: Text(
          strings.quranTitle,
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 0.3),
        ),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.settings_outlined, color: Colors.white),
            tooltip: strings.settings,
            onPressed: () => SettingsScreen.show(context),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
        ],
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          Column(
            children: [
              // ── Arama Çubuğu ──────────────────────────────────────────────
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 6),
                child: Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF07201C) : Colors.white,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
                      width: 1,
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.2 : 0.03),
                        blurRadius: 8,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: _searchController,
                    onChanged: (q) {
                      setState(() {});
                    },
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14.5,
                      color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                    ),
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      hintText: strings.searchQuranHint,
                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : AppColors.textHint,
                      ),
                      prefixIcon: Icon(
                        Icons.search_rounded,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        size: 20,
                      ),
                      suffixIcon: _searchController.text.isNotEmpty
                          ? IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.clear_rounded, size: 18),
                              onPressed: () {
                                _searchController.clear();
                                setState(() {});
                              },
                            )
                          : null,
                      border: InputBorder.none,
                      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 16,
                        vertical: 12,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              // ── Kaldığım Yerden Devam Et Kartı ─────────────────────────────
              if (lastRead != null && !isSearching)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 2, 16, 6),
                  child: InkWell(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    onTap: () {
                      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                      final targetSurah = allSurahs.firstWhere(
                        (s) => s.id == lastRead.surahId,
                        orElse: () => allSurahs.isNotEmpty ? allSurahs.first : const Surah(
                          id: 1,
                          nameArabic: 'الفاتحة',
                          nameTurkish: 'Fâtiha',
                          nameEnglish: 'Al-Fatiha',
                          revelationType: 'meccan',
                          verseCount: 7,
                        ),
                      );
                      _openSurahAtVerse(targetSurah, lastRead.verseNumber);
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: LinearGradient(
                          colors: [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF034A3E)],
                        ),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                          width: 1,
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(5),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                            child: Icon(Icons.bookmark_added_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  strings.resumeReading,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                Text(
                                  '${lastRead.surahName} • ${strings.verseNumberLabel(lastRead.verseNumber)}',
                                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white70),
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                          Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 12),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              // ── 3 Ana Kategori Sekmesi (Sureler / Cüzler / Önemli Âyet & Dualar) ──
              if (!isSearching)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 2, 16, 6),
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3.5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06221D) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE9F3EE),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.2),
                        width: 1,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildCategoryTabButton(
                            label: strings.tabSurahs,
                            icon: Icons.auto_stories_rounded,
                            isActive: _selectedTab == _QuranTab.surahs,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              setState(() {
                                _selectedTab = _QuranTab.surahs;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildCategoryTabButton(
                            label: '${strings.tabJuzs} (30)',
                            icon: Icons.menu_book_rounded,
                            isActive: _selectedTab == _QuranTab.juzs,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              setState(() {
                                _selectedTab = _QuranTab.juzs;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildCategoryTabButton(
                            label: strings.tabImportantVerses,
                            icon: Icons.spa_rounded,
                            isActive: _selectedTab == _QuranTab.versesAndDuas,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              setState(() {
                                _selectedTab = _QuranTab.versesAndDuas;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Expanded(
                          child: _buildCategoryTabButton(
                            label: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Favoriler' : 'Favorites',
                            icon: Icons.star_rounded,
                            isActive: _selectedTab == _QuranTab.favorites,
                            onTap: () {
                              HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                              setState(() {
                                _selectedTab = _QuranTab.favorites;
                              });
                            },
                            isDark: isDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              // ── Sureler Alt Filtre Çipleri (Mekkî / Medenî / Meşhur) ─────────
              if (!isSearching && _selectedTab == _QuranTab.surahs)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 2, 16, 6),
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                    physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        _buildFilterPill(
                          label: strings.filterAllSurahs,
                          isSelected: _selectedFilter == _SurahFilter.all,
                          onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFilter = _SurahFilter.all),
                          isDark: isDark,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        _buildFilterPill(
                          label: strings.filterMeccan,
                          isSelected: _selectedFilter == _SurahFilter.meccan,
                          onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFilter = _SurahFilter.meccan),
                          isDark: isDark,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        _buildFilterPill(
                          label: strings.filterMedinan,
                          isSelected: _selectedFilter == _SurahFilter.medinan,
                          onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFilter = _SurahFilter.medinan),
                          isDark: isDark,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        _buildFilterPill(
                          label: '✨ ${strings.filterFamousSurahs}',
                          isSelected: _selectedFilter == _SurahFilter.famous,
                          onTap: () => setState(() => _selectedFilter = _SurahFilter.famous),
                          isDark: isDark,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

              // ── Ana İçerik Görünümü ────────────────────────────────────────
              Expanded(
                child: allSurahsAsync.when(
                  loading: () => app_widgets.LoadingWidget(message: strings.versesLoading),
                  error: (e, _) => app_widgets.AppErrorWidget(
                    message: strings.versesLoadError,
                    onRetry: () => ref.invalidate(allSurahsProvider),
                  ),
                  data: (surahs) {
                    // Arama Yapılıyorsa
                    if (isSearching) {
                      return _buildSearchResultsView(
                        query: searchQuery,
                        allSurahs: surahs,
                        strings: strings,
                        isDark: isDark,
                      );
                    }

                    // Sekmeye Göre Gösterim
                    switch (_selectedTab) {
                      case _QuranTab.surahs:
                        return _buildSurahsListView(
                          allSurahs: surahs,
                          filter: _selectedFilter,
                          strings: strings,
                          isDark: isDark,
                        );
                      case _QuranTab.juzs:
                        return _buildJuzsGridView(
                          allSurahs: surahs,
                          strings: strings,
                          isDark: isDark,
                        );
                      case _QuranTab.versesAndDuas:
                        return _buildFeaturedVersesAndDuasView(
                          allSurahs: surahs,
                          strings: strings,
                          isDark: isDark,
                        );
                      case _QuranTab.favorites:
                        return _buildFavoritesView(
                          allSurahs: surahs,
                          strings: strings,
                          isDark: isDark,
                        );
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ),

              // Alt banner reklam
              const BannerAdWidget(),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryTabButton({
    required String label,
    required IconData icon,
    required bool isActive,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isActive
              ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F3E34) : Colors.white)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          boxShadow: isActive
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.05),
                    blurRadius: 4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                  ),
                ]
              : null,
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              size: 14,
              color: isActive
                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                  : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 4),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11.5,
                  fontWeight: isActive ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
                  color: isActive
                      ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B))
                      : (isDark ? Colors.white60 : Colors.black54),
                ),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterPill({
    required String label,
    required bool isSelected,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
        onTap();
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
              : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF082621) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF1F6F4)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(
            color: isSelected
                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.2),
            width: 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 11.5,
            fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
            color: isSelected
                ? Colors.black87
                : (isDark ? Colors.white70 : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35)),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ── Sureler Listesi (Ultra Hızlı 120 FPS - itemExtent Optimize) ─────────────
  Widget _buildSurahsListView({
    required List<Surah> allSurahs,
    required _SurahFilter filter,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final filtered = allSurahs.where((s) {
      switch (filter) {
        case _SurahFilter.all:
          return true;
        case _SurahFilter.meccan:
          return s.isMeccan;
        case _SurahFilter.medinan:
          return !s.isMeccan;
        case _SurahFilter.famous:
          return _famousSurahIds.contains(s.id);
      }
    }).toList();

    return ListView.builder(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 90, top: 2),
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      itemExtent: 74.0,
      scrollCacheExtent: const ScrollCacheExtent.viewport(2.0),
      addRepaintBoundaries: true,
      itemCount: filtered.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final surah = filtered[index];
        return SurahListItem(
          surah: surah,
          langCode: strings.language.code,
          onTap: () => _openSurahAtVerse(surah, 1),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ── 30 Cüz Vitrini ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildJuzsGridView({
    required List<Surah> allSurahs,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    return ListView.builder(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 90),
      itemCount: quranJuzList.length,
      itemBuilder: (context, index) {
        final juz = quranJuzList[index];
        final matchingSurah = allSurahs.firstWhere(
          (s) => s.nameTurkish.toLowerCase().contains(juz.startSurah.toLowerCase()) ||
                 juz.startSurah.toLowerCase().contains(s.nameTurkish.toLowerCase()),
          orElse: () => allSurahs.isNotEmpty ? allSurahs.first : const Surah(
            id: 1,
            nameArabic: 'الفاتحة',
            nameTurkish: 'Fâtiha',
            nameEnglish: 'Al-Fatiha',
            revelationType: 'meccan',
            verseCount: 7,
          ),
        );

        return RepaintBoundary(
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D2823) : Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
              border: Border.all(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF133B34) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE5ECE9),
                width: 1,
              ),
            ),
            child: Material(
              color: Colors.transparent,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),
              child: InkWell(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),

  // ── Akıllı Arama Sonuçları Görünümü ────────────────────────────────────────
  Widget _buildSearchResultsView({
    required String query,
    required List<Surah> allSurahs,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final normQuery = QuranFeaturedVerse.normalize(query);

    // 1. Eşleşen Sureler
    final matchedSurahs = allSurahs.where((s) {
      if (normQuery.isEmpty) return true;
      final t = QuranFeaturedVerse.normalize(s.nameTurkish);
      final e = QuranFeaturedVerse.normalize(s.nameEnglish);
      final idStr = s.id.toString();
      return t.contains(normQuery) || e.contains(normQuery) || s.nameArabic.contains(query) || idStr == query;
    }).toList();

    // 2. Eşleşen Önemli Âyet & Dualar (örn: 'aye' -> Âyetü'l-Kürsî!)
    final matchedVerses = featuredQuranicVersesList.where((v) => v.matchesQuery(query)).toList();

    if (matchedSurahs.isEmpty && matchedVerses.isEmpty) {
      return Center(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.search_off_rounded, size: 52, color: AppColors.textHint),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Text(
                strings.noSurahFound,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 15,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Text(
                'Aradığınız dua veya ayet Kur\'an kütüphanesinde bulunamadıysa Dua Kütüphanesi\'nde arayabilirsiniz.',
                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _openDuaLibraryWithQuery(query),
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                  foregroundColor: Colors.black,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.menu_book_rounded, size: 18),
                label: Text(
                  '${strings.searchInDuaLibrary} ("$query")',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 12),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return ListView(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 4, 16, 90),
      children: [
        // ── Dua Kütüphanesinde Arama Hızlı Butonu ──────────────────────
        Container(
          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.auto_stories_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), size: 18),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Dua Kütüphanesi\'nde "$query" ara (40+ Dua)',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => _openDuaLibraryWithQuery(query),
                style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                  visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                ),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Text('Aç', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37))),
                    Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded, size: 14, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

        // ── Eşleşen Önemli Âyet & Dualar Bölümü ────────────────────────
        if (matchedVerses.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.stars_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 16),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  '${strings.foundVersesAndDuas} (${matchedVerses.length})',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          ...matchedVerses.map((verse) {
            final targetSurah = allSurahs.firstWhere(
              (s) => s.id == verse.surahId,
              orElse: () => allSurahs.isNotEmpty ? allSurahs.first : const Surah(
                id: 2,
                nameArabic: 'البقرة',
                nameTurkish: 'Bakara',
                nameEnglish: 'Al-Baqarah',
                revelationType: 'medinan',
                verseCount: 286,
              ),
            );
            return _buildFeaturedVerseCard(
              verse: verse,
              surah: targetSurah,
              strings: strings,
              isDark: isDark,
            );
          }),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
        ],

        // ── Eşleşen Sureler Bölümü ────────────────────────────────────
        if (matchedSurahs.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.format_list_bulleted_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), size: 16),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  '${strings.foundSurahs} (${matchedSurahs.length})',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF02362E),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          ...matchedSurahs.map((surah) {
            return SurahListItem(
              surah: surah,
              langCode: strings.language.code,
              onTap: () => _openSurahAtVerse(surah, 1),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFavoritesView({
    required List<Surah> allSurahs,
    required AppStrings strings,
    required bool isDark,
  }) {
    final favoriteSurahIds = ref.watch(favoriteSurahsProvider);
    final bookmarkedKeys = ref.watch(bookmarkedVersesProvider);

    final favoriteSurahs = allSurahs.where((s) => favoriteSurahIds.contains(s.id)).toList();
    final sortedBookmarks = bookmarkedKeys.toList()..sort();

    final isEmpty = favoriteSurahs.isEmpty && sortedBookmarks.isEmpty;

    if (isEmpty) {
      return _buildQuranFavoritesEmptyState(isDark: isDark, strings: strings);
    }

    return ListView(
      physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
      children: [
        // ── Favori Sureler Bölümü ───────────────────────────────────
        if (favoriteSurahs.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 6, 4, 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 18),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                      ? 'Favori Sureler (${favoriteSurahs.length})'
                      : 'Favorite Surahs (${favoriteSurahs.length})',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          ...favoriteSurahs.map((surah) {
            return SurahListItem(
              surah: surah,
              langCode: strings.language.code,
              onTap: () => _openSurahAtVerse(surah, 1),
            );
          }),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
        ],

        // ── Kaydedilen Ayetler Bölümü ────────────────────────────────
        if (sortedBookmarks.isNotEmpty) ...[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(4, 6, 4, 8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Icon(Icons.bookmark_added_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), size: 18),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                      ? 'Kaydedilen Âyetler (${sortedBookmarks.length})'
                      : 'Bookmarked Verses (${sortedBookmarks.length})',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          ...sortedBookmarks.map((key) {
            final parts = key.split(':');
            final sId = int.tryParse(parts.first) ?? 1;
            final vNum = int.tryParse(parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : '1') ?? 1;

            final targetSurah = allSurahs.firstWhere(
              (s) => s.id == sId,
              orElse: () => allSurahs.isNotEmpty ? allSurahs.first : const Surah(
                id: 1,
                nameArabic: 'الفاتحة',
                nameTurkish: 'Fâtiha',
                nameEnglish: 'Al-Fatiha',
                revelationType: 'meccan',
                verseCount: 7,
              ),
            );

            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF082621) : Colors.white,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.25),
                  width: 1,
                ),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.2 : 0.04),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Material(
                color: Colors.transparent,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                child: InkWell(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  onTap: () => _openSurahAtVerse(targetSurah, vNum),
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        Container(
                          width: 40,
                          height: 40,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                              width: 1,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Center(
                            child: Text(
                              '$vNum',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF033E35),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: [
                              Text(
                                '${targetSurah.localizedName(strings.language.code)} • ${strings.verseNumberLabel(vNum)}',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF02362E),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 3),
                              Text(
                                '${targetSurah.localizedRevelation(strings.language.code)} • ${targetSurah.localizedVerseCount(strings.language.code)}',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  color: isDark ? Colors.white54 : AppColors.textSecondary,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                          icon: Icon(Icons.star_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 22),
                          tooltip: strings.removeBookmark,
                          onPressed: () {
                            HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
                            ref.read(bookmarkedVersesProvider.notifier).toggleBookmark(sId, vNum);
                          },
                        ),
                        Icon(
                          Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded,
                          size: 13,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

import 'dart:async';

/// Kur'an tilavetinde kelime kelime milisaniyelik zamanlama segmenti.
class WordSegment {
  final int wordIndex; // Quran.com API'den gelen 1 tabanlı kelime sırası
  final int startMs;
  final int endMs;

  const WordSegment({
    required this.wordIndex,
    required this.startMs,
    required this.endMs,
  });

  factory WordSegment.fromList(List<dynamic> list) {
    final wIdx = (list[0] as num).toInt();
    final start = (list[1] as num).round();
    final end = (list[2] as num).round();
    return WordSegment(wordIndex: wIdx, startMs: start, endMs: end);
  }
}

/// Kur'an tilavetinde ayet bazlı milisaniyelik zamanlama ve kelime segmentleri.
class VerseTiming {
  final int surahId;
  final int verseNumber;
  final int timestampFrom;
  final int timestampTo;
  final int duration;
  final List<WordSegment> segments;

  const VerseTiming({
    required this.surahId,
    required this.verseNumber,
    required this.timestampFrom,
    required this.timestampTo,
    required this.duration,
    required this.segments,
  });

  factory VerseTiming.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    final verseKey = json['verse_key'] as String? ?? '1:1';
    final parts = verseKey.split(':');
    final sId = parts.length > 1 ? int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? 1 : 1;
    final vNum = parts.length > 1 ? int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? 1 : 1;

    final from = (json['timestamp_from'] as num?)?.round() ?? 0;
    final to = (json['timestamp_to'] as num?)?.round() ?? 0;
    final dur = (json['duration'] as num?)?.round().abs() ?? (to - from).abs();

    final rawSegments = json['segments'] as List<dynamic>? ?? [];
    final segList = <WordSegment>[];
    for (final s in rawSegments) {
      if (s is List && s.length >= 3) {
        segList.add(WordSegment.fromList(s));
      }
    }

    return VerseTiming(
      surahId: sId,
      verseNumber: vNum,
      timestampFrom: from,
      timestampTo: to,
      duration: dur,
      segments: segList,
    );
  }
}

class QuranReciter {
  final String id;
  final String nameTr;
  final String nameAr;
  final String baseUrl;
  final int? quranComReciterId;
  final bool usesPadding;

  const QuranReciter({
    required this.id,
    required this.nameTr,
    required this.nameAr,
    required this.baseUrl,
    this.quranComReciterId,
    this.usesPadding = false,
  });

  String getSurahAudioUrl(int surahId) {
    if (usesPadding) {
      final code = surahId.toString().padLeft(3, '0');
      return '$baseUrl$code.mp3';
    }
    return '$baseUrl$surahId.mp3';
  }
}
