`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../../core/services/acoustic_audio_service.dart';
import '../models/surah.dart';
import '../models/verse.dart';
import '../services/quran_audio_service.dart';

/// Beyân - Orijinal Mushaf Sayfa Görünümü (Sayfa Sayfa Çevirme)
/// Medine ve Diyanet baskısı lüks tezhibli hat görünümü.
class MushafPageView extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final Surah surah;
  final List<Verse> verses;
  final int? initialVerseNumber;
  final VoidCallback onSwitchToListMode;

  const MushafPageView({
    super.key,
    required this.surah,
    required this.verses,
    this.initialVerseNumber,
    required this.onSwitchToListMode,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<MushafPageView> createState() => _MushafPageViewState();
}

class _MushafPageViewState extends ConsumerState<MushafPageView> {
  late PageController _pageController;
  late List<List<Verse>> _pages;
  int _currentPageIndex = 0;
  int _lastHapticMilestone = -1;
  double _fontSize = 22.0;
  bool _showInlineTranslation = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _pages = _partitionVersesIntoPages(widget.verses);
    final initialPage = _findInitialPageIndex();
    _currentPageIndex = initialPage;
    _pageController = PageController(initialPage: initialPage)
      ..addListener(_onPageScrollTick);
  }

  void _onPageScrollTick() {
    if (!_pageController.hasClients || !_pageController.position.haveDimensions) return;
    final page = _pageController.page ?? _currentPageIndex.toDouble();
    final fraction = (page - page.floor()).abs();
    // Parmakla sayfa kıvrılırken %35 geçiş eşiğinde ince dokunsal sayfa gerilimi hissi
    final milestone = (fraction > 0.32 && fraction < 0.68) ? page.floor() : -1;
    if (milestone != -1 && milestone != _lastHapticMilestone) {
      _lastHapticMilestone = milestone;
      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    } else if (milestone == -1) {
      _lastHapticMilestone = -1;
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant MushafPageView oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (oldWidget.verses != widget.verses) {
      setState(() {
        _pages = _partitionVersesIntoPages(widget.verses);
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _pageController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  int _findInitialPageIndex() {
    if (widget.initialVerseNumber == null || _pages.isEmpty) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < _pages.length; i++) {
      if (_pages[i].any((v) => v.verseNumber == widget.initialVerseNumber)) {
        return i;
      }
    }
    return 0;
  }

  List<List<Verse>> _partitionVersesIntoPages(List<Verse> verses) {
    if (verses.isEmpty) return [];
    final pages = <List<Verse>>[];
    var currentPage = <Verse>[];
    var currentChars = 0;
    const targetCharsPerPage = 540;

    for (final v in verses) {
      final vLen = v.arabicText.length;
      if (currentChars + vLen > targetCharsPerPage && currentPage.isNotEmpty) {
        pages.add(currentPage);
        currentPage = [v];
        currentChars = vLen;
      } else {
        currentPage.add(v);
        currentChars += vLen;
      }
    }
    if (currentPage.isNotEmpty) {
      pages.add(currentPage);
    }
    return pages;
  }

  Widget _buildMushafVerseRichText({
    required Verse verse,
    required bool isDark,
    required bool isActiveVerse,
    required int? activeWordIndex,
    required double wordProgress,
  }) {
    final defaultColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFE082) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B);
    if (!isActiveVerse || activeWordIndex == null) {
      return Text.rich(
        TextSpan(
          children: [
            TextSpan(
              text: verse.arabicText,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                fontSize: _fontSize,
                height: 2.15,
                letterSpacing: 0.2,
                color: defaultColor,
                fontWeight: isActiveVerse ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
            TextSpan(
              text: ' ﴿${verse.verseNumber}﴾ ',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                fontSize: _fontSize * 0.85,
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
        textAlign: TextAlign.justify,
      );
    }

    final words = verse.arabicText.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).where((w) => w.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final clampedWordIdx = words.isNotEmpty ? activeWordIndex.clamp(0, words.length - 1) : 0;
    final wp = wordProgress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final sweep = wp * 1.20 - 0.10;
    final leadStop = (sweep - 0.10).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final trailStop = (sweep + 0.10).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final litGold = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B);
    final unlitColor = isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.36) : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.34);

    return Text.rich(
      TextSpan(
        children: [
          for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) ...[
            if (i == clampedWordIdx)
              WidgetSpan(
                alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.baseline,
                baseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                child: ShaderMask(
                  blendMode: BlendMode.srcIn,
                  shaderCallback: (bounds) {
                    return LinearGradient(
                      begin: Alignment.centerRight,
                      end: Alignment.centerLeft,
                      colors: [
                        isDark ? const Color(0xFFFFF6CC) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
                        litGold,
                        unlitColor,
                        unlitColor,
                      ],
                      stops: [0.0, leadStop, trailStop, 1.0],
                    ).createShader(bounds);
                  },
                  child: Text(
                    words[i],
                    textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                      fontSize: _fontSize * 1.04,
                      height: 2.0,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: Colors.white,
                      shadows: [
                        Shadow(
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                          blurRadius: 10,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              )
            else
              TextSpan(
                text: words[i],
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                  fontSize: _fontSize,
                  height: 2.15,
                  letterSpacing: 0.2,
                  color: i < clampedWordIdx ? defaultColor : unlitColor,
                  fontWeight: i < clampedWordIdx ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
                ),
              ),
            if (i < words.length - 1)
              TextSpan(
                text: ' ',
                style: TextStyle(fontFamily: 'Amiri', fontSize: _fontSize, height: 2.15),
              ),
          ],
          TextSpan(
            text: ' ﴿${verse.verseNumber}﴾ ',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontFamily: 'Amiri',
              fontSize: _fontSize * 0.85,
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
      textAlign: TextAlign.justify,
    );
  }

  void _onVerseTap(Verse verse, AppStrings strings) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    _showVerseDetailSheet(context, verse, strings);
  }

  void _showVerseDetailSheet(BuildContext context, Verse verse, AppStrings strings) {
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 30),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF06221D) : Colors.white,
            borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            border: Border.all(
              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Center(
                child: Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 4,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: Colors.white24,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.16),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      border: Border.all(
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
                        width: 1,
                      ),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      '${widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code)} • ${verse.verseNumber}. Âyet',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: Icon(Icons.copy_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), size: 20),
                    tooltip: strings.copyAndShare,
                    onPressed: () {
                      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                      final text = '${verse.arabicText}\n\n'
                          '${verse.transliteration ?? ''}\n\n'
                          '${verse.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code)}\n\n'
                          '(${widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code)} ${verse.verseNumber})';
                      Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(
                          content: Text(strings.duaCopied),
                          duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
                          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Container(
                width: double.infinity,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF031A16) : const Color(0xFFF9FBF9),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.2)),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  verse.arabicText,
                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                    fontSize: 21,
                    height: 1.8,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              if (verse.transliteration != null && verse.transliteration!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Text(
                  verse.transliteration!,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12.5,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                    color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
              Text(
                verse.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code),
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13.5,
                  height: 1.45,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final audioState = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider);
    final activeVerseNumber = audioState.activeVerseNumber;

    // Sayfalar boşsa
    if (_pages.isEmpty) {
      return Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)));
    }

    // Sesli tilavet ilerlerken aktif ayet başka bir sayfadaysa sayfayı otomatik çevir
    ref.listen<QuranAudioState>(quranAudioProvider, (prev, next) {
      if (next.currentSurahId == widget.surah.id && next.isPlaying && next.activeVerseNumber != null) {
        final targetPageIdx = _pages.indexWhere((p) => p.any((v) => v.verseNumber == next.activeVerseNumber));
        if (targetPageIdx != -1 && targetPageIdx != _currentPageIndex && _pageController.hasClients) {
          _pageController.animateToPage(
            targetPageIdx,
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 350),
            curve: Curves.easeInOut,
          );
        }
      }
    });

    final totalPages = _pages.length;

    return Column(
      children: [
        // ── Üst Mushaf Çubuğu (Görünüm Değiştir / Boyut / Sayfa Bilgisi) ──────
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF031A16) : const Color(0xFFF6F3E9),
            border: Border(
              bottom: BorderSide(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.25),
                width: 1,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              // Liste Görünümüne Geçiş Butonu
              InkWell(
                onTap: widget.onSwitchToListMode,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Icon(Icons.format_list_bulleted_rounded, size: 14, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text(
                        'Ayet Listesi',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              const Spacer(),

              // Yazı Boyutu A- / A+
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.text_decrease_rounded, size: 18),
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                tooltip: 'Yazı Boyutunu Küçült',
                onPressed: () {
                  if (_fontSize > 18.0) {
                    setState(() => _fontSize -= 2.0);
                  }
                },
              ),
              Text(
                '${_fontSize.toInt()}',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)),
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.text_increase_rounded, size: 18),
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                tooltip: 'Yazı Boyutunu Büyüt',
                onPressed: () {
                  if (_fontSize < 32.0) {
                    setState(() => _fontSize += 2.0);
                  }
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),

              // Meal Aç/Kapat Butonu
              IconButton(
                icon: Icon(
                  _showInlineTranslation ? Icons.translate_rounded : Icons.g_translate_outlined,
                  color: _showInlineTranslation ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white60,
                  size: 20,
                ),
                tooltip: _showInlineTranslation ? 'Meal Gizle' : 'Meal Göster',
                onPressed: () {
                  HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                  setState(() => _showInlineTranslation = !_showInlineTranslation);
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

        // ── Ana Mushaf Sayfası (Parmak Hareketine Duyarlı 3B Gerçek Sayfa Çevirme) ────────────
        Expanded(
          child: PageView.builder(
            controller: _pageController,
            physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
            itemCount: totalPages,
            onPageChanged: (idx) {
              AcousticAudioService.instance.playParchmentPageFlip();
              setState(() {
                _currentPageIndex = idx;
              });
            },
            itemBuilder: (context, pageIndex) {
              final pageVerses = _pages[pageIndex];
              final pageShowBismillah =
                  pageIndex == 0 && widget.surah.id != 9 && widget.surah.id != 1;

              final pageCard = Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 10, 14, 10),
                child: Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient: LinearGradient(
                      colors: isDark
                          ? [BeyanColors.tone(0xFF03221D), BeyanColors.tone(0xFF011613)]
                          : const [Color(0xFFFDFBF7), Color(0xFFF5EFE3)],
                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                    ),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.45 : 0.35),
                      width: 1.5,
                    ),
                    boxShadow: [
                      BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.35 : 0.08),
                        blurRadius: 16,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 6),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child: Stack(
                    children: [
                      // Cilt Sırtı Gölgelendirmesi (Gerçek Kitap Oluk Hissi)
                      Positioned(
                        top: 0,
                        bottom: 0,
                        right: 0,
                        width: 24,
                        child: IgnorePointer(
                          child: DecoratedBox(
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              borderRadius: const BorderRadius.horizontal(right: Radius.circular(20)),
                              gradient: LinearGradient(
                                begin: Alignment.centerRight,
                                end: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                colors: [
                                  Colors.black.withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.32 : 0.08),
                                  Colors.transparent,
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      // İç Tezhib Çerçeve Çizgisi
                      Positioned.fill(
                        child: Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.25 : 0.18),
                              width: 1,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),

                      // Sayfa İçeriği
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 12),
                        child: Column(
                          children: [
                            // ── Üst Sayfa Başlığı (Cüz & Sure Adı) ─────────
                            Row(
                              children: [
                                Text(
                                  widget.surah.localizedName(strings.language.code),
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF034A3E),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const Spacer(),
                                Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: [
                                    Icon(
                                      Icons.swipe_rounded,
                                      size: 13,
                                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.7),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                    Text(
                                      widget.surah.nameArabic,
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                                        fontSize: 16,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF034A3E),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ],
                            ),
                            Divider(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), height: 12, thickness: 0.8),

                            // Besmele (1. Sayfada)
                            if (pageShowBismillah) ...[
                              Container(
                                width: double.infinity,
                                margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                ),
                                child: Text(
                                  'بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ',
                                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                  textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                    fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                                    fontSize: 20,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            ],

                            // ── Kesintisiz Akan Arapça Mushaf Metni ──────────
                            Expanded(
                              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                                physics: const BouncingScrollPhysics(),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                  children: [
                                    Text.rich(
                                      TextSpan(
                                        children: [
                                          for (final verse in pageVerses) ...[
                                            WidgetSpan(
                                              alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.middle,
                                              child: GestureDetector(
                                                onTap: () => _onVerseTap(verse, strings),
                                                child: Container(
                                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 3, vertical: 1),
                                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                                    color: (activeVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber)
                                                        ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.14)
                                                        : Colors.transparent,
                                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                                  ),
                                                  child: _buildMushafVerseRichText(
                                                    verse: verse,
                                                    isDark: isDark,
                                                    isActiveVerse: activeVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber,
                                                    activeWordIndex: (activeVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber)
                                                        ? audioState.activeWordIndex
                                                        : null,
                                                    wordProgress: (activeVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber)
                                                        ? audioState.wordProgress
                                                        : 1.0,
                                                  ),
                                                ),
                                              ),
                                            ),
                                          ],
                                        ],
                                      ),
                                      textDirection: TextDirection.rtl,
                                      textAlign: TextAlign.justify,
                                    ),

                                    // Meal görünümü açıkken altta Türkçe meal
                                    if (_showInlineTranslation) ...[
                                      const SizedBox(height: 14),
                                      Divider(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), height: 16),
                                      for (final v in pageVerses) ...[
                                        Padding(
                                          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                                          child: Text(
                                            '${v.verseNumber}. ${v.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code)}',
                                            style: TextStyle(
                                              fontSize: 11.5,
                                              height: 1.35,
                                              color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                                            ),
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ],
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),

                            // ── Alt Sayfa Numarası (Mushaf Çerçevesi) ─────────
                            Divider(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37), height: 12, thickness: 0.8),
                            Center(
                              child: Text(
                                '— ${pageIndex + 1} / $totalPages —',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                                  letterSpacing: 1.5,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              );

              // Parmak hareketini anlık takip eden 3B Mushaf Sayfa Kıvrılma & Gölge Efekti
              return AnimatedBuilder(
                animation: _pageController,
                child: pageCard,
                builder: (context, child) {
                  double pageOffset = _currentPageIndex.toDouble();
                  if (_pageController.hasClients && _pageController.position.haveDimensions) {
                    pageOffset = _pageController.page ?? _currentPageIndex.toDouble();
                  }
                  final delta = (pageOffset - pageIndex).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
                  if (delta.abs() < 0.001) return child!;

                  final absDelta = delta.abs();
                  final isTurningAway = delta > 0;
                  final rotationY = delta * 0.62; // 3B perspektif açısı
                  final scale = 1.0 - (absDelta * 0.045);

                  final matrix = Matrix4.identity()
                    ..setEntry(3, 2, 0.0018) // 3B derinlik perspektifi
                    ..rotateY(rotationY)
                    ..scaleByDouble(scale, scale, 1.0, 1.0);

                  return Transform(
                    alignment: isTurningAway ? Alignment.centerLeft : Alignment.centerRight,
                    transform: matrix,
                    child: Stack(
                      children: [
                        child!,
                        // Parmakla çevrilirken oluşan dinamik kağıt kıvrımı ve gölgesi
                        Positioned.fill(
                          child: IgnorePointer(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 10, 14, 10),
                              child: DecoratedBox(
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                                    begin: isTurningAway ? Alignment.centerRight : Alignment.centerLeft,
                                    end: isTurningAway ? Alignment.centerLeft : Alignment.centerRight,
                                    stops: const [0.0, 0.25, 0.65, 1.0],
                                    colors: [
                                      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: (absDelta * 0.42).clamp(0.0, 0.42)),
                                      BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: (absDelta * 0.14).clamp(0.0, 0.14)),
                                      Colors.transparent,
                                      Colors.black.withValues(alpha: (absDelta * 0.22).clamp(0.0, 0.22)),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),

        // ── Alt Sayfa Kontrol Çubuğu (Önceki/Sonraki Sayfa) ──────────────────
        Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF031A16) : const Color(0xFFF6F3E9),
            border: Border(
              top: BorderSide(
                color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.3 : 0.25),
                width: 1,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              // Önceki Sayfa
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back_ios_rounded, size: 18),
                color: _currentPageIndex > 0 ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37) : Colors.white24,
                onPressed: _currentPageIndex > 0
                    ? () {
                        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                        _pageController.previousPage(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                        );
                      }
                    : null,
              ),

              // Sayfa Göstergesi
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35)),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  'Sayfa ${_currentPageIndex + 1} / $totalPages',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                  ),
                ),
              ),

              // Sonraki Sayfa
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_ios_rounded, size: 18),
                color: _currentPageIndex < totalPages - 1 ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37) : Colors.white24,
                onPressed: _currentPageIndex < totalPages - 1
                    ? () {
                        HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                        _pageController.nextPage(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
                          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                        );
                      }
                    : null,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/quran/widgets/quran_audio_player_bar.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../services/quran_audio_service.dart';
import 'sleep_and_ambience_sheet.dart';

/// Kur'an-ı Kerim Dinleme Mini Oynatıcı Çubuğu
class QuranAudioPlayerBar extends ConsumerWidget {
  const QuranAudioPlayerBar({super.key});

  String _formatDuration(Duration d) {
    final m = d.inMinutes.remainder(60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final s = d.inSeconds.remainder(60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    if (d.inHours > 0) {
      return '${d.inHours}:$m:$s';
    }
    return '$m:$s';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final audioState = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    if (audioState.currentSurahId == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final totalSecs = audioState.duration.inSeconds > 0 ? audioState.duration.inSeconds.toDouble() : 1.0;
    final currSecs = audioState.position.inSeconds.toDouble().clamp(0.0, totalSecs);

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 0, 16, 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF032822) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01362F),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
          width: 1.2,
        ),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            blurRadius: 14,
            offset: const Offset(0, 4),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 36,
                height: 36,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                ),
                child: const Icon(Icons.volume_up_rounded, color: Colors.black87, size: 20),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      audioState.activeVerseNumber != null
                          ? '${strings.recitationOfSurah(audioState.currentSurahName ?? 'Surah')} • ${audioState.activeVerseNumber}. Âyet'
                          : strings.recitationOfSurah(audioState.currentSurahName ?? 'Surah'),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      ),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                    Text(
                      audioState.activeWordIndex != null && audioState.isWordHighlightEnabled
                          ? '${audioState.selectedReciter.nameTr} • ${strings.wordTrackingBadge}'
                          : audioState.selectedReciter.nameTr,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 11,
                        color: Colors.white70,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              // Döngü / Ezber Tekrar Modu (1x, 3x, 5x, 10x, ∞)
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
                icon: Stack(
                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.repeat_rounded,
                      color: audioState.loopRepeatCount > 1 || audioState.loopRepeatCount == -1
                          ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                          : Colors.white60,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    if (audioState.loopRepeatCount != 1)
                      Positioned(
                        bottom: 0,
                        right: 0,
                        child: Text(
                          audioState.loopRepeatCount == -1 ? '∞' : '${audioState.loopRepeatCount}x',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 8.5,
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w900,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Ezber / Döngü Tekrarı' : 'Loop & Memorization Repeat',
                onPressed: () {
                  HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).cycleLoopRepeat();
                },
              ),
              // Manevi Ambiyans & Uyku Zamanlayıcısı
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
                icon: Icon(
                  audioState.activeAmbience != null || audioState.sleepTimerSecondsRemaining != null
                      ? Icons.bedtime_rounded
                      : Icons.bedtime_outlined,
                  color: audioState.activeAmbience != null || audioState.sleepTimerSecondsRemaining != null
                      ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                      : Colors.white60,
                  size: 19,
                ),
                tooltip: strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Manevi Ambiyans & Uyku Modu' : 'Ambience & Sleep Timer',
                onPressed: () => SleepAndAmbienceSheet.show(context),
              ),
              // 10 sn geri
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.replay_10_rounded, color: Colors.white70, size: 21),
                tooltip: strings.seekBackward10s,
                onPressed: () => ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekRelative(-10),
              ),
              // Oynat / Duraklat
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 36, minHeight: 36),
                icon: audioState.isLoading
                    ? SizedBox(
                        width: 22,
                        height: 22,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                      )
                    : Icon(
                        audioState.isPlaying ? Icons.pause_circle_filled_rounded : Icons.play_circle_fill_rounded,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                        size: 31,
                      ),
                onPressed: () {
                  HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                  ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).togglePlayPause();
                },
              ),
              // 10 sn ileri
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 32, minHeight: 32),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.forward_10_rounded, color: Colors.white70, size: 21),
                tooltip: strings.seekForward10s,
                onPressed: () => ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seekRelative(10),
              ),
              // Kapat
              IconButton(
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 28, minHeight: 28),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white54, size: 18),
                tooltip: strings.closeBtn,
                onPressed: () => ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).stop(),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          // Süre İlerleme Çubuğu
          Row(
            children: [
              Text(
                _formatDuration(audioState.position),
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10),
              ),
              Expanded(
                child: SliderTheme(
                  data: SliderTheme.of(context).copyWith(
                    trackHeight: 2.5,
                    thumbShape: const RoundSliderThumbShape(enabledThumbRadius: 5),
                    activeTrackColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                    inactiveTrackColor: Colors.white24,
                    thumbColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                  ),
                  child: Slider(
                    value: currSecs,
                    min: 0,
                    max: totalSecs,
                    onChanged: (val) {
                      ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).seek(Duration(seconds: val.toInt()));
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                _formatDuration(audioState.duration),
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white54, fontSize: 10),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/quran/widgets/sleep_and_ambience_sheet.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../services/quran_audio_service.dart';

/// Manevi Ambiyans & Uyku Zamanlayıcısı Modal Sayfası
class SleepAndAmbienceSheet extends ConsumerWidget {
  const SleepAndAmbienceSheet({super.key});

  static Future<void> show(BuildContext context) {
    return showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (_) => const SleepAndAmbienceSheet(),
    );
  }

  String _formatSeconds(int totalSecs) {
    final m = (totalSecs ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final s = (totalSecs % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    return '$m:$s';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final audioState = ref.watch(quranAudioProvider);
    final audioNotifier = ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 32),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF03221C) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF01362F),
        borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(28)),
        border: Border.all(
          color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          width: 1.2,
        ),
        boxShadow: const [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black54,
            blurRadius: 25,
            offset: Offset(0, -6),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // Tutamaç
          Center(
            child: Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 4,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white24,
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 18),

          // Başlık
          Row(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 38,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                ),
                child: Icon(Icons.bedtime_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B), size: 22),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                          ? 'Manevi Ambiyans & Uyku Modu'
                          : 'Sleep & Spiritual Ambience',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A),
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                          ? 'Kur\'an tilavetine huzur veren ortam sesleri eşlik etsin'
                          : 'Peaceful background ambience & gentle sleep timer',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: Colors.white70),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: Colors.white60),
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              ),
            ],
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 20),

            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.white54),
          ),
        ],
      ),

}

class _AmbienceChip extends StatelessWidget {
  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
  final bool isSelected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  const _AmbienceChip({
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
    required this.isSelected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Expanded(
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: isSelected ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37) : Colors.white10,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
            border: Border.all(
              color: isSelected ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : Colors.white24,
              width: 1,
            ),
          ),
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              Icon(
                icon,
                size: 18,
                color: isSelected ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B) : Colors.white70,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.w500,
                  color: isSelected ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B) : Colors.white,
                ),
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

## Dosya: lib/features/quran/widgets/verse_card_widget.dart

`dart
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/theme_provider.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../core/localization/app_strings.dart';
import '../../quran/models/verse.dart';
import '../../quran/widgets/arabic_text_widget.dart';
import '../providers/quran_reading_providers.dart';
import '../services/quran_audio_service.dart';

/// Tek bir ayeti tam olarak gösteren lüks kart widget'ı.
class VerseCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Verse verse;
  final String? surahName;
  final bool showSurahReference;
  final bool isHighlighted;
  final bool isPlaying;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final void Function(int wordIndex)? onWordTap;

  const VerseCard({
    super.key,
    required this.verse,
    this.surahName,
    this.showSurahReference = false,
    this.isHighlighted = false,
    this.isPlaying = false,
    this.onTap,
    this.onWordTap,
  });

  void _shareVerse(BuildContext context, AppStrings strings) {
    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
    final isTr = strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish;
    final meaning = verse.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code);
    final header = isTr
        ? 'Sure No: ${verse.surahId}, Ayet: ${verse.verseNumber}'
        : 'Surah: ${verse.surahId}, Verse: ${verse.verseNumber}';
    final label = isTr ? 'Meali:' : 'Translation:';
    final text = '$header\n\n'
        '${verse.arabicText}\n\n'
        '$label $meaning\n\n'
        '— Beyân';
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A), size: 18),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(strings.verseCopied(verse.reference)),
          ],
        ),
        backgroundColor: BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 2),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Apple Music Live Lyrics tarzı Harf Harf (Character-by-Character) Okunuş Senkronizasyonu
  Widget _buildTransliterationText(
    BuildContext context,
    bool isDark,
    int? activeWordIndex,
    double wordProgress,
    double verseProgress,
  ) {
    final text = verse.transliteration;
    if (text == null || text.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    final baseLitColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B);
    final completedColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF80CBC4) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0A685A);
    final unlitColor = isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.30) : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.28);

    if (activeWordIndex == null) {
      return Text(
        text,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 14.0,
          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
          color: completedColor,
          height: 1.55,
        ),
        textAlign: TextAlign.left,
      );
    }

    final words = text.trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).where((w) => w.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (words.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final clampedIndex = activeWordIndex.clamp(0, words.length - 1);
    final wp = wordProgress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);

    return Text.rich(
      TextSpan(
        children: [
          for (int i = 0; i < words.length; i++) ...[
            if (i < clampedIndex)
              TextSpan(
                text: words[i],
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14.0,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  height: 1.55,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: completedColor,
                ),
              )
            else if (i > clampedIndex)
              TextSpan(
                text: words[i],
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14.0,
                  fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  height: 1.55,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.normal,
                  color: unlitColor,
                ),
              )
            else ...[
              // Aktif kelimenin içindeki harfleri Apple Music Live Lyrics gibi harf harf aydınlat
              ...() {
                final word = words[i];
                final len = word.length;
                final exactPos = wp * len;
                final litChars = exactPos.floor().clamp(0, len);
                final frac = (exactPos - litChars).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

                final spans = <InlineSpan>[];
                if (litChars > 0) {
                  spans.add(
                    TextSpan(
                      text: word.substring(0, litChars),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14.5,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        height: 1.55,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: baseLitColor,
                        shadows: [
                          Shadow(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.55),
                            blurRadius: 8,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }
                if (litChars < len) {
                  spans.add(
                    TextSpan(
                      text: word.substring(litChars, litChars + 1),
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 14.5,
                        fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        height: 1.55,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: Color.lerp(unlitColor, baseLitColor, frac) ?? baseLitColor,
                        shadows: [
                          Shadow(
                            color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.45 * frac),
                            blurRadius: 6,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                  if (litChars + 1 < len) {
                    spans.add(
                      TextSpan(
                        text: word.substring(litChars + 1),
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 14.0,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                          height: 1.55,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          color: unlitColor,
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                }
                return spans;
              }(),
            ],
            if (i < words.length - 1)
              const TextSpan(
                text: ' ',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14.0, height: 1.55),
              ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      textAlign: TextAlign.left,
    );
  }

  /// Meal metni için Apple Music tarzı harf harf (character-by-character) akan senkronizasyon
  Widget _buildLiveSyncedMeaningText(
    BuildContext context,
    String meaning,
    bool isDark,
    bool isActivePlaying,
    double verseProgress,
  ) {
    final defaultColor = isDark ? Colors.white70 : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF334E48);
    if (!isActivePlaying || meaning.isEmpty) {
      return Text(
        meaning,
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
              height: 1.6,
              fontSize: 14.0,
              color: defaultColor,
            ),
        textAlign: TextAlign.left,
      );
    }

    final prog = verseProgress.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    final len = meaning.length;
    final exactChar = prog * len;
    final litCount = exactChar.floor().clamp(0, len);
    final charFrac = (exactChar - litCount).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

    final litColor = isDark ? Colors.white : BeyanColors.tone(0xFF012E2B);
    final activeCharColor = isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37);
    final dimColor = isDark ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.36) : Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.34);

    return Text.rich(
      TextSpan(
        style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodyMedium?.copyWith(
              height: 1.6,
              fontSize: 14.0,
            ),
        children: [
          if (litCount > 0)
            TextSpan(
              text: meaning.substring(0, litCount),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: litColor,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
            ),
          if (litCount < len) ...[
            TextSpan(
              text: meaning.substring(litCount, litCount + 1),
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Color.lerp(dimColor, activeCharColor, charFrac),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            if (litCount + 1 < len)
              TextSpan(
                text: meaning.substring(litCount + 1),
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: dimColor,
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      textAlign: TextAlign.left,
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final effectivePalette = ref.watch(effectivePaletteProvider);
    BeyanColors.setPalette(effectivePalette);
    final strings = ref.watch(appStringsProvider);
    final isDark = Theme.of(context).brightness == Brightness.dark;
    final arabicFontSize = ref.watch(arabicFontSizeProvider);
    final isBookmarked = ref.watch(bookmarkedVersesProvider).contains('${verse.surahId}:${verse.verseNumber}');
    final lastRead = ref.watch(lastReadProvider);
    final isLastRead = lastRead?.surahId == verse.surahId && lastRead?.verseNumber == verse.verseNumber;
    final shouldHighlight = isLastRead || isHighlighted || isPlaying;

    final memorizationState = ref.watch(quranMemorizationProvider);
    final isComparativeMealEnabled = ref.watch(comparativeMealProvider);
    final isLoopingThisVerse = ref.watch(
      quranAudioProvider.select((s) => s.loopVerseNumber == verse.verseNumber),
    );

    final allWords = verse.words;
    final revealedSet = memorizationState.revealedWordsByVerse[verse.verseNumber] ?? <int>{};
    final hiddenIndices = memorizationState.isActive
        ? Set<int>.from(List.generate(allWords.length, (i) => i)).difference(revealedSet)
        : null;

    // SADECE ve SADECE bu ayet çalıyorsa ses akış ilerlemesini dinle (diğer tüm ayetler 30 FPS rebuild'den kurtulur!)
    final int? activeWordIndex;
    final double verseProgress;
    final double wordProgress;
    if (isPlaying) {
      final activeAudio = ref.watch(
        quranAudioProvider.select((s) => (
          s.isWordHighlightEnabled ? s.activeWordIndex : null,
          s.verseProgress,
          s.wordProgress,
        )),
      );
      activeWordIndex = activeAudio.$1;
      verseProgress = activeAudio.$2;
      wordProgress = activeAudio.$3;
    } else {
      activeWordIndex = null;
      verseProgress = 0.0;
      wordProgress = 1.0;
    }

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 6),
      elevation: isPlaying ? 3 : 0,
      shadowColor: isPlaying ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A).withValues(alpha: 0.3) : Colors.transparent,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        side: BorderSide(
          color: isPlaying
              ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
              : (shouldHighlight
                  ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)
                  : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF133B34) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE2EBE8))),
          width: isPlaying ? 2.2 : (shouldHighlight ? 1.8 : 1),
        ),
      ),
      color: isPlaying
          ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF13423A) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE8F6F0))
          : (shouldHighlight
              ? (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0F362F) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFF1F8F5))
              : (isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF0D2823) : Colors.white)),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 16),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: [
              // ── Ayet Header & İşlem Butonları (Taşma Korumalı Düzen) ──────
              Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Wrap(
                      crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                      spacing: 6,
                      runSpacing: 4,
                      children: [
                        // Daire içinde ayet numarası
                        Container(
                          width: 34,
                          height: 34,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            color: isPlaying
                                ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)
                                : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: isDark ? 0.2 : 0.1),
                            border: Border.all(
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.6),
                              width: 1,
                            ),
                          ),
                          child: Center(
                            child: Text(
                              '${verse.verseNumber}',

                              ),

                          ),

                        // Referans Etiketi
                        Container(

                        : (strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish ? 'Bu Âyeti Tekrarla' : 'Loop This Verse'),
                    onPressed: () {
                      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                      if (isLoopingThisVerse) {
                        ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).setLoopVerse(null);
                      } else {
                        ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).setLoopVerse(verse.verseNumber);
                        if (ref.read(quranAudioProvider).loopRepeatCount <= 1) {
                          ref.read(quranAudioProvider.notifier).setLoopRepeat(3);

                      }
                    },
                  ),

                  // 5. Paylaş & Kopyala

                          } else {
                            ref.read(quranMemorizationProvider.notifier).revealAllInVerse(verse.verseNumber, allWords.length);
                          }

                        child: Text(

                          style: TextStyle(

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,

                            decoration: TextDecoration.underline,

                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],

              // Ayet İlerleme Çizgisi (Canlı Okunurken)
              if (isPlaying) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                  child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: verseProgress.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    minHeight: 2.2,
                    backgroundColor: isDark ? Colors.white10 : Colors.black12,
                    valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(BeyanColors.tone(0xFFFFDF7A)),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
              ] else ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
              ],

              // ── Arapça Metin (Apple Music Tarzı Kelime & Harf Harf Akış & Ezber Maskesi & Dokun-Atla) ──
              ArabicText(
                verse.arabicText,
                fontSize: arabicFontSize,
                lineHeight: 2.1,
                textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                highlightedWordIndex: activeWordIndex,
                highlightedWordProgress: wordProgress,
                hiddenWordIndices: hiddenIndices,
                onWordTap: (wordIdx) {
                  if (memorizationState.isActive) {
                    HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                    ref.read(quranMemorizationProvider.notifier).revealWord(verse.verseNumber, wordIdx);
                  } else if (onWordTap != null) {
                    onWordTap!(wordIdx);
                  }
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 14),

              // Arapça / Latin bölücü çizgi
              Divider(
                color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF1A3D36) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE8EEEC),
                thickness: 0.8,
                height: 1,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // ── Türkçe Okunuş (Apple Music Live Lyrics Tarzı Harf Harf Akışlı) ─
              if (verse.transliteration != null && verse.transliteration!.isNotEmpty) ...[
                _buildTransliterationText(context, isDark, activeWordIndex, wordProgress, verseProgress),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
              ],

              // ── Birincil Meal (Canlı Okuma Sırasında Harf Harf Aydınlanan) ───
              _buildLiveSyncedMeaningText(
                context,
                verse.localizedMeaning(strings.language.code),
                isDark,
                isPlaying,
                verseProgress,
              ),

              // ── Çift Mealli Karşılaştırma Kutusu ──────────────────
              if (isComparativeMealEnabled) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: isDark ? BeyanColors.tone(0xFF042B24) : BeyanColors.tone(0xFFE8F2EF),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    border: Border.all(
                      color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37).withValues(alpha: 0.35),
                      width: 0.8,
                    ),
                  ),
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.compare_arrows_rounded, size: 14, color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37)),
                          const SizedBox(width: 5),
                          Text(
                            strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                                ? 'Saheeh International (İngilizce Karşılaştırmalı)'
                                : 'Turkish Translation (Diyanet Comparative)',
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        strings.language == AppLanguage.turkish
                            ? (verse.meaningEn ?? verse.turkishMeaning)
                            : verse.turkishMeaning,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          height: 1.5,
                          color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                          fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

/// Kur'an-ı Kerim Cüz Bilgisi
class QuranJuzInfo {
  final int juzNumber;
  final String startSurah;
  final int startAyah;
  final int startPage;
  final int endPage;

  const QuranJuzInfo({
    required this.juzNumber,
    required this.startSurah,
    required this.startAyah,
    required this.startPage,
    required this.endPage,
  });

  int get pageCount => (endPage - startPage) + 1;
}

/// Standart 30 Cüz Listesi (Mushaf Sayfa Aralıklarıyla)
final List<QuranJuzInfo> quranJuzList = [
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 1, startSurah: 'Fâtiha', startAyah: 1, startPage: 1, endPage: 21),

  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 22, startSurah: 'Ahzâb', startAyah: 31, startPage: 422, endPage: 441),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 23, startSurah: 'Yâsîn', startAyah: 28, startPage: 442, endPage: 461),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 24, startSurah: 'Zümer', startAyah: 32, startPage: 462, endPage: 481),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 25, startSurah: 'Fussilet', startAyah: 47, startPage: 482, endPage: 501),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 26, startSurah: 'Ahkâf', startAyah: 1, startPage: 502, endPage: 521),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 27, startSurah: 'Zâriyât', startAyah: 31, startPage: 522, endPage: 541),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 28, startSurah: 'Mücâdele', startAyah: 1, startPage: 542, endPage: 561),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 29, startSurah: 'Mülk', startAyah: 1, startPage: 562, endPage: 581),
  const QuranJuzInfo(juzNumber: 30, startSurah: 'Nebe', startAyah: 1, startPage: 582, endPage: 604),
];

/// Hatim Takip Durumu
class KhatamProgressState {
  final Set<int> completedJuzs;

  const KhatamProgressState({required this.completedJuzs});

  bool isCompleted(int juzNumber) => completedJuzs.contains(juzNumber);
  int get completedCount => completedJuzs.length;
  double get percentage => (completedCount / 30.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
  bool get isEntireQuranCompleted => completedCount == 30;
}

/// Hatim Takip State Notifier
class KhatamProgressNotifier extends StateNotifier<KhatamProgressState> {
  static const _keyCompleted = 'beyan_khatam_completed_juzs';

  KhatamProgressNotifier() : super(const KhatamProgressState(completedJuzs: {})) {
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final list = prefs.getStringList(_keyCompleted) ?? [];
      final set = list.map((e) => int.tryParse(e) ?? 0).where((e) => e > 0).toSet();
      state = KhatamProgressState(completedJuzs: set);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> toggleJuz(int juzNumber) async {
    final updated = Set<int>.from(state.completedJuzs);
    if (updated.contains(juzNumber)) {
      updated.remove(juzNumber);
    } else {
      updated.add(juzNumber);
    }
    state = KhatamProgressState(completedJuzs: updated);
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setStringList(
        _keyCompleted,
        updated.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(),
      );
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> resetAll() async {
    state = const KhatamProgressState(completedJuzs: {});
    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.remove(_keyCompleted);
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}

final khatamProgressProvider =
    StateNotifierProvider<KhatamProgressNotifier, KhatamProgressState>((ref) {
  return KhatamProgressNotifier();
});

                  '«اَللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا إِمَامًا وَنُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً. '
                  'اَللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنَا مِنْهُ مَا نَسِينَا، وَعَلِّمْنَا مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْنَا، '
                  'وَارْزُقْنَا تِلاَوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ، '
                  'وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.»',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: 'Amiri',
                    fontSize: 18,
                    height: 1.8,
                    color: BeyanColors.tone(0xFFD4AF37),

                'Gece saatlerinde ve gündüzün etrafında onu okumayı bize nasip eyle ve onu lehimize delil kıl ey Âlemlerin Rabbi!»',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12,
                  color: isDark ? Colors.white70 : Colors.black87,
                  height: 1.4,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: Text('Kapat', style: TextStyle(color: gold, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _confirmReset(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Hatmi Sıfırla'),
        content: const Text('Tüm cüz ilerlemeniz sıfırlanacaktır. Yeni bir hatme başlamak istiyor musunuz?'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Vazgeç'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              ref.read(khatamProgressProvider.notifier).resetAll();
              Navigator.pop(ctx);
            },
            child: const Text('Sıfırla', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:islamic_app/core/theme/beyan_colors.dart';
